papers.title: Spin Migration in the Argon Dimer
papers.abstract: We introduce the concept of \emph{spin migration}, i.e. time-dependent spin density, and the absolute smallest example of molecular spintronics. We illustrate the concept by \emph{ab initio} calculations of the coupled vibronic motion of the electrons and the nuclei in the argon dimer cation, in which the vibrational level spacing is similar to the spin--orbit splitting of the atomic argon cations. We find that the spin density varies on multiple time scales, given by the natural time scales of the electronic and nuclear wavepackets.
papers.title_cn: 氩二聚体中的自旋迁移
papers.abs_cn: 我们引入了\emph{自旋迁移}的概念，即随时间变化的自旋密度，以及分子自旋电子学中绝对最小的例子。我们通过\emph{从头算}计算氩二聚体阳离子中电子与原子核的耦合振动运动来说明这一概念，其中振动能级间距与原子氩阳离子的自旋--轨道分裂相似。我们发现自旋密度在多个时间尺度上变化，这些时间尺度由电子和核波包的自然时间尺度给出。

papers.title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
papers.abstract: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.
papers.title_cn: 从自然语言设计蛋白质结构
papers.abs_cn: 从头蛋白质设计的一个核心挑战是生成具有所需结构和功能特性的蛋白质。现有设计模型通常需要为每种特性使用专门的输入表示，限制了其支持的设计目标。我们开发了 Prompteina，这是首个支持以自然语言指定的新的、更广泛设计目标的全原子结构生成模型，类似于文本到图像生成。为了训练 Prompteina，我们构建了 Prompteina-Data，这是一个配对的文本--蛋白质结构数据集，包含 180 万个结构和超过 5000 万条描述全局及残基特异性结构和功能特性的标题。我们通过文本条件预训练和微调对预训练结构生成模型 Proteina-Complexa 进行适配，使残基与其对应的文本对齐。Prompteina 在 18 项结构特性中的 15 项上优于基线，并生成更符合其预期功能描述的蛋白质。在结合体设计中，它在 20 个靶标中至少 13 个上领先基线，并将界面置信度相比最强基线提高了 14%。通过迭代的计算机反馈，Prompteina 相对于非迭代生成的增益在最难靶标上比次优基线大 57%。最后，我们针对 GM2A 实验验证了 Prompteina 的设计，该靶标尚无报道的从头结合体。我们鉴定出九个结合体，其中最强者的表观 $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ 为 107 nM。这些结果确立了自然语言作为蛋白质结构生成的有效且强大的条件接口。

papers.title: Accuracy of Vibrational Properties of Machine-Learning Force Fields for Molecular Crystal Transformations
papers.abstract: Machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) enable the calculation of transformation pathways in molecular crystals at a fraction of the computational cost of density functional theory (DFT). However, a good agreement in energies and structures does not necessarily imply an accurate description of vibrational properties, which are essential for characterizing transition states and determining free energies at finite temperatures. Herein, we assess the accuracy of system-specific SO3krates MLFFs trained on PBE+MBD reference data for describing vibrational properties of molecular crystal transformations. As examples, we consider a polymorph transition of 1,4-diiodobenzene and a single-crystal-to-single-crystal Diels-Alder reaction. The transition state structures obtained from solid-state nudged-elastic-band (NEB) calculations with the MLFFs exhibit a single imaginary $Γ$-point frequency associated with the respective transformation. Compared with PBE+MBD, the mean absolute errors of $Γ$-point vibrational frequencies and relative harmonic free energies at 300 K are about 3 cm$^{-1}$ and 1 kJ/mol, respectively. Furthermore, we compare for the Diels-Alder reaction a collective transformation pathway with a sequential one, in which individual diene-dienophile pairs react successively, and demonstrate that PBE0+MBD single-point corrections can significantly affect the predicted reaction energetics. These results demonstrate that system-specific MLFFs can reproduce not only the energies and forces but also the local curvature of the potential-energy surface with high accuracy, enabling reliable calculations of harmonic vibrational free energies, providing a basis for extending the studies of molecular crystal transformations to larger supercells.
papers.title_cn: 机器学习力场对分子晶体转变的振动性质的准确性
papers.abs_cn: 机器学习力场（MLFFs）能够以远低于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算成本计算分子晶体的转变路径。然而，能量和结构上的良好一致性并不一定意味着对振动性质的准确描述，而振动性质对于表征过渡态和确定有限温度下的自由能至关重要。在此，我们评估了基于 PBE+MBD 参考数据训练的特定体系 SO3krates MLFFs 在描述分子晶体转变振动性质方面的准确性。作为示例，我们考虑了 1,4-二碘苯的多晶型转变和单晶到单晶的 Diels-Alder 反应。使用 MLFFs 进行固态微动弹性带（NEB）计算获得的过渡态结构表现出与各自转变相关的单个虚 Γ 点频率。与 PBE+MBD 相比，Γ 点振动频率和 300 K 下相对谐波自由能的平均绝对误差分别约为 3 cm^-1 和 1 kJ/mol。此外，对于 Diels-Alder 反应，我们比较了集体转变路径与顺序转变路径（其中各个二烯-亲双烯体对依次反应），并证明 PBE0+MBD 单点校正可以显著影响预测的反应能量学。这些结果表明，特定体系的 MLFFs 不仅能够高精度地再现能量和力，还能高精度地再现势能面的局部曲率，从而能够可靠地计算谐波振动自由能，为将分子晶体转变研究扩展到更大的超胞提供了基础。

papers.title: Necessary conditions for benchmarking next-generation AI in materials discovery
papers.abstract: Current AI predicts materials by speeding up energy minimisation and training on large databases. However, scaling data generation prevents manual analysis by domain experts. If novelty is evaluated by chemical compositions or traditional representations in Crystallographic Information Files, or standard structure matchers based on manually chosen thresholds, one can easily generate millions of ``new'' compositions or files without discovering truly novel materials. This paper uses a hierarchy of crystal invariants to continuously trace and quantify structural novelty based on the new mathematical definition of a crystal structure and asymptotic guarantees for invariant descriptors. The invariant-based analysis through cascade computations on a modest computer exposes the unexpected scale of duplication in the world's largest materials databases, shown here in the high-profile case of GNoME datasets. To prevent current ``embarrassment of over-prediction'', we propose necessary conditions for next-generation AI that should be automatically enforced before claiming any new materials.
papers.title_cn: 下一代人工智能在材料发现中基准测试的必要条件
papers.abs_cn: 当前的人工智能通过加速能量最小化和在大规模数据库上训练来预测材料。然而，数据生成规模的扩大阻碍了领域专家的手动分析。如果新颖性是通过化学组成或晶体学信息文件中的传统表示，或基于手动选择阈值的标准结构匹配器来评估的，那么人们很容易生成数百万个“新”组成或文件，而无法发现真正新颖的材料。本文利用晶体不变量的层级结构，基于晶体结构的新数学定义和不变量描述符的渐近保证，持续追踪和量化结构新颖性。通过在普通计算机上进行级联计算，基于不变量的分析揭示了世界上最大的材料数据库中意想不到的重复规模，本文以备受瞩目的GNoME数据集为例进行了展示。为了防止当前“过度预测的尴尬”，我们提出了下一代人工智能的必要条件，这些条件应在声称任何新材料之前自动强制执行。

papers.title: Potential energy release rate for solids with bounded domains during evolutions involving changes to boundaries and boundary data
papers.abstract: We investigate the rate of change of equilibrium potential energy for nonlinear elastic solids undergoing evolutions that may involve changes in body geometry, material properties, applied tractions, and prescribed displacements. We represent such an evolution by a one-parameter family of variational problems and identify a class of these families for which the potential-energy release rate is well defined. Particular attention is given to the formulation of the potential energy at each evolution state: each constituent variational problem must yield the appropriate equilibrium state, while its equilibrium value must also correctly represent the physical change in potential energy between states. Within this framework, we derive a closed-form expression for the potential-energy release rate for solids with bounded domains, allowing for spatially nonuniform material evolution, sharp material interfaces, and evolving boundary geometry and prescribed boundary data. The expression is determined entirely by the equilibrium solution at the state under consideration and by the quantities prescribing the local evolution, so neighboring equilibrium problems need not be solved. Finally, we apply the result to the extension of a notch in a two-dimensional elastic body and show that the resulting potential-energy release rate reduces to the classical $J$-integral.
papers.title_cn: 有界区域固体在涉及边界和边界数据变化的演化过程中的势能释放率
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了非线性弹性固体在可能涉及物体几何、材料属性、施加面力和指定位移变化的演化过程中的平衡势能变化率。我们将此类演化表示为一族单参数变分问题，并确定了一类势能释放率有良好定义的此类问题族。特别关注每个演化状态下势能的表述：每个组成变分问题必须给出相应的平衡状态，同时其平衡值也必须正确表示状态之间势能的物理变化。在此框架内，我们推导了有界区域固体势能释放率的闭式表达式，允许空间非均匀材料演化、尖锐材料界面以及演化的边界几何和指定边界数据。该表达式完全由所考虑状态的平衡解和规定局部演化的量决定，因此无需解决相邻的平衡问题。最后，我们将结果应用于二维弹性体中缺口的扩展，并表明所得的势能释放率退化为经典的 $J$-积分。

papers.title: Classification of topological phases of matter in stochastic systems
papers.abstract: Topological phases of matter support edge states protected from random perturbations, and the identification of the discrete non-spatial symmetries and dimensions that support such phases was systematically developed for quantum systems and analogous platforms. While topological phases were also discovered in stochastic systems and posited as mechanisms for key biochemical processes, a classification consistent with their Markovian constraints remains lacking, impeding generalization to new scenarios. To address this, we develop new methods including a new homotopy approach, real-space invariants and a redefinition of the point gap to classify both transient and steady states. We find robust transient states in two symmetry classes, no symmetry and pseudo-Hermiticity respectively, while topological steady states are expected only in systems without symmetry. We identify the dimensions with non-trivial phases and their group structure, creating a rigorous framework for predicting robust behavior in active and living matter.
papers.title_cn: 随机系统中物质拓扑相的分类
papers.abs_cn: 物质拓扑相支持受随机扰动保护的边缘态，而支持此类相的离散非空间对称性和维度的识别已在量子系统及类似平台上得到系统发展。尽管拓扑相也在随机系统中被发现，并被假定为关键生化过程的机制，但仍缺乏与其马尔可夫约束相一致分类，阻碍了对新场景的推广。为解决这一问题，我们发展了新方法，包括一种新的同伦方法、实空间不变量以及点隙的重新定义，以对瞬态和稳态进行分类。我们在两个对称类（分别为无对称性和伪厄米性）中发现了鲁棒瞬态，而拓扑稳态仅预期存在于无对称性的系统中。我们识别了具有非平凡相的维度及其群结构，为预测活性和生命物质中的鲁棒行为创建了严格框架。

papers.title: Doubly Metastable Synthesis for Accelerated Quantum Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: New physics emerges from new materials, which in turn rely on the development of new synthesis techniques. Identifying the enlargement of metastable synthesis window as enabling for realizing novel materials, we develop diffusion-activated epitaxy, a technique which combines two metastable synthesis methods of diffusion and epitaxy. We observe that within a narrow window of investigated synthesis space we can experimentally identify the stabilization of four distinct phases, three of which show X-ray diffraction and scanning transmission electron microscopy characterization data that are incompatible with the crystal structures registered in experimental and computational inorganic structure databases. These results suggest an enlarged metastable synthesis window is enabled by this synthesis approach, identifying doubly metastable synthesis as a promising method for exploration of quantum materials.
papers.title_cn: 双亚稳合成用于加速量子材料发现
papers.abs_cn: 新物理源于新材料，而新材料又依赖于新合成技术的发展。认识到亚稳合成窗口的扩大能够实现新材料，我们开发了扩散激活外延，这是一种结合了扩散和外延两种亚稳合成方法的技术。我们观察到，在研究合成空间的狭窄窗口内，我们可以在实验上识别出四种不同相的稳定化，其中三种相的X射线衍射和扫描透射电子显微镜表征数据与实验和计算无机结构数据库中登记的晶体结构不相容。这些结果表明，这种合成方法实现了扩大的亚稳合成窗口，将双亚稳合成确定为探索量子材料的一种有前景的方法。

papers.title: Final-state centrality in relativistic heavy-ion simulations from neural networks
papers.abstract: Experiments in relativistic heavy-ion collisions determine centrality from final-state quantities, usually the charged-particle multiplicity. Performing the same in hydrodynamic simulations requires millions of events, which is impractical for state-of-the-art hybrid models, and centrality is therefore commonly approximated by the initial entropy or energy. We show that neural networks trained on a few hundred hybrid events predict the event-by-event multiplicity and mean transverse momentum $[p_T]$ with relative errors of 1--2\%, which makes it possible to generate millions of collisions at a small fraction of the cost of the full simulation. For Pb--Pb collisions at $2.76$~TeV and Au--Au collisions at $200$~GeV, the initial-state and final-state definitions select nearly the same events in 10\%-wide classes, but up to 20\% of the events change class when the classes are 1\% wide. We then compute the fluctuations of $[p_T]$ and its Pearson correlations with a proxy of the elliptic flow, estimated from the initial eccentricity, and with multiplicity. The first correlation is insensitive to how centrality is defined, while the second changes substantially. The approach can be applied at every design point of Bayesian analyses at modest additional cost.
papers.title_cn: 相对论重离子模拟中基于神经网络的末态中心度
papers.abs_cn: 相对论重离子碰撞实验通过末态量（通常是带电粒子多重数）确定中心度。在流体动力学模拟中做同样的事需要数百万个事件，这对最先进的混合模型来说不切实际，因此中心度通常用初始熵或能量来近似。我们表明，在几百个混合事件上训练的神经网络可以预测逐事件多重数和平均横动量 $[p_T]$，相对误差为 1--2\%，这使得以完整模拟成本的一小部分生成数百万次碰撞成为可能。对于 $2.76$~TeV 的 Pb--Pb 碰撞和 $200$~GeV 的 Au--Au 碰撞，初态和末态定义在 10\% 宽的类别中选出几乎相同的事件，但当类别宽度为 1\% 时，多达 20\% 的事件会改变类别。然后我们计算 $[p_T]$ 的涨落及其与椭圆流代理量（由初始偏心率估计）和多重数的 Pearson 关联。第一个关联对中心度如何定义不敏感，而第二个则变化显著。该方法可以以适度的额外成本应用于贝叶斯分析的每个设计点。

papers.title: Phononic Frequency Combs in Twisted Bilayer Transition Metal Dichalcogenide Heterostructures from First Principles
papers.abstract: Phononic frequency combs are equidistant spectral ladders generated when a driven vibrational mode transfers energy to an autoparametrically excited subharmonic mode through anharmonic intermode coupling. In previous studies, the coupling strength governing this energy transfer has typically been treated as a free parameter, extracted from a fabricated device, or adopted from an earlier calculation for a specific mode pair. As a result, whether a given crystal can support a phononic frequency comb, and the drive strength required to generate it, has not been predictable a priori. Here we obtain the complete parameter set from density functional theory. Twisted bilayers of \MoSSe{} and \MoSMoSe{} at the commensurate angle $21.787^{\circ}$ adopt space group $P3$ in a 42-atom \rootseven{} moiré supercell. The second-order force constants provide the mode frequencies; the third-order constants provide the linewidths through the Boltzmann transport equation and hence the quality factors; and the same third-order tensor projected onto the phonon eigenvectors of a chosen mode pair provides the anharmonic couplings $\kt$ and $\kss$. Both bilayers constitute a mode pair within $0.8\%$ of the $2\!:\!1$ resonance with $ω_1/ω_2 = 1.9923$ in \MoSSe{} and $1.9943$ in \MoSMoSe{}. By integrating the resulting two-mode equations, both modes generate combs through a discontinuous transition: at $701\,\fth$ in \MoSSe{} the envelope variance rises from $2.1\times10^{3}$ to $1.37\times10^{4}$ and the tooth count of mode 1 from 7 to 16 within a single $5\,\fth$ increment, identifying the onset as subcritical. The spectral entropy peaks \emph{before} this jump, at $341\,\fth$. The two compounds carry comparable coupling, differing by a factor of $1.2$. However, the comb excitation threshold is set by the quality-factors of signal modes: $Q_2 = 672$ for \MoSSe{} and $Q_2 = 3844$ for \MoSMoSe{}.
papers.title_cn: 第一性原理研究扭转双层过渡金属硫族化合物异质结构中的声子频率梳
papers.abs_cn: 声子频率梳是当驱动振动模式通过非谐模式间耦合将能量转移至自参数激发的次谐波模式时产生的等间距频谱阶梯。在以往研究中，主导这种能量转移的耦合强度通常被视为自由参数、从制备器件中提取，或沿用针对特定模式对的早期计算结果。因此，给定晶体能否支持声子频率梳以及产生它所需的驱动强度，此前无法先验预测。本文中，我们从密度泛函理论获得了完整的参数集。MoSSe 和 MoSMoSe 的扭转双层在公度角 $21.787^{\circ}$ 下采用空间群 $P3$，处于 42 原子 root7 莫尔超胞中。二阶力常数提供模式频率；三阶常数通过 Boltzmann 输运方程提供线宽，进而给出品质因子；同一三阶张量投影到所选模式对的声子本征矢上，提供非谐耦合 kt 和 kss。两种双层均构成一个模式对，其与 2:1 共振的偏差在 0.8% 以内，MoSSe 中 omega1/omega2 = 1.9923，MoSMoSe 中为 1.9943。通过积分所得的双模式方程，两种模式均通过不连续转变产生频率梳：在 MoSSe 中于 701 fth 处，包络方差从 2.1×10^3 升至 1.37×10^4，模式 1 的梳齿数在单个 5 fth 增量内从 7 增至 16，表明其起始为亚临界。谱熵在此跃变之前达到峰值，位于 341 fth。两种化合物具有相当的耦合，相差 1.2 倍。然而，频率梳激发阈值由信号模式的品质因子决定：MoSSe 的 Q2 = 672，MoSMoSe 的 Q2 = 3844。

papers.title: Physical-state supervision for design-only Gaussian process surrogates of implosion simulations
papers.abstract: Physical diagnostics recorded during simulation can organize a sharply varying response, but using them as surrogate inputs normally requires another calculation at prediction. We construct a physical-state-supervised Gaussian process surrogate that learns these diagnostics from design variables. Cross-fitted state estimates augment a retained design representation; a global Gaussian process and an optional soft mixture of response-band experts use identical inputs. On a database of 1,987 paired one-dimensional implosions, learned burn-weighted states from calculations without alpha-particle heating reduce mean squared log-response error by 60.25% and 52.98% for the global predictor on random holdout and design-space extrapolation. Random-projection and shuffled-state supervision do not reproduce these gains. For CH, matched-input comparisons show that experts help at smaller training budgets but contribute little at 1,000 designs with this representation. A thermal-feedback benchmark validates the complete learned-state procedure, while 3,000 newly calculated Be/Cocktail designs expose weaker extrapolation gains and cases where experts degrade accuracy. A conditional state-error bound separates encoding sensitivity from routing effects. An open Python implementation reproduces the archived predictions and is released with the data, per-design results, and measured costs. Physical-state supervision is thus a useful representation for finite-data surrogates, whereas expert specialization should be selected by validation.
papers.title_cn: 内爆模拟纯设计高斯过程代理模型的物理状态监督
papers.abs_cn: 模拟过程中记录的物理诊断量能够组织剧烈变化的响应，但将其用作代理模型输入通常需要在预测时进行额外计算。我们构建了一种物理状态监督的高斯过程代理模型，从设计变量中学习这些诊断量。交叉拟合的状态估计增强了一个保留的设计表示；一个全局高斯过程和一个可选的响应带专家软混合模型使用相同的输入。在包含1,987个配对一维内爆的数据库上，从无alpha粒子加热的计算中学习到的燃耗加权状态，使全局预测器在随机留出集和设计空间外推上的均方对数响应误差分别降低了60.25%和52.98%。随机投影和打乱状态监督无法复现这些增益。对于CH，匹配输入比较表明，专家模型在较小训练预算下有帮助，但在1,000个设计下使用该表示时贡献甚微。一个热反馈基准验证了完整的学习状态流程，而3,000个新计算的Be/Cocktail设计则暴露出较弱的外推增益以及专家模型降低精度的情形。一个条件状态误差界将编码敏感性与路由效应分离开来。一个开放的Python实现复现了存档的预测结果，并与数据、逐设计结果和测量成本一同发布。因此，物理状态监督是有限数据代理模型的一种有用表示，而专家特化应通过验证来选择。

papers.title: Improved screening of doped ZrO$_2$ catalysts for CO$_2$ hydrogenation from graph-based machine learning
papers.abstract: Dopants can tune the activity of zirconia-based CO$_2$ hydrogenation catalysts through changes in adsorbate and transition-state (TS) energetics. Computing these quantities with density functional theory (DFT) becomes expensive when several dopants, reaction intermediates, and TSs must be screened. Here, we further develop the graph-based machine learning method Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman Gaussian Process Regression (WWL-GPR): we introduce additional electronic-structure and local-environment features relevant for oxide surfaces and use the resulting model to predict adsorption and TS energies on ZrO$_2$(101) surfaces doped with Al$^{3+}$, Cd$^{2+}$, Ga$^{3+}$, In$^{3+}$, and Zn$^{2+}$. Adsorbate-surface structures are represented as attributed graphs that combine bonds connectivity and features. We benchmark WWL-GPR against thermodynamic scaling relations (TSR) for reaction intermediates and Bronsted-Evans-Polanyi relations (BEP) for TSs, and then propagate the predicted energies to microkinetic CH$_3$OH-yield estimates. WWL-GPR consistently improves the prediction of reaction intermediate energetics relative to linear scaling approaches and provides TS estimates that are competitive with BEP-based models. These improvements become especially relevant when the predicted energetics are propagated through the reaction network. Microkinetic calculations show that WWL-GPR-derived energies give CH$_3$OH yields closer to DFT-derived yields than the linear-relation workflow. Degree-of-rate-control analysis links the activity errors to dopant-dependent rate-controlling steps, including HCOO* formation, H$_2$COOH* dissociation, and H$_3$CO* formation. These results support WWL-GPR as a data-efficient surrogate for connecting atomistic energetics with catalyst-screening observables on doped oxide surfaces.
papers.title_cn: 基于图机器学习的掺杂 ZrO$_2$ 催化剂 CO$_2$ 加氢改进筛选
papers.abs_cn: 掺杂剂可以通过改变吸附物和过渡态（TS）能量来调控锆基 CO$_2$ 加氢催化剂的活性。当需要筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体和 TS 时，用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算这些量变得昂贵。在此，我们进一步发展了基于图的机器学习方法 Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman 高斯过程回归（WWL-GPR）：我们引入了与氧化物表面相关的额外电子结构和局域环境特征，并使用所得模型预测掺杂 Al$^{3+}$、Cd$^{2+}$、Ga$^{3+}$、In$^{3+}$ 和 Zn$^{2+}$ 的 ZrO$_2$(101) 表面上的吸附能和 TS 能量。吸附物-表面结构被表示为结合键连接性和特征的属性图。我们将 WWL-GPR 与反应中间体的热力学标度关系（TSR）和 TS 的 Bronsted-Evans-Polanyi 关系（BEP）进行基准比较，然后将预测能量传播到微观动力学 CH$_3$OH 产率估计中。相对于线性标度方法，WWL-GPR 持续改进了反应中间体能量的预测，并提供了与基于 BEP 的模型具有竞争力的 TS 估计。当预测能量通过反应网络传播时，这些改进变得尤为重要。微观动力学计算表明，与线性关系工作流程相比，WWL-GPR 导出的能量给出的 CH$_3$OH 产率更接近 DFT 导出的产率。速率控制度分析将活性误差与掺杂剂依赖的速率控制步骤联系起来，包括 HCOO* 形成、H$_2$COOH* 解离和 H$_3$CO* 形成。这些结果支持 WWL-GPR 作为一种数据高效的代理模型，用于将原子尺度能量与掺杂氧化物表面上的催化剂筛选可观测量联系起来。

papers.title: Arrested phase separation and amorphous patterns in charged binary fluids
papers.abstract: Frustration generated by competing interactions can stabilise patterns with tunable lengthscales which evade indefinite coarsening and macroscopic phase separation. Here we investigate a charged binary fluid in which the tendency toward phase separation is opposed by screened electrostatic repulsion. Combining analytics and numerical simulations, we identify a regime of arrested phase separation characterised by finite-wavelength instability. The resulting states include droplet and labyrinthine phases in two dimensions, and droplets, concentric shells and tubular structures in three dimensions. Surprisingly, some of these structures are amorphous morphologies that emerge reproducibly from different initial conditions. Free-energy estimates suggest that these disordered structures may be thermodynamically stabilised by frustration, rather than being kinetically trapped. Our results identify a simple mechanism through which the competition between phase separation and screened electrostatics can generate equilibrium amorphous microphases with glassy features.
papers.title_cn: 带电二元流体中的受阻相分离与非晶图案
papers.abs_cn: 竞争相互作用产生的阻挫可以稳定具有可调特征长度的图案，这些图案避免了无限粗化和宏观相分离。本文研究了带电二元流体，其中相分离趋势被屏蔽静电排斥所对抗。结合解析与数值模拟，我们识别出一个以有限波长不稳定性为特征的受阻相分离区域。所得状态包括二维中的液滴相和迷宫相，以及三维中的液滴、同心壳层和管状结构。令人惊讶的是，其中一些结构是非晶形貌，能够从不同初始条件中可重复地出现。自由能估计表明，这些无序结构可能因阻挫而在热力学上被稳定，而非被动力学捕获。我们的结果揭示了一种简单机制，通过该机制，相分离与屏蔽静电之间的竞争可以产生具有玻璃态特征的平衡非晶微相。

papers.title: Shear-driven arrest of dip-coating film entrainment
papers.abstract: A plate withdrawn from a bath of partially wetting liquid entrains a film above a critical velocity. Here, we show that this critical threshold can be substantially increased by the presence of a laminar gas flow opposed to the plate velocity that exerts a tangential shear stress on the liquid-gas interface. Using two-phase immiscible Navier-Stokes simulations and confining the gas to a narrow channel, we derive a closed-form expression for the interfacial stress, which combined with lubrication theory relates the thickness of the film and the contact line velocity to the applied shear stress. As the gas velocity is increased, the film thins and the contact line velocity slows down, until the imposed shear overcomes the drag of the moving plate and entrainment is arrested. As in the quiescent case, the velocity mismatch between plate and contact line is independent of the plate velocity and is set by the applied shear alone. We find that one set of varying gas flow simulations, with constant critical plate velocity, therefore determines the critical gas flow for every smaller plate velocity.
papers.title_cn: 剪切驱动的浸涂薄膜夹带抑制
papers.abs_cn: 从部分润湿液体浴中抽出的平板在超过临界速度时会夹带薄膜。在此，我们表明，当存在与平板速度相反的层流气流，在液-气界面上施加切向剪切应力时，这一临界阈值可以大幅提高。利用两相不混溶 Navier-Stokes 模拟，并将气体限制在狭窄通道中，我们推导出界面应力的闭式表达式，结合润滑理论，将薄膜厚度和接触线速度与所施加的剪切应力联系起来。随着气体速度增加，薄膜变薄，接触线速度减慢，直到施加的剪切克服移动平板的阻力，夹带被抑制。与静止情况一样，平板与接触线之间的速度失配与平板速度无关，仅由所施加的剪切决定。我们发现，因此，一组具有恒定临界平板速度的变化气流模拟，可以确定每个更小平板速度下的临界气流。

papers.title: Dislocation mediated twin boundary faceting in $β$-Sn
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs), including twin boundaries (TBs), play a critical role in plastic deformation by interacting with dislocations. The deformation and strengthening mechanisms in $β$-Sn are of significant interest because Sn-based alloys are widely used as solder materials. Recent experiments have shown deformation-induced faceting in $β$-Sn arising from twin-dislocation interactions. Using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations informed by a recently developed machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP), we demonstrate a $\langle c\rangle$ dislocation-absorption mediated faceting reaction along $(301)$ TBs in $β$-Sn in which facet length grows with the number of absorbed dislocations. We show that the predicted facet length is consistent with isotropic elasticity theory only when the disclination character of the asymmetric twin facet is taken into account. We discuss analogies to faceting reactions in other low symmetry metals and hypothesize that the ubiquity of $(301)$ twins in $β$-Sn stems from their ability to grow rapidly through a forest of dislocation obstacles.
papers.title_cn: 位错介导的β-Sn中孪晶界刻面化
papers.abs_cn: 晶界（GBs），包括孪晶界（TBs），通过与位错相互作用在塑性变形中起着关键作用。β-Sn的变形和强化机制引起了广泛关注，因为Sn基合金被广泛用作焊料。最近的实验表明，β-Sn中由孪晶-位错相互作用引起的变形诱导刻面化。利用基于最近开发的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们展示了β-Sn中沿(301) TBs的<c>位错吸收介导的刻面化反应，其中刻面长度随吸收位错数量的增加而增长。我们表明，只有当考虑非对称孪晶刻面的向错特征时，预测的刻面长度才与各向同性弹性理论一致。我们讨论了与其他低对称性金属中刻面化反应的类比，并假设β-Sn中(301)孪晶的普遍性源于它们能够通过位错障碍森林快速生长的能力。

papers.title: Electron-Density-Informed Molecular Property Prediction Using Surrogate Functionals
papers.abstract: Machine learning methods are increasingly used to predict chemical properties directly from the molecular structure to bypass the often prohibitive cost of quantum mechanical calculations. Recent work has shown that including the ground-state electron density as input to the machine learning model can improve accuracy in this setting. This work employs the recent surrogate functional framework originally developed for orbital-free density functional theory and extends it to predicting molecular properties. We show that passing the ground-state density as input to the model, while simultaneously enforcing it to be the minimum of the surrogate functional, surpasses state-of-the-art performance for six out of seven extensive properties of the QM9 dataset. Additionally, the approach shows improved generalization to larger molecules taken from the QM40 dataset. On all extensive properties of both datasets, our approach outperforms models that are informed by the ground-state density but do not enforce the surrogate functional constraints.
papers.title_cn: 基于代理泛函的电子密度信息分子性质预测
papers.abs_cn: 机器学习方法越来越多地被用于直接从分子结构预测化学性质，以绕过量子力学计算往往高昂的成本。近期研究表明，将基态电子密度作为机器学习模型的输入可以提高此类任务的精度。本工作采用了最初为无轨道密度泛函理论开发的代理泛函框架，并将其扩展到分子性质预测。我们表明，将基态密度作为模型输入，同时约束其为代理泛函的最小值，在 QM9 数据集的七个广延性质中有六个超越了当前最优性能。此外，该方法在来自 QM40 数据集的更大分子上展现出更好的泛化能力。在两个数据集的所有广延性质上，我们的方法均优于那些以基态密度为输入但未施加代理泛函约束的模型。

papers.title: Encoding Matters: A Qubit-Efficient Reformulation for Quantum Resilient Routing
papers.abstract: Qubits are powerful computational resources because each additional qubit doubles the size of the accessible state space. This expressive power comes at a cost: adding qubits also increases circuit size, constraint overhead, and exposure to hardware noise. These limitations are especially critical for near-term quantum computers, making the number of qubits required to formulate a problem a central practical concern. In this work, we present a method for efficiently mapping logistics and routing problems onto qubits through structure-aware encoding reduction. We demonstrate the method on a benchmark problem of latency-resilient routing under dual-link failures. For this benchmark, the reduced formulation substantially lowers both the qubit count and the compiled circuit complexity while preserving the original optimization task. By running the reduced model on the same trapped-ion quantum computer as the benchmark, we obtain a 100X improvement in the success probability. This finding shows how careful problem formulation can make current quantum hardware substantially more effective for practical optimization.
papers.title_cn: 编码至关重要：一种量子比特高效的量子弹性路由重构方法
papers.abs_cn: 量子比特是强大的计算资源，因为每增加一个量子比特，可访问状态空间的大小就翻倍。这种表达能力是有代价的：增加量子比特也会增加电路规模、约束开销以及对硬件噪声的暴露。这些限制对于近期量子计算机尤为关键，使得表述一个问题所需的量子比特数量成为核心的实际关切。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种通过结构感知的编码缩减，将物流和路由问题高效映射到量子比特上的方法。我们在双链路故障下延迟弹性路由的基准问题上演示了该方法。对于该基准问题，缩减后的表述在保持原始优化任务的同时，大幅降低了量子比特数量和编译后的电路复杂度。通过在与此基准相同的 trapped-ion 量子计算机上运行缩减后的模型，我们获得了成功概率 100 倍的提升。这一发现表明，精心的问題表述如何能使当前量子硬件在实际优化中显著更加有效。

papers.title: Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Motion, Stability, and Frequency Responses under Different Screening-Charge Conservation Laws
papers.abstract: We analyze ferroelectric domain wall motion, shape, and internal structure arising from coupling between polarization and screening charge. Universal cases are organized by electrical boundary conditions, charge conservation and dynamics, and polarization free energy. We consider exposed surfaces, interfaces beneath a dielectric layer and top electrode, and interfaces with a blocking mixed ionic-electronic conductor. Screening occurs through local exchange, exchange with lateral transport, or strictly conserved redistribution. Analytical derivations and finite-depth calculations establish screening drag, velocity branches, and conditions for spatial instability. For an isolated wall joining differently compensated domains, strict surface conservation and zero far-field current exclude steady translation of the screening profile, while allowing transient displacement, finite-sample arrest, and charge-balanced structural changes. Conservation also constrains long-distance transport around a moving junction in an adjoining conductor. Large-field simulations in the top-electrode geometry reveal nonlinear corrugation, transfer toward longer wavelengths, and coupled polarization rotation. First-order polarization energetics allow two interphase fronts enclosing a paraelectric core; multiaxial polarization permits wall rotation and competing intermediate ferroelectric domains. A driven structural-screening reduction supports stable periodic behavior. Reduced-variable diagrams summarize motion and structural regimes, while BaTiO3 and BiFeO3 examples connect them to material thermodynamics. Small-signal analysis distinguishes displacement, polarization, and electrostatic response functions. These results provide a framework for wall dynamics and structural transitions under different driving and screening conditions.
papers.title_cn: 不同屏蔽电荷守恒律下的铁电畴壁运动、稳定性与频率响应
papers.abs_cn: 我们分析了由极化和屏蔽电荷之间耦合引起的铁电畴壁运动、形状和内部结构。根据电学边界条件、电荷守恒与动力学以及极化自由能，将普遍情形进行了分类。我们考虑了暴露表面、介电层和顶部电极下方的界面，以及与阻塞型混合离子-电子导体的界面。屏蔽通过局部交换、伴随横向输运的交换或严格守恒的再分布发生。解析推导和有限深度计算建立了屏蔽拖曳、速度分支以及空间不稳定性的条件。对于连接不同补偿畴的孤立畴壁，严格的表面守恒和零远场电流排除了屏蔽分布的稳态平移，同时允许瞬态位移、有限样品中的钉扎以及电荷平衡的结构变化。守恒还约束了在相邻导体中移动结周围的长距离输运。顶部电极几何中的大场模拟揭示了非线性褶皱、向更长波长的转移以及耦合的极化旋转。一阶极化能量学允许两个相间前沿包围一个顺电核心；多轴极化允许畴壁旋转和竞争性中间铁电畴。驱动结构-屏蔽约化支持稳定的周期性行为。约化变量图总结了运动和结构区域，而 BaTiO3 和 BiFeO3 示例将它们与材料热力学联系起来。小信号分析区分了位移、极化和静电响应函数。这些结果为不同驱动和屏蔽条件下的畴壁动力学和结构转变提供了一个框架。

papers.title: Efficient Transport Networks through Edge Pruning by Relative Resistance
papers.abstract: Transport networks are key to living and engineered systems. How can transport networks adapt efficiently using only local rules, without a global objective or specific boundary conditions? Inspired by observations in biological transport networks, we adapt networks by subsequently pruning edges by relative resistance, thus removing edges whose resistance is higher than the resistance for routing flow through the rest of the network. We find that adaptation by such a local, boundary-condition-free measure of redundancy, set by topology alone, yields sparse, loop-rich, low-dissipation networks.
papers.title_cn: 通过相对阻力边剪枝实现高效运输网络
papers.abs_cn: 运输网络是生命系统和工程系统的关键。运输网络如何仅使用局部规则，在没有全局目标或特定边界条件的情况下高效适应？受生物运输网络观察的启发，我们通过相对阻力依次剪枝边来适应网络，从而移除那些阻力高于通过网络其余部分路由流量的阻力的边。我们发现，通过这种局部的、无边界条件的冗余度量（仅由拓扑结构决定）进行适应，会产生稀疏、富含环路、低耗散的网络。

papers.title: Giant geometric nonlinear transport in inhomogeneously strained Bi$_2$Se$_3$ single crystalline slabs
papers.abstract: Electrical transport in non-centrosymmetric materials exhibits a nonlinear conductivity tensor component that generates second-harmonic voltages in response to applied electric fields. Harnessing this effect is essential for developing zero-threshold electromagnetic energy harvesters and broadband frequency upconverters, both of which require maximizing the nonlinear responsivity. Here, we demonstrate that inhomogeneously strained macroscopic slabs of the topological insulator Bi$_2$Se$_3$ achieve a record-high nonlinear responsivity of $10^4\,μ$m/V: a six orders of magnitude boost compared to its thin-film counterparts. We attribute this giant enhancement to a classical geometric nonlinear transport effect, which is driven by complex strain gradients within the bulk material. Notably, a similar geometric mechanism known as geometric nonlinear Hall was previously observed only in microscale-patterned structures. Our findings establish macroscopic strain engineering as a powerful route to enhance nonlinear transport, with immediate relevance to a broad class of layered systems, including transition metal dichalcogenides and moiré heterostructures.
papers.title_cn: 非均匀应变 Bi$_2$Se$_3$ 单晶板中的巨大几何非线性输运
papers.abs_cn: 非中心对称材料中的电输运表现出一种非线性电导张量分量，该分量在施加电场时产生二次谐波电压。利用这一效应对于开发零阈值电磁能量收集器和宽带频率上转换器至关重要，而这两者都需要最大化非线性响应度。在此，我们证明，拓扑绝缘体 Bi$_2$Se$_3$ 的非均匀应变宏观板实现了创纪录的高非线性响应度 $10^4\,μ$m/V：与其薄膜对应物相比提升了六个数量级。我们将这一巨大增强归因于经典的几何非线性输运效应，该效应由块体材料内复杂的应变梯度驱动。值得注意的是，一种被称为几何非线性霍尔效应的类似几何机制此前仅在微尺度图案化结构中观察到。我们的发现确立了宏观应变工程作为增强非线性输运的强大途径，并直接适用于广泛的一类层状体系，包括过渡金属二硫属化物和莫尔异质结构。

papers.title: Aubry-André transition in photonic time quasicrystals
papers.abstract: In one dimension, Anderson localization by a disordered potential sets in at any strength, whereas localization by a quasiperiodic potential in the Aubry-André model occurs through a transition at a critical strength. Disordered photonic time crystals exhibit a temporal counterpart of this Anderson localization, in which light, instead of decaying in space, stops propagating and grows in time. Whether a counterpart of the Aubry-André transition exists in photonic time quasicrystals remains an open question. Here we show that it does, and that the transition occurs at mobility edges in momentum rather than in energy. These edges arise even under impulsive modulation, where the field obeys the self-dual almost-Mathieu equation exactly, and for general analytic modulations Avila's global theory reveals the condition under which they form. The Aubry-André transition thus extends from spatial lattices to the time domain, where it sorts light by wave number into components that propagate and components that stop and grow.
papers.title_cn: 光子时间准晶中的 Aubry-André 转变
papers.abs_cn: 在一维中，无序势导致的 Anderson 局域化在任何强度下都会发生，而 Aubry-André 模型中准周期势导致的局域化则通过临界强度处的转变发生。无序光子时间晶体展示了这种 Anderson 局域化的时间对应物，其中光不是在空间中衰减，而是停止传播并随时间增长。光子时间准晶中是否存在 Aubry-André 转变的对应物仍是一个未决问题。在这里，我们证明它确实存在，并且该转变发生在动量而非能量中的迁移率边处。这些边甚至会在脉冲调制下出现，此时场精确满足自对偶 almost-Mathieu 方程；对于一般解析调制，Avila 的全局理论揭示了它们形成的条件。因此，Aubry-André 转变从空间晶格扩展到时间域，在那里它按波数将光分选为传播的分量和停止并增长的分量。

papers.title: How Fluctuations Control Chiral Symmetry Breaking in Reacting Mixtures of Chiral Molecules
papers.abstract: The pronounced chiral asymmetry of biomolecules is a defining feature of living systems, yet the mechanisms by which such asymmetry emerged remain unresolved. Chiral symmetry breaking may have occurred under prebiotic conditions in systems with sufficiently small molecular populations for intrinsic fluctuations to play an important role. Here, we investigate how finite-population fluctuations affect chiral-state selection, the characteristic time for symmetry breaking, and stochastic switching between chiral states in a system driven by autocatalysis and mutual antagonism. We determine how these dynamical processes scale with particle number and derive an analytical expression for the probability of selecting either chiral state as a function of the initial enantiomeric bias. We further calculate the mean selection time for different initial biases and show that, for weak mutual antagonism, fluctuations can induce transitions between opposite chiral states. These results characterize how finite-population fluctuations control both the emergence and stability of molecular chirality in autocatalytic chemical systems.
papers.title_cn: 波动如何控制手性分子反应混合物中的手性对称性破缺
papers.abs_cn: 生物分子显著的手性不对称性是生命系统的一个决定性特征，然而这种不对称性产生的机制仍未得到解决。手性对称性破缺可能发生在生命起源前的条件下，在分子数量足够小以至于内禀波动起重要作用的系统中。在这里，我们研究了有限种群波动如何影响手性态选择、对称性破缺的特征时间，以及在自催化和相互拮抗驱动的系统中手性态之间的随机切换。我们确定了这些动力学过程如何随粒子数缩放，并推导了选择任一 hinged 手性态的概率作为初始对映体偏置函数的解析表达式。我们进一步计算了不同初始偏置下的平均选择时间，并表明对于弱相互拮抗，波动可以诱导相反手性态之间的转变。这些结果刻画了有限种群波动如何控制自催化化学系统中分子手性的出现和稳定性。

papers.title: Latin squares as a model of perfect mixing of high-entropy alloys
papers.abstract: The structure of high-entropy alloys, which include 5 or more components in equimolar proportions, is proposed to be described in the mathematical language of Latin squares. This model is fundamentally discrete and allows for a quantitative description of ideal mixing, in which any given alloy element is guaranteed not to have an identical element as its nearest neighbor. For the two-dimensional case, the model possesses four axes of translational symmetry, which makes it possible to tile the plane with a single Latin square and, based on the properties of this square, describe the properties of macroscopic material samples. The model makes it possible to make quantitative estimates of the suitability of a particular atomic structure (configuration) for implementation in a perfectly mixed high-entropy alloy with maximum mixing entropy. A condition has been obtained for acceptable fluctuations in the concentration of components at which the thermodynamic stability of the alloy is maintained. The possibility of identifying superstructures in high-entropy alloys based on group theory, as applied to the description and construction of Latin squares, is discussed. Based on the proposed model, the probability of forming a multicomponent alloy with ideal mixing is estimated. For a five-component alloy, this probability is no more than 2.6*10^{-10}.
papers.title_cn: 拉丁方作为高熵合金完美混合的模型
papers.abs_cn: 本文提出用拉丁方的数学语言来描述高熵合金的结构，这类合金包含5种或更多以等摩尔比例存在的组分。该模型本质上是离散的，能够对理想混合进行定量描述，其中任意给定合金元素保证其最近邻不是同种元素。对于二维情形，该模型具有四个平移对称轴，这使得可以用单个拉丁方铺砌平面，并基于该方的性质来描述宏观材料样品的性质。该模型能够定量评估特定原子结构（构型）在具有最大混合熵的完美混合高熵合金中实现的适用性。文中获得了组分浓度可接受涨落的条件，在此条件下合金的热力学稳定性得以保持。讨论了基于群论识别高熵合金中超结构的可能性，并将其应用于拉丁方的描述和构造。基于所提出的模型，估算了形成具有理想混合的多组分合金的概率。对于五组分合金，该概率不超过2.6*10^{-10}。

papers.title: Energy-dependent trapping of backscattered helium during magnetron sputtering growth: A molecular dynamics study
papers.abstract: Helium incorporation during magnetron sputtering can strongly affect thin film growth and lead to the formation of gas/solid nanocomposites and nanoporous structures. Here, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are used to investigate the trapping mechanism of helium atoms (He) and the subsequent formation of He bubbles during the sputter deposition of aluminum (Al) and titanium (Ti) thin films. The simulations account for the kinetic energy distributions of sputtered metal atoms and backscattered gas species. Results indicate that He is efficiently incorporated into the growing films, leading to the formation of high-pressure, dense He bubbles, with a much higher He-to-metal atomic ratio in Ti ($\sim$ 60%) than in Al ($\sim$ 12%). More importantly, the simulations reveal a clear energy dependence of He trapping in Ti: background He atoms at thermal energies are essentially not incorporated, whereas efficient trapping starts at an incident energy of approximately 20 eV and increases up to a saturation regime near 100 eV. Simulated thermal desorption spectroscopy (TDS) further reveals distinct release mechanisms in the two investigated metals: He desorption from Al occurs at higher temperatures and is preceded by the removal of surface Al atoms, whereas He and Ti atom desorption starts continuously around 950 K, leading to a porous structure. Comparative simulations with argon (Ar) demonstrate negligible trapping even at comparable kinetic energy or momentum, showing that neither parameter alone accounts for the strong He incorporation observed in Ti. The above results are in very good agreement with what is reported in literature for low-kinetic energy He ion implantation in metal surfaces, suggesting similar insertion mechanisms. They clarify the atomistic conditions governing noble gas trapping during film growth and provide a basis for controlling He incorporation and porosity in films synthesized by magnetron sputtering.
papers.title_cn: 磁控溅射生长过程中背散射氦的能量依赖性捕获：分子动力学研究
papers.abs_cn: 磁控溅射过程中的氦掺入会强烈影响薄膜生长，并导致气/固纳米复合材料和纳米多孔结构的形成。本文采用分子动力学（MD）模拟研究了铝（Al）和钛（Ti）薄膜溅射沉积过程中氦原子（He）的捕获机制以及随后He气泡的形成。模拟考虑了溅射金属原子和背散射气体物种的动能分布。结果表明，He被高效地掺入生长薄膜中，形成高压、致密的He气泡，且Ti中的He与金属原子比（约60%）远高于Al（约12%）。更重要的是，模拟揭示了Ti中He捕获具有明显的能量依赖性：处于热能背景的He原子基本不被掺入，而有效捕获从入射能量约20 eV开始，并在接近100 eV时增至饱和状态。模拟的热脱附谱（TDS）进一步揭示了两种金属中不同的释放机制：Al中He的脱附发生在较高温度，且先于表面Al原子的移除；而He和Ti原子的脱附在约950 K附近持续开始，导致多孔结构的形成。与氩（Ar）的对比模拟表明，即使在相当的动能或动量下，Ar的捕获也可忽略不计，说明单一参数均无法解释Ti中观察到的强He掺入。上述结果与文献中关于低动能He离子注入金属表面的报道非常吻合，表明存在相似的插入机制。这些结果阐明了薄膜生长过程中惰性气体捕获的原子尺度条件，并为控制磁控溅射合成薄膜中的He掺入和孔隙率提供了基础。

papers.title: The effects of non-stoichiometric lattice structure and secondary phase α-Fe2O3 on modifying the magnetic, electrical, and magneto-electric properties of Eu doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrite
papers.abstract: The Ba-atoms in BaFe12O19 were substituted by Eu-atoms to prepare the material of composition Ba1-xEuyFe12O19. The Eu atoms occupied at the sites of Fe atoms. The atomic ratio of Eu/Ba were varied from 0 to 0.33 to control the secondary phase (hematite) and M-type hexaferrite. Raman spectra provided complimentary support for a systematic increase of the hematite phase on increasing the Eu/Ba ratio. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy informed the presence of oxygen deficiency and surface defects, and charge state of Ba and Fe/Eu ions close to +2 and +3, respectively. The material showed direct optical transitions with band gap in the range of 2.25-3.09 eV. The increase of Eu/Ba ratio systematically increased the saturation magnetization from 84.44 emu g-1 to 57.68 emu g-1 at 3 K and 67.09 emu g-1 to 43.42 emu g-1 at 300 K, along with remarkable enhancement of the coercivity (914- 3656 Oe at 3 K and 1996-4862 Oe at 300 K). Electrical conductivity increased from 10-11-10-10 Sm-1 at 30 K to 10-5 -10-4 Sm-1 at 300 K. The electrical conductivity analysis reveals the Efros-Shklovsky-type variable-range hopping mechanism at the low-temperature region, whereas the Mott variable range hopping mechanism is applicable near to room temperature. The analysis of current-voltage characteristics provided electrode to sample interfacial barrier height of 0.27-0.74 eV. The material exhibited novel magneto-electronic properties (bi-stable electronic switching and its transformation in the temperature scale, magnetoresistance and magnetoelectric coupling) which are highly useful for spintronic devices. This work demonstrates that controlled Eu/Ba atomic ratio in the stoichiometric and non-stoichiometric lattice structure could be an effective strategy to widely tune the magnetic, optical and magneto-electronic properties in M-type Ba hexaferrite material.
papers.title_cn: 非化学计量晶格结构和二次相 alpha-Fe2O3 对改性 Eu 掺杂 BaFe12O19 六方铁氧体的磁、电和磁电性能的影响
papers.abs_cn: 通过用 Eu 原子取代 BaFe12O19 中的 Ba 原子，制备了组成为 Ba1-xEuyFe12O19 的材料。Eu 原子占据 Fe 原子的位置。Eu/Ba 原子比在 0 至 0.33 之间变化，以调控二次相（赤铁矿）和 M 型六方铁氧体。拉曼光谱为赤铁矿相随 Eu/Ba 比增加而系统增加提供了补充支持。X 射线光电子能谱表明存在氧空位和表面缺陷，并且 Ba 和 Fe/Eu 离子的电荷态分别接近 +2 和 +3。该材料表现出直接光学跃迁，带隙在 2.25-3.09 eV 范围内。Eu/Ba 比的增加使饱和磁化强度在 3 K 时从 84.44 emu g-1 系统增加到 57.68 emu g-1，在 300 K 时从 67.09 emu g-1 增加到 43.42 emu g-1，同时矫顽力显著增强（3 K 时为 914-3656 Oe，300 K 时为 1996-4862 Oe）。电导率从 30 K 时的 10-11-10-10 Sm-1 增加到 300 K 时的 10-5-10-4 Sm-1。电导率分析揭示了低温区域为 Efros-Shklovsky 型变程跳跃机制，而 Mott 变程跳跃机制适用于接近室温时。电流-电压特性分析提供了电极与样品之间的界面势垒高度为 0.27-0.74 eV。该材料表现出新颖的磁电子性能（双稳态电子开关及其在温度尺度上的转变、磁阻和磁电耦合），这些性能对自旋电子器件非常有用。这项工作表明，在化学计量和非化学计量晶格结构中控制 Eu/Ba 原子比可能是广泛调控 M 型 Ba 六方铁氧体材料磁、光和磁电子性能的有效策略。

papers.title: A new device for live cell imaging of biological samples under in-plane shear
papers.abstract: The effect of mechanical stresses and deformations upon the behavior and properties of cells and tissues is a topic of paramount interest in the field of biophysics. Its understanding is essential for deepening our comprehension of cellular responses to environmental stimuli, with implications in fields ranging from embryogenesis to tumor development. For boosting the understanding in this field, it is important to develop devices for the application of simple deformations in order to probe the cellular response to the basic mechanical transformations. While a number of stretching devices have been developed, in-plane shearing deformation has been little investigated. Here, a new device is introduced that allows the application of homogeneous in-plane shear upon a cell monolayer while imaging the sample with a commercial optical microscope. A description of the faced experimental challenges is reported and a full characterization is presented. It is demonstrated the capability of the device to apply reproducible, controlled and homogeneous shear of both single cells and confluent cellular monolayers.
papers.title_cn: 一种用于在面内剪切下对生物样品进行活细胞成像的新装置
papers.abs_cn: 机械应力和变形对细胞与组织行为及性质的影响是生物物理学领域极为关注的主题。理解这一主题对于加深我们对细胞响应环境刺激的认识至关重要，其意义涵盖从胚胎发生到肿瘤发展的多个领域。为推动该领域的理解，开发能够施加简单变形的装置以探究细胞对基本机械转变的响应十分重要。尽管已开发出多种拉伸装置，但面内剪切变形的研究却很少。本文介绍了一种新装置，该装置能够在用商用光学显微镜对样品成像的同时，对细胞单层施加均匀的面内剪切。文中报告了所面临的实验挑战，并给出了完整的表征。结果证明了该装置能够对单细胞和汇合细胞单层施加可重复、可控且均匀的剪切。

papers.title: Controlling the Atomic Reconstruction in Twisted MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ with a Monolayer hBN Spacer
papers.abstract: Twisted van der Waals heterobilayers are a promising material platform for studying collective exciton many-body phenomena, but near-aligned structures often exhibit a local, anisotropic atomic reconstruction that compromises lateral homogeneity. The present study describes how atomic-scale rearrangement in adjacent regions of hBN-encapsulated, near-aligned MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers is controlled by the presence of a mono- or bilayer hBN spacer between the two monolayers. High-angle annular dark-field STEM directly resolves the atomic alignment in both layers and shows that the spacer suppresses the reconstruction and strongly increases the structural uniformity of the heterobilayers. 4D-STEM quantitatively maps local rotation, dilation, and heterostrain, revealing that the separated regions remain consistent with rigid moiré superlattice simulations, whereas without the spacer the structural parameters have two to three times broader distributions. By suppressing reconstruction, ultrathin hBN spacers therefore provide an effective route to enhance lattice homogeneity in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers targeting collective excitonic and optoelectronic phenomena.
papers.title_cn: 利用单层 hBN 隔离层控制扭转 MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ 中的原子重构
papers.abs_cn: 扭转范德华异质双层是研究集体激子多体现象的有前景的材料平台，但近对齐结构通常表现出局域的各向异性原子重构，从而损害了横向均匀性。本研究描述了 hBN 封装的近对齐 MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ 异质双层中相邻区域的原子尺度重排如何受两层单层之间单层或双层 hBN 隔离层的存在所控制。高角环形暗场 STEM 直接分辨了两层中的原子排列，并表明隔离层抑制了重构并显著提高了异质双层的结构均匀性。4D-STEM 定量映射了局部旋转、膨胀和异质应变，揭示出分离区域与刚性莫尔超晶格模拟保持一致，而在没有隔离层的情况下，结构参数的分布要宽两到三倍。因此，通过抑制重构，超薄 hBN 隔离层为提高面向集体激子和光电子现象的 MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ 异质双层的晶格均匀性提供了一条有效途径。

papers.title: Unveiling the Influence of Graphitic Nanocarbon Structures, Defects, and Surface Functional Groups on Supercapacitive Performance in LiTFSI Electrolyte
papers.abstract: When investigating the performance of supercapacitors (SCs), it was found that they offer high-power density and long life but are limited in capacity and energy density. Water-in-salt electrolytes, i.e., 21___m lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl) imide (LiTFSI), offer a solution by expanding the electrochemical window compared to a diluted aqueous environment. While significant research has been dedicated to improving these electrolytes, the impact of carbon properties on energy storage remains relatively underexplored. This study investigated the influence of carbon structures, defects, and surface functional groups on supercapacitive performance in LiTFSI electrolytes. For this purpose, a series of carbon materials, including carbon nano-onions and porous conductive carbon black (ENSACO), were synthesized and systematically modified by oxidative and reductive thermal treatments. Our results indicated that higher specific surface area and active surface area improve the ion adsorption and capacitance, while specific oxygen functionalities, such as carboxylic and anhydride groups, were found to significantly enhance capacitance. Furthermore, crystallinity and graphitic characteristics play a role in capacitance, with smaller graphene domains and greater disorder promoting ion storage. The study demonstrates a direct correlation between carbon microstructure and electrochemical behavior, providing insights into the rational design of carbon electrodes in high-performance SCs.
papers.title_cn: 揭示石墨纳米碳结构、缺陷和表面官能团对LiTFSI电解液中超级电容性能的影响
papers.abs_cn: 在研究超级电容器（SCs）的性能时，发现它们具有高功率密度和长寿命，但容量和能量密度有限。盐包水电解质，即21 m 双(三氟甲磺酰)亚胺锂（LiTFSI），通过扩大电化学窗口相比稀释水环境提供了一种解决方案。虽然已有大量研究致力于改进这些电解质，但碳性质对能量存储的影响仍然相对未被充分探索。本研究探讨了碳结构、缺陷和表面官能团对LiTFSI电解质中超级电容性能的影响。为此，合成了一系列碳材料，包括碳纳米洋葱和多孔导电炭黑（ENSACO），并通过氧化和还原热处理进行了系统改性。我们的结果表明，更高的比表面积和活性表面积改善了离子吸附和电容，而特定的含氧官能团，如羧基和酸酐基团，被发现能显著增强电容。此外，结晶度和石墨特性在电容中起作用，较小的石墨烯域和更大的无序度促进了离子存储。该研究展示了碳微观结构与电化学行为之间的直接相关性，为高性能SCs中碳电极的合理设计提供了见解。

papers.title: Magnetic-field-induced detwinning of orientational domains in altermagnet $α$-MnTe: A single-crystal neutron diffraction study
papers.abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, which makes them promising for future spintronic and magnonic applications, but their macroscopic responses can be strongly reduced by domain averaging. In hexagonal $α$-MnTe, three symmetry-related in-plane Néel-vector orientations and their time-reversal counterparts form six magnetic domain states, complicating both magnetic structure determination and measurements of the chiral magnon response. Using single-crystal neutron diffraction, we show that an in-plane field applied along the $[-1,1,0]$ direction produces a common magnetic domain orientation that saturates near $μ_0H=2$ T. A constrained refinement of 61 nuclear and magnetic reflections collected at 2 K and 2 T yields $\mathbf{M}\parallel[1,1,0]$, an ordered moment of $4.62(8)~μ_\mathrm{B}$ per Mn, and an orientational domain population at $r_A:r_B:r_C=0.97:0.03(5):0$ that is compatible with a nearly complete alignment of orientational domains. Furthermore, an abnormal behaviour in the temperature dependence of the selected reflections is observed in 60-88 K, its microscopic origin is discussed within the context of possible intrinsic piezomagnetic or magnetoelastic effects. Because unpolarized diffraction neither distinguishes domain repopulation from continuous Néel-vector rotation nor resolves time-reversal antiphase domains, the field-prepared state is a near-single-orientation state rather than a truly single-domain state. This non-contact domain control provides a practical complement to strain and field-cooling approaches for preparing well-defined magnetic states in bulk $α$-MnTe.
papers.title_cn: 磁场诱导交错磁体 alpha-MnTe 中取向畴的去孪化：单晶中子衍射研究
papers.abs_cn: 交错磁体兼具补偿磁序与动量依赖的自旋劈裂，这使其在未来的自旋电子学和磁子学应用中颇具前景，但其宏观响应可能因畴平均而显著减弱。在六方 alpha-MnTe 中，三个对称相关的面内 Néel 矢量取向及其时间反演对应态构成六种磁畴态，这使磁结构测定和手性磁子响应的测量变得复杂。利用单晶中子衍射，我们表明沿 [-1,1,0] 方向施加的面内磁场会产生一种共同的磁畴取向，并在 μ0H=2 T 附近饱和。对在 2 K 和 2 T 下收集的 61 个核反射和磁反射进行约束精修，得到 M || [1,1,0]、每个 Mn 的有序磁矩为 4.62(8) μB，以及取向畴布居 r_A:r_B:r_C=0.97:0.03(5):0，这与取向畴几乎完全排列一致。此外，在 60-88 K 范围内观察到所选反射的温度依赖性出现异常行为，并在可能的本征压磁或磁弹性效应的背景下讨论了其微观起源。由于非极化衍射既不能区分畴重新布居与连续的 Néel 矢量旋转，也不能分辨时间反演反相畴，因此该场制备态是近单一取向态，而非真正的单畴态。这种非接触式畴控制为在块体 alpha-MnTe 中制备明确磁态提供了一种实用补充，可弥补应变和场冷方法的不足。

papers.title: Implementation and verification of a new free boundary module for Resistive Wall Modes simulations with the nonlinear 3D full MHD code SpeCyl
papers.abstract: Self-consistent numerical simulations of free boundary instabilities, such as resistive wall modes (RWMs) and external kink modes, require special attention given their relevance on the path towards magnetic fusion based nuclear reactors. In this work, a new implementation and a verification benchmark are presented for the nonlinear three-dimensional (3D) full magneto-hydrodynamics (MHD) code SpeCyl, which self-consistently combines a free flow 3D treatment for the edge plasma velocity with double resistive wall thin shell magnetic boundary conditions, capable of capturing the essential features of common setups in experimental devices. Two coaxial resistive shells surround the plasma. Vacuum conditions are assumed between and outside the resistive shells, whose relative positions and time constants can be varied on purpose. The implementation is extensively verified against Shafranov's analytic theory, valid for a circular cross section large aspect ratio tokamak and assuming a flat current profile. The correctness of newly implemented Boundary Conditions (BCs) is confirmed by the good agreement obtained for the linear growth rates of (m=2,n=1) RWM and external kink, over a wide range of wall positions, resistive shell time constants, and for different initial reference equilibria. The (m=2,n=1) RWM growth rates are also benchmarked against previous different RWMs modelling and successful validation studies for RFX-mod tokamak plasmas. The new BCs make SpeCyl a flexible and robust tool to investigate free boundary MHD modes in large aspect ratio magnetic confinement configurations, such as those achieved with the RFX-mod machine and expected in RFX-mod2.
papers.title_cn: 用于电阻壁模式模拟的新自由边界模块在非线性三维全MHD代码SpeCyl中的实现与验证
papers.abs_cn: 自由边界不稳定性（如电阻壁模式（RWMs）和外扭曲模）的自洽数值模拟，鉴于其在通往磁聚变核反应堆道路上的重要性，需要特别关注。在这项工作中，针对非线性三维（3D）全磁流体动力学（MHD）代码SpeCyl，提出了一种新的实现和验证基准，该代码自洽地将边缘等离子体速度的自由流动3D处理与双电阻壁薄壳磁边界条件相结合，能够捕捉实验装置中常见设置的基本特征。两个同轴电阻壳围绕等离子体。在电阻壳之间和外部假定为真空条件，其相对位置和时间常数可以有意变化。该实现针对Shafranov的解析理论进行了广泛验证，该理论适用于圆形截面大纵横比托卡马克并假设平坦电流剖面。新实现的边界条件（BCs）的正确性通过（m=2,n=1）RWM和外扭曲模的线性增长率在广泛的壁位置、电阻壳时间常数范围内以及不同初始参考平衡下获得良好一致性得到确认。（m=2,n=1）RWM增长率还与先前不同的RWMs建模以及针对RFX-mod托卡马克等离子体的成功验证研究进行了基准测试。新的边界条件使SpeCyl成为研究大纵横比磁约束配置中自由边界MHD模式的灵活而稳健的工具，例如RFX-mod机器所实现的以及RFX-mod2中预期的那些。

papers.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
papers.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. These predictions accurately reproduce edge morphology, linewidth variations, and defect probabilities observed in fabricated samples, enabling statistical analysis of milling performance and the identification of dominant structural and process parameter-dependent deformation modes. The work establishes a probabilistic modelling framework for fabrication variability analysis and fabrication-aware design optimization.
papers.title_cn: 预测纳米加工偏差：一种条件扩散模型
papers.abs_cn: 通过聚焦离子束（FIB）铣削加工的微纳结构，由于烧蚀速率波动和再沉积等系统性和随机性效应，总是偏离输入设计。因此，给定工艺的名义相同迭代会产生非相同加工结果的分布，导致所加工结构的物理（光学、机械）性质发生变化。现有的铣削过程模型通常预测单一的确定性加工结果，忽略了这种变异性。在此，我们提出了一种条件扩散模型，该模型学习以输入设计为条件的工艺结果的统计分布，使其能够预测可能的输出样品结构的真实分布。这些预测准确再现了加工样品中观察到的边缘形貌、线宽变化和缺陷概率，从而能够对铣削性能进行统计分析，并识别主导的结构和工艺参数相关的变形模式。这项工作为加工变异性分析和加工感知设计优化建立了一个概率建模框架。

papers.title: VN-GraphGG: von Neumann--Mullins--based graph grain growth simulation
papers.abstract: Efficient simulations of grain growth are essential for investigating the process-structure-property relationships in polycrystalline materials. We introduce a two-dimensional von Neumann-Mullins-based graph grain growth simulation (VN-GraphGG), which couples the grain-scale kinetics with microstructure reconstruction. The polycrystalline microstructure is represented as a graph with grain and junction nodes. The grain-area evolution on the grain graph is governed by the von Neumann--Mullins (VN) law, while a graph neural network is trained to reconstruct the microstructure from the graph. This separation allows kinetic coefficients to be varied without retraining the neural reconstruction model. Topological changes during grain growth such as disappearance of grains and changes in neighbor relations are handled straightforwardly through reconstruction and postprocessing. Simulations demonstrate accurate predictions of VN kinetics and coarsening statistics, and significant speedup over the phase-field simulations. The proposed method provides a foundation for efficient grain growth simulation based on grain-scale kinetics, opening the way to incorporate a broader range of physical mechanisms. An application example is presented for abnormal grain growth, in which kinetic heterogeneity significantly influences the grain microstructure evolution.
papers.title_cn: VN-GraphGG：基于 von Neumann-Mullins 的图晶粒生长模拟
papers.abs_cn: 晶粒生长的高效模拟对于研究多晶材料中的过程-结构-性能关系至关重要。我们提出了一种二维的基于 von Neumann-Mullins 的图晶粒生长模拟（VN-GraphGG），它将晶粒尺度的动力学与微观结构重建耦合起来。多晶微观结构被表示为具有晶粒节点和结点节点的图。晶粒图上的晶粒面积演化由 von Neumann-Mullins（VN）定律控制，同时训练图神经网络从该图重建微观结构。这种分离允许在不重新训练神经重建模型的情况下改变动力学系数。晶粒生长过程中的拓扑变化，如晶粒消失和邻接关系变化，通过重建和后处理直接处理。模拟表明，该方法能够准确预测 VN 动力学和粗化统计，并且相比相场模拟具有显著加速。所提出的方法为基于晶粒尺度动力学的高效晶粒生长模拟提供了基础，为纳入更广泛的物理机制开辟了道路。文中给出了一个异常晶粒生长的应用示例，其中动力学异质性显著影响晶粒微观结构演化。

papers.title: Quantitative Eshelby stability: local and finite-shape theory through AI-assisted mechanics
papers.abstract: How can human researchers use artificial intelligence (AI) to make progress on difficult mechanics problems while retaining control of physical significance, mathematical rigor, and validation? We explore this opportunity through a quantitative stability problem rooted in the Eshelby conjecture. For a uniform dilatational eigenstrain in a homogeneous isotropic solid, we establish a nonlinear two-sided relation between whole-interior strain heterogeneity and a geometry-only distance from the ellipsoid family, with half-order Sobolev scaling that captures morphological length scale. We then develop a complementary finite-shape theory: ellipsoidal subtraction yields an exact residual-field budget from which systematically convergent upper and lower bounds are obtained for a prescribed geometry. Applied to protruded, indented, and necked inclusions, the bounds agree with independent displacement-based finite-element calculations. The study also documents a human-led, AI-assisted research process in which researchers select consequential problems, shape targets, audit arguments, require independent checks, and interpret mechanics, while AI broadens analytical exploration and supports computation. This experience also led us to develop Open Problems in Mechanics, a versioned community-facing map that makes selected mechanics questions, their known/open boundaries, and criteria for progress explicit.
papers.title_cn: 定量 Eshelby 稳定性：通过 AI 辅助力学建立的局部与有限形状理论
papers.abs_cn: 人类研究者如何利用人工智能（AI）在困难的力学问题上取得进展，同时保持对物理意义、数学严谨性和验证的控制？我们通过一个根植于 Eshelby 猜想的定量稳定性问题来探索这一机会。对于均匀各向同性固体中的均匀膨胀本征应变，我们建立了内部整体应变非均匀性与仅由几何决定的到椭球族距离之间的非线性双边关系，其半阶 Sobolev 标度捕捉了形态长度尺度。随后我们发展了一个互补的有限形状理论：椭球减除产生精确的剩余场收支，由此对给定几何获得系统收敛的上界和下界。应用于凸出、凹陷和颈缩夹杂时，这些界与独立的基于位移的有限元计算一致。该研究还记录了一个人类主导、AI 辅助的研究过程，其中研究者选择重要问题、设定目标、审查论证、要求独立检验并解释力学，而 AI 拓宽了解析探索并支持计算。这一经验还促使我们开发了 Open Problems in Mechanics，一个面向社区的版本化地图，使选定的力学问题、其已知/开放边界以及进展标准变得明确。

papers.title: Global Optimization of Beam Profiles for Suppressing the Bump-On-Tail Instability
papers.abstract: A particle beam with constant intensity that propagates into a plasma triggers a bump-on-tail instability. It has been demonstrated that beam modulation can be used to significantly reduce this instability. However, finding the optimal beam profiles that accomplish this is a complex optimization problem that suffers from an extremely rugged optimization landscape and a relatively high-dimensional parameter space. In this paper, we evaluate a number of optimization algorithms and find that population based methods (in particular, CMA-ES and Differential Evolution) perform best. In particular, we investigate beam profiles where the beam is either completely turned ON or OFF. This configuration is easier to accomplish experimentally, but leads to a higher-dimensional and thus more challenging optimization problem. We obtain ON/OFF beam profiles that reduce the instability by more than 80% and thus perform significantly better than what has been reported in the literature.
papers.title_cn: 抑制尾隆不稳定性的束流剖面全局优化
papers.abs_cn: 一束恒定强度的粒子束传播进入等离子体时会触发尾隆不稳定性。已有研究表明，束流调制可以显著降低这种不稳定性。然而，寻找实现这一目标的最优束流剖面是一个复杂的优化问题，其优化景观极其崎岖，且参数空间维度相对较高。本文评估了多种优化算法，发现基于种群的算法（特别是 CMA-ES 和差分进化）表现最佳。我们特别研究了束流完全开启或关闭的束流剖面。这种配置在实验上更容易实现，但会导致更高维、因而更具挑战性的优化问题。我们获得了可将不稳定性降低 80% 以上的 ON/OFF 束流剖面，因此其性能显著优于文献中已报道的结果。

papers.title: MORAD: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Objective Rewards for RNA Inverse Design
papers.abstract: We introduce MORAD, an online reinforcement learning framework for backbone-conditioned RNA diffusion models that trains a single shared policy across diverse target backbones. Structure-conditioned RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences compatible with a target three-dimensional backbone, yet existing reinforcement learning approaches either optimize a separate policy for each target backbone or rely on offline preference optimization, leaving online post-training of a reusable backbone-conditioned model largely unexplored. MORAD combines backbone-conditioned group sampling, group-relative reward normalization, and a forward-process diffusion objective. Beyond existing RL rewards that primarily target tertiary structural quality, MORAD jointly optimizes six measurements spanning tertiary geometry, base pairing, ensemble behavior, and sequence composition. To aggregate these heterogeneous objectives despite differences in scale and optimization direction, MORAD maps each measurement to a bounded desirability score and combines them with a weighted geometric mean. Compared with a tertiary-structure-only reward, this multi-objective formulation improves 10 of the 11 evaluation metrics that have a preferred direction. Applied to pretrained RIDE, MORAD improves GDT-TS by 16.0% (from 0.3300 to 0.3827) and pairing MCC by 19.4% (from 0.6110 to 0.7295), while reducing normalized ensemble defect by 27.5% (from 0.3906 to 0.2830). On the test set, MORAD outperforms RiboDiffusion, gRNAde, and RDesign across tertiary structural accuracy, secondary-structure pairing, and thermodynamic quality, establishing a new state of the art in structure-conditioned RNA inverse design.
papers.title_cn: MORAD：面向RNA逆向设计的多目标奖励强化学习
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出MORAD，一个用于骨架条件RNA扩散模型的在线强化学习框架，可在多种目标骨架上训练单一共享策略。结构条件RNA逆向设计旨在寻找与目标三维骨架兼容的核苷酸序列，然而现有的强化学习方法要么为每个目标骨架单独优化策略，要么依赖离线偏好优化，使得可复用的骨架条件模型的在线后训练在很大程度上尚未被探索。MORAD结合了骨架条件分组采样、组相对奖励归一化和前向过程扩散目标。除了主要针对三级结构质量的现有RL奖励之外，MORAD联合优化涵盖三级几何、碱基配对、系综行为和序列组成的六项测量。为了在尺度和优化方向存在差异的情况下聚合这些异构目标，MORAD将每项测量映射为有界合意性得分，并通过加权几何平均将其组合。与仅针对三级结构的奖励相比，这种多目标公式在11个具有偏好方向的评估指标中改善了10个。应用于预训练的RIDE时，MORAD将GDT-TS提高了16.0%（从0.3300到0.3827），将配对MCC提高了19.4%（从0.6110到0.7295），同时将归一化系综缺陷降低了27.5%（从0.3906到0.2830）。在测试集上，MORAD在三级结构精度、二级结构配对和热力学质量方面优于RiboDiffusion、gRNAde和RDesign，确立了结构条件RNA逆向设计的新技术水平。

papers.title: Quantum dynamics of an ion in an RF quadrupole trap with weak octupolar anharmonicity
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum dynamics of a single ion confined in a radio-frequency (RF) Paul trap in the presence of weak octupole-induced anharmonicity, as can occur in realistic ion-trap potential. The explicitly time-dependent quadrupole potential is treated in a reference-oscillator Fock basis, allowing the effects of the RF drive and the quartic correction to be resolved directly at the level of motional-state couplings. While the quadratic RF interaction generates $Δn=\pm2$ transitions and Gaussian squeezing, the quartic contribution opens additional $Δn=\pm4$ coupling pathways. Starting from the reference-oscillator vacuum, we show that the octupole interaction broadens the even-parity Fock-state distribution and enhances the phonon-number fluctuations more strongly than the mean occupation. At the same time, the RF-induced sub-vacuum quadrature squeezing remains robust, although its magnitude and orientation are modified by the quartic interaction. The number statistics and quadrature fluctuations therefore respond differently to the same nonlinear perturbation, reflecting the distinct roles of Fock-space redistribution and phase coherence. The resulting dynamics provide a quantum-mechanical characterization of weak octupole corrections beyond the ideal quadrupole approximation and clarify how realistic anharmonicities modify nonclassical trapped-ion motion. Importantly, the motional nonclassicality remains robust against the weak octupole perturbation, as evidenced by persistent sub-vacuum quadrature squeezing and Klyshko-inequality violation. These results characterize how realistic anharmonic corrections reshape trapped-ion motion beyond the ideal quadrupole approximation.
papers.title_cn: 具有弱八极非谐性的射频四极阱中离子的量子动力学
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了在射频（RF）Paul阱中单个离子在弱八极诱导非谐性存在下的量子动力学，这种非谐性可能出现在实际的离子阱势中。显式含时的四极势在参考振子Fock基中处理，使得RF驱动和四次修正的效应可以直接在运动态耦合层面上被分辨。二次RF相互作用产生 $Δn=\pm2$ 跃迁和高斯压缩，而四次贡献打开了额外的 $Δn=\pm4$ 耦合通道。从参考振子真空态出发，我们表明八极相互作用展宽了偶宇称Fock态分布，并且对声子数涨落的增强比对平均占据数的增强更为显著。同时，RF诱导的亚真空正交压缩仍然稳健，尽管其幅度和方向被四次相互作用修改。因此，粒子数统计和正交涨落对同一非线性微扰的响应不同，反映了Fock空间重新分布和相位相干性的不同作用。由此产生的动力学为超越理想四极近似的弱八极修正提供了量子力学表征，并阐明了实际非谐性如何修改非经典囚禁离子运动。重要的是，运动非经典性对弱八极微扰保持稳健，这由持续存在的亚真空正交压缩和Klyshko不等式违背所证明。这些结果刻画了实际非谐修正如何在理想四极近似之外重塑囚禁离子运动。

papers.title: Recovering Irreducible Three-Body Interactions with Lagrangian Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn mechanical systems from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving the dynamics through the Euler-Lagrange equations, biasing the model toward motion that respects the variational structure of mechanics. The interactions studied so far have been pairwise-additive, leaving open whether LNNs can recover an irreducible many-body interaction from motion alone. We address this using the Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole interaction, the leading three-body dispersion term, whose dependence on the collective geometry of three particles cannot be represented by any sum of pairwise terms. We prescribe the kinetic energy exactly and learn only the potential, as a function of interparticle distances and angles. Combined with a signal-aware sampling strategy that concentrates training data where the three-body signal is strongest while preserving broad coverage of configuration space, this recovers the interaction from accelerations alone. The learned potential reproduces the radial scaling, angular dependence, and characteristic sign reversal of the Axilrod-Teller interaction, and generates stable trajectories. Embedding it within a pairwise Lennard-Jones potential lets us examine its observability: the three-body term is recovered once its dynamical signature exceeds the residual modeling error, which it does cleanly at amplified coupling but not at the coupling of a real noble gas, bracketing the transition between the two. Finally, symbolic regression on the trained potential, with no assumed functional form, returns the Axilrod-Teller expression with angular numerator, radial law, and coupling constant intact. An LNN with domain-specific structure can thus recover an irreducible three-body interaction from trajectories as a closed-form law, pointing toward learning interaction laws whose structure is not known a priori.
papers.title_cn: 用拉格朗日神经网络恢复不可约三体相互作用
papers.abs_cn: 拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）通过参数化标量拉格朗日量并经由欧拉-拉格朗日方程导出动力学，从轨迹数据中学习机械系统，使模型偏向于遵循力学变分结构的运动。迄今为止研究的相互作用都是成对可加的，这使得 LNNs 能否仅从运动恢复不可约多体相互作用这一问题仍悬而未决。我们使用 Axilrod-Teller 三偶极相互作用——领先的三体色散项——来解决这一问题，其对三个粒子集体几何构型的依赖无法由任何成对项之和表示。我们精确指定动能，仅学习势能，将其表示为粒子间距离和角度的函数。结合一种信号感知采样策略，该策略将训练数据集中在三体信号最强之处，同时保持对构型空间的广泛覆盖，从而仅从加速度中恢复该相互作用。学习到的势能再现了 Axilrod-Teller 相互作用的径向标度、角度依赖性和特征性符号反转，并生成稳定轨迹。将其嵌入成对 Lennard-Jones 势中，使我们能够考察其可观测性：一旦三体项的动力学特征超过残余建模误差，它就会被恢复；在放大的耦合下这一点可以干净地实现，但在真实惰性气体的耦合下则不能，从而界定了两者之间的转变。最后，对训练后的势能进行符号回归，在不假设函数形式的情况下，返回了 Axilrod-Teller 表达式，其角度分子、径向规律和耦合常数均保持完整。因此，具有领域特定结构的 LNN 可以从轨迹中以闭式定律的形式恢复不可约三体相互作用，这指向学习其结构并非先验已知的相互作用定律。

papers.title: Quantitative modeling of acid-base equilibria
papers.abstract: Simulating acid-base equilibria from first principles is a tremendous challenge, as it requires modeling bond-breaking events in a complex hydrogen-bonding environment. The quantum mechanical behavior of the protons is often important, complicating simulations even further. We show that by combining state-of-the-art machine-learning potentials, accelerated sampling of the dissociation process, and an efficient estimation of nuclear quantum corrections it is possible to reliably compute the dissociation constants of different species in water. We demonstrate the transferability of this workflow, applying it successfully to the autoionization of water and to the entire ladder of the aqueous dissociation of phosphoric acid. The definition of the dissociation constant, the choice of order parameters, sampling artifacts and finite-size effects, as well as quantum nuclear effects all play a non-trivial role in determining the outcome of the calculation, so that cutting corners is likely to introduce biases that can only be compensated by fortuitous cancellations of errors.
papers.title_cn: 酸碱平衡的定量建模
papers.abs_cn: 从第一性原理模拟酸碱平衡是一项巨大的挑战，因为它需要对复杂氢键环境中的键断裂事件进行建模。质子的量子力学行为通常很重要，使模拟更加复杂。我们表明，通过结合最先进的机器学习势、解离过程的加速采样以及核量子修正的高效估计，可以可靠地计算不同物种在水中的解离常数。我们展示了该工作流程的可迁移性，成功将其应用于水的自电离以及磷酸在水溶液中解离的完整阶梯。解离常数的定义、序参量的选择、采样伪影和有限尺寸效应以及量子核效应，在决定计算结果时都起着非平凡的作用，因此偷工减料很可能引入偏差，而这些偏差只能通过误差的偶然抵消来补偿。

papers.title: Ultrafast laser-stimulated field emission from a metal: a non-equilibrium Green's functions approach
papers.abstract: Ultrafast laser-assisted field emission from metallic nanotips is a promising route for generating coherent electron pulses. However, existing theoretical models often neglect many-body strong correlation effects in the emitter's electronic structure and its response to the optical field. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework based on the non-equilibrium Green's function formalism to simulate the out-of-equilibrium electron dynamics across a strongly driven matter-vacuum interface, in a one-dimensional model. Treating the tip-vacuum coupling perturbatively, we find that the interplay between strong-field emission and multi-photon emission regimes can be described in terms of a filtering of the emitter's local density of occupied states through field-dressed vacuum propagators. By including electron-electron interactions via the second-Born approximation, we show that correlation-induced modifications in the electronic structure are directly transferred to the far-field spectrum. Finally, by self-consistently solving the Dyson equation at the interface, we uncover a dynamic back-action regime driven by the optical field, characterized by a periodic polarization of the emitter, which reshapes the far-field spectrum. This shows that the non-equilibrium Green's functions approach provides a versatile framework for exploring and analyzing field emission of correlated electrons.
papers.title_cn: 超快激光激发的金属场发射：非平衡格林函数方法
papers.abs_cn: 超快激光辅助的金属纳米尖端场发射是产生相干电子脉冲的一条有前景的途径。然而，现有的理论模型往往忽略了发射体电子结构中的多体强关联效应及其对光场的响应。在本工作中，我们提出了一个基于非平衡格林函数形式主义的理论框架，在一维模型中模拟跨越强驱动物质-真空界面的非平衡电子动力学。将尖端-真空耦合作微扰处理，我们发现强场发射与多光子发射区域之间的相互作用可以通过场缀饰真空传播子对发射体占据态局域态密度的滤波来描述。通过第二Born近似引入电子-电子相互作用，我们表明关联诱导的电子结构修正会直接传递到远场谱中。最后，通过在界面处自洽求解Dyson方程，我们揭示了一种由光场驱动的动态反馈区域，其特征是发射体的周期性极化，这种极化重塑了远场谱。这表明非平衡格林函数方法为探索和分析关联电子的场发射提供了一个通用的框架。

papers.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
papers.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. In addition to the analytical theory, we also present results in simple systems with flat bands with a nontrivial quantum metric and show that the biexcitonic spectrum differs strongly from that in the case without quantum geometry. Our theory paves the way for accurate quantitative calculations of biexciton spectra and excitonic many-body phases in modern condensed-matter systems.
papers.title_cn: 晶体系统中激子-激子相互作用理论
papers.abs_cn: 激子是半导体中的束缚电子-空穴对，其相互作用影响光学性质并决定其集体行为和涌现的关联相。尽管这些现象在理论和实验上具有重要意义，但目前仍缺乏一个考虑这些准粒子完全复合性质的激子-激子相互作用微观理论。在此，我们提出一个通用的激子-激子相互作用理论，它建立在我们之前发表的工作[Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)]之上，该工作仅适用于带杂化较弱的传统半导体。相比之下，本文提出的理论几乎适用于任何晶体半导体系统，并可应用于研究能带拓扑、量子几何和莫尔效应起重要作用的系统中的双激子形成和关联激子相。除了解析理论外，我们还展示了具有非平凡量子度规的平带简单系统中的结果，并表明双激子谱与没有量子几何的情况有显著不同。我们的理论为现代凝聚态系统中双激子谱和激子多体相的精确定量计算铺平了道路。

papers.title: Insights on the volume variation of LiCoxMn2-xO4 electrode upon cycling: a correlative operando XRD and XAS study
papers.abstract: Understanding volume changes in high-voltage spinel cathodes is essential for mitigating mechanical degradation and improving cycling stability. However, linking these changes to cation-specific redox processes remains challenging. Here, we combine operando X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to investigate the LiCoxMn2-xO4 spinel system, which exhibits a cubic structure and isotropic lattice response, in order to correlate the evolution of the local and long-range structure. Five compositions (x = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0) were synthesized and electrochemically characterized, with x = 0, 0.5, and 1.0 examined in detail under identical cycling conditions. XAS at the Mn and Co K-edges reveals distinct Mn4+/Mn3+ and Co4+/Co3+ redox processes, with Mn redox activity dominating below 4.7 V and Co redox triggered at higher potentials. Chemometric tools for XAS data analysis further resolve the evolution of local structure during cycling. Both XRD and XAS capture consistent trends in volume evolution, despite probing different structural length scales. Increasing Co content progressively decreases the overall volume change, from 5.0 % to 1.6 % by XAS and from 5.8 % to 2.1 % by XRD. These results demonstrate that Co substitution suppresses electrochemically induced structural strain and establish a direct link between cation-specific redox activity and volumetric evolution. The correlative operando XRD/XAS approach provides a framework to investigate newly designed low-strain, high-energy cathodes with improved cycling stability.
papers.title_cn: LiCoxMn2-xO4电极在循环过程中体积变化的研究：一项关联operando XRD和XAS研究
papers.abs_cn: 理解高压尖晶石正极中的体积变化对于减轻机械降解和提高循环稳定性至关重要。然而，将这些变化与特定阳离子的氧化还原过程联系起来仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们结合operando X射线衍射（XRD）和X射线吸收光谱（XAS）研究了LiCoxMn2-xO4尖晶石体系，该体系呈现立方结构和各向同性晶格响应，以关联局部结构和长程结构的演变。我们合成了五种组成（x = 0、0.25、0.5、0.75和1.0）并进行了电化学表征，其中x = 0、0.5和1.0在相同循环条件下进行了详细研究。Mn和Co K边的XAS揭示了明显的Mn4+/Mn3+和Co4+/Co3+氧化还原过程，其中Mn氧化还原活性在4.7 V以下占主导，而Co氧化还原在更高电位下被触发。用于XAS数据分析的化学计量学工具进一步解析了循环过程中局部结构的演变。尽管探测的结构长度尺度不同，XRD和XAS在体积演变方面捕获了一致的趋势。Co含量的增加逐渐降低了整体体积变化，XAS显示从5.0%降至1.6%，XRD显示从5.8%降至2.1%。这些结果表明，Co取代抑制了电化学诱导的结构应变，并建立了特定阳离子氧化还原活性与体积演变之间的直接联系。关联operando XRD/XAS方法为研究新设计的低应变、高能量正极并提高循环稳定性提供了一个框架。

papers.title: Imbibition dynamics under dissolution-driven fluid thickening
papers.abstract: The imbibition of milk into a biscuit provides an example of a broader class of processes in which a liquid invades a porous material, dissolving components of the solid and thereby modifying its own rheology. This coupling between imbibition, dissolution, and evolving fluid rheology also occurs in food processing, filtration, and reactive porous media. While the resulting changes in fluid viscosity are known to affect imbibition, a quantitative description of how this evolving rheology determines the imbibition dynamics is still lacking. Here, we establish such a description for dissolution-driven fluid thickening. For a capillary tube in the well-mixed limit, we derive a generalized Washburn law showing that the evolving viscosity can be incorporated through a rescaled time given by the accumulated inverse viscosity. This predicts a collapse of the imbibition dynamics for different dissolution rates, which we confirm numerically using coupled free-surface and solute-transport simulations. When diffusion is slower, concentration and viscosity become spatially heterogeneous, resulting in a weaker retardation of the advancing liquid than predicted by the well-mixed theory. We then consider disordered porous media and quantify how dissolution-driven thickening and variations in pore geometry affect the dynamics. Our results extend the classical Washburn description to imbibition with evolving fluid properties and provide a quantitative basis for understanding fluid uptake when interactions with the solid progressively modify the rheology of the invading liquid.
papers.title_cn: 溶解驱动的流体增稠下的渗吸动力学
papers.abs_cn: 牛奶渗入饼干是一个更广泛过程的例子，其中液体侵入多孔材料，溶解固体成分，从而改变自身的流变学。这种渗吸、溶解和流体流变学演化之间的耦合也发生在食品加工、过滤和反应性多孔介质中。虽然已知由此产生的流体粘度变化会影响渗吸，但对于这种演化的流变学如何决定渗吸动力学，仍缺乏定量描述。在这里，我们为溶解驱动的流体增稠建立了这样的描述。对于充分混合极限下的毛细管，我们推导出一个广义 Washburn 定律，表明演化的粘度可以通过由累积的逆粘度给出的重标度时间来纳入。这预测了不同溶解速率下渗吸动力学的坍缩，我们使用耦合的自由表面和溶质输运模拟进行了数值验证。当扩散较慢时，浓度和粘度变得空间非均匀，导致推进液体的阻滞弱于充分混合理论的预测。然后我们考虑无序多孔介质，并量化溶解驱动的增稠和孔隙几何变化如何影响动力学。我们的结果将经典 Washburn 描述扩展到具有演化流体性质的渗吸，并为理解当与固体的相互作用逐渐改变侵入液体的流变学时的流体吸收提供了定量基础。

papers.title: X-ray absorption spectroscopic studies of oxygen-deficient double perovskite oxide NdBaCo$_2$O$_{5+δ}$ ($δ\sim 0.65$)
papers.abstract: The degree of oxygen vacancy in A-site-doped layered double perovskite oxides can lead to anion vacancy ordering, which subsequently results in distinct superstructures. We have studied oxygen deficient double perovskite oxide, NdBaCo$2$O$_{5+δ}$ ($δ\sim$ 0.65), utilising X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy complemented by multiple scattering and first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT+U).
