The present results establish a direct correlation between oxygen-vacancy distribution, magnetic inhomogeneity, and charge transport in layered cobaltates. Our investigations on the Co K, Ba, and Nd $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ edges suggest that the near-edge spectra, based on the number and shape of the spectral features, indicate the value of $δ$ for the compound under study lies closer to 0.75. The analysis of the Ba $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ edge spectrum confirms the +2 oxidation state for Ba ions. The Co K-edge near-edge spectra suggest the possibility of oxygen vacancies arising at the basal sites in addition to the apical sites. This is counterintuitive to the common understanding that oxygen vacancies usually occur at the apical sites, i.e., in the lanthanide (Nd) layer in these compounds. Such a distribution of oxygen vacancies naturally explains the Griffith phase and the conduction mechanism of variable range hopping observed in the compound. The vacancy distribution, when at the optimum level, can also bring about easier oxygen ion mobility and a more sensitive and faster oxygen sensor. We believe that our results will help in tailoring oxygen-ion mobility and enhancing oxygen-sensing performance.
papers.title_cn: 缺氧双钙钛矿氧化物 NdBaCo$_2$O$_{5+δ}$（$δ\sim 0.65$）的 X 射线吸收光谱研究
papers.abs_cn: A 位掺杂的层状双钙钛矿氧化物中氧空位的程度可以导致阴离子空位有序，从而产生不同的超结构。我们利用 X 射线吸收近边结构（XANES）光谱，并结合多重散射和基于密度泛函理论（DFT+U）的第一性原理计算，研究了缺氧双钙钛矿氧化物 NdBaCo$2$O$_{5+δ}$（$δ\sim$ 0.65）。目前的结果建立了层状钴酸盐中氧空位分布、磁不均匀性和电荷输运之间的直接关联。我们对 Co K、Ba 和 Nd $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ 边的研究表明，基于光谱特征的数量和形状，近边光谱表明所研究化合物的 $δ$ 值更接近 0.75。对 Ba $L_{\mathrm{III}}$ 边光谱的分析证实了 Ba 离子的 +2 氧化态。Co K 边近边光谱表明，除了顶端位点外，氧空位也可能出现在基面位点。这与通常认为氧空位通常出现在顶端位点（即这些化合物中镧系（Nd）层）的理解相反。这种氧空位分布自然地解释了该化合物中观察到的 Griffith 相和变程跳跃传导机制。当空位分布处于最佳水平时，还可以带来更容易的氧离子迁移以及更灵敏、更快速的氧传感器。我们相信我们的结果将有助于调整氧离子迁移率并增强氧传感性能。

papers.title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
papers.abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. In a separate high-field-calibrated benchmark, RK removes 66.8% of the orbital error of a pure two-dimensional Coulomb reference, making the remaining state-selective deviations particularly informative. After separating gap and common-scale contributions, the residuals reveal distinct material-dependent orbital patterns and constrain simple multichannel descriptions. For WS2, the measured 2p/3p curvatures yield a parameter-fixed prediction, Q4p=+4.08 meV, for a future same-platform measurement. Together these results show how a well-performing spectral model can be tested for transferable physical information, with the next unmeasured state providing an independent experimental check.
papers.title_cn: 轨道转移揭示里德伯激子中的材料选择性结构
papers.abs_cn: 原子级薄半导体中的里德伯激子为介电屏蔽和电子结构提供了灵敏的观测窗口。随着其光谱分辨率的不断提高，一个核心问题是：有效哈密顿量在用于确定其参数的态之外，还能预测多少材料信息。我们使用 1s、2p 和 2s 能级确定标量 Rytova-Keldysh 哈密顿量，并检验其向被排除的 3p 态的转移。转移偏差具有相反的符号：在 MoSe2 中观测到的 3p 比预测低 7.38 meV，而在 WS2 中比预测高 5.58 meV；在完整报道的 +/-2-sigma 峰误差框内，相反的符号持续存在。在一个独立的高场校准基准中，RK 消除了纯二维库仑参考的 66.8% 的轨道误差，使得剩余的态选择性偏差尤其具有信息量。在分离带隙和共同尺度贡献后，残差揭示了不同的材料依赖轨道模式，并约束了简单的多通道描述。对于 WS2，测得的 2p/3p 曲率给出了一个参数固定的预测值 Q4p=+4.08 meV，供未来同平台测量使用。这些结果共同表明，一个表现良好的光谱模型可以被检验其可转移的物理信息，而下一个未测量的态提供了独立的实验检验。

papers.title: Electron- and hole-doped superconductivity in two-dimensional electride ZrX$_2$ (X = Cl, Br, I)
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) superconducting systems have recently emerged as a frontier in condensed matter physics, driven by their unique physical properties and potential applications. Using first-principles calculations, we show that monolayer ZrX$_2$ (X = Cl, Br, I), which is a family of 2D semiconducting electrides, hosts phonon-mediated superconductivity under both electron and hole dopings. Electron doping in ZrX$_{2}$ can achieve high superconducting transition temperatures at very low concentrations, with ZrBr$_2$ reaching $T_c = 30.0$ K at 0.01 \textit{e}/f.u., followed by ZrCl$_2$ (22.5 K at 0.05 \textit{e}/f.u.) and ZrI$_2$ (18.1 K at 0.01 \textit{e}/f.u.), for which the high $T_c$ originates from the flat conduction band minimum, with Van Hove singularities nearby enhancing the density of states. In contrast, hole doping requires higher concentrations (0.2--0.25 \textit{h}/f.u.) to activate superconductivity, yielding $T_c \sim 2$ K, and approaches a magnetic instability at elevated doping levels. By comparing with InSe and LaBr$_2$, we identify the spatial location and orbital character of excess electrons as key factors determining the strength of hole-doped superconductivity and the nature of competing orders. These findings establish monolayer ZrX$_2$ as a platform for bipolar superconductivity in a 2D electride and provide insights into flat-band engineering for high-$T_c$ superconductors.
papers.title_cn: 二维电子化物 ZrX$_2$（X = Cl、Br、I）中的电子和空穴掺杂超导性
papers.abs_cn: 二维（2D）超导系统因其独特的物理性质和潜在应用，近年来已成为凝聚态物理的前沿领域。通过第一性原理计算，我们表明单层 ZrX$_2$（X = Cl、Br、I）——一族二维半导体电子化物——在电子和空穴掺杂下均可承载声子介导的超导性。ZrX$_2$ 中的电子掺杂可以在极低浓度下实现高超导转变温度，其中 ZrBr$_2$ 在 0.01 e/f.u. 时达到 Tc = 30.0 K，其次是 ZrCl$_2$（0.05 e/f.u. 时为 22.5 K）和 ZrI$_2$（0.01 e/f.u. 时为 18.1 K），其高 Tc 源于平坦的导带底以及附近增强态密度的 Van Hove 奇点。相比之下，空穴掺杂需要更高浓度（0.2--0.25 h/f.u.）才能激活超导性，产生 Tc ~ 2 K，并在更高掺杂水平下接近磁不稳定性。通过与 InSe 和 LaBr$_2$ 比较，我们确定过量电子的空间位置和轨道特征是决定空穴掺杂超导强度及竞争序性质的关键因素。这些发现确立了单层 ZrX$_2$ 作为二维电子化物中双极性超导的平台，并为高 Tc 超导体的平带工程提供了见解。

papers.title: Assessing quantitative phase reliability in electron ptychography using a twisted trilayer WS2 thickness staircase
papers.abstract: The phase of an electron wave is sensitive to the local electrostatic environment and can therefore provide information about atomic-scale structural variations. In electron ptychography, however, specimen thickness, multiple scattering and projected atomic overlap can complicate the quantitative interpretation of the reconstructed phase. Here, we use a twisted trilayer WS2 thickness staircase containing monolayer, bilayer and trilayer regions as an internal reference, with all regions measured under identical experimental conditions. The mean W-column phase increases by approximately 13.2% from the monolayer to the bilayer region, compared with only 4.7% from the bilayer to the trilayer region, revealing a nonlinear thickness dependence. W-S overlap has little effect on the W-column phase, whereas short-range projected W-W overlap increases it by approximately 8-9%. These results provide a benchmark for evaluating quantitative phase measurement in multilayer WS2 and for assessing phase-based mapping of local electrostatic potential, charge-density and three-dimensional atomic-scale polarization.
papers.title_cn: 利用扭转三层 WS2 厚度阶梯评估电子叠层成像中的定量相位可靠性
papers.abs_cn: 电子波的相位对局域静电环境敏感，因此能够提供原子尺度结构变化的信息。然而，在电子叠层成像中，样品厚度、多重散射和投影原子重叠会使重建相位的定量解释变得复杂。本文中，我们使用包含单层、双层和三层区域的扭转三层 WS2 厚度阶梯作为内部参考，所有区域均在相同实验条件下测量。W 原子柱的平均相位从单层到双层区域增加约 13.2%，而从双层到三层区域仅增加 4.7%，揭示了非线性厚度依赖关系。W-S 重叠对 W 原子柱相位影响很小，而短程投影 W-W 重叠使其增加约 8-9%。这些结果为评估多层 WS2 中的定量相位测量以及评估基于相位的局域静电势、电荷密度和三维原子尺度极化映射提供了基准。

papers.title: Role of composition-tuned disorder on magnetic exchange interactions in NiRuMnGa
papers.abstract: We report the experimental investigation of the quaternary Heusler alloy NiRuMnGa, complemented by first-principles calculations. The energetically favorable crystal structure was identified from first-principles calculations and subsequently used as the structural model for refinement of the powder X-ray diffraction data. The refinement shows good agreement with the experimental pattern and reveals substantial B2-type disorder involving Ni/Ru and Mn/Ga site intermixing. The dc magnetic response exhibits pronounced ZFC--FC irreversibility near $\sim 48$ K, with the irreversibility temperature shifting toward lower temperatures under increasing magnetic field, indicating a field-sensitive glassy state. The isothermal magnetization remains unsaturated up to 7 T, reaching only $\sim 0.4\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$/f.u., accompanied by pronounced hysteresis, suggesting competing exchange interactions and frustrated magnetic moments. AC susceptibility, together with magnetic relaxation and memory measurements, confirms slow spin dynamics characteristic of a cluster glass state. The lack of a discernible heat-capacity anomaly near the irreversibility temperature further supports the absence of conventional long-range magnetic order. Collectively, these results demonstrate that competition between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions in NiRuMnGa leads to magnetic frustration and stabilizes a cluster glass state.
papers.title_cn: 组分调控的无序对NiRuMnGa中磁交换相互作用的影响
papers.abs_cn: 我们报道了四元Heusler合金NiRuMnGa的实验研究，并辅以第一性原理计算。通过第一性原理计算确定了能量上有利的晶体结构，并将其作为粉末X射线衍射数据精修的结构模型。精修结果与实验图谱吻合良好，并揭示了涉及Ni/Ru和Mn/Ga位点互占的显著B2型无序。直流磁响应在约48 K附近表现出明显的ZFC--FC不可逆性，且不可逆温度随磁场增大向低温移动，表明存在场敏感的玻璃态。等温磁化在7 T以下仍未饱和，仅达到约0.4 μ_B/f.u.，并伴随明显的磁滞，表明存在竞争的交换相互作用和受挫磁矩。交流磁化率以及磁弛豫和记忆测量证实了团簇玻璃态所特有的慢自旋动力学。在不可逆温度附近未观察到明显的热容异常，进一步支持了不存在常规长程磁有序。总体而言，这些结果表明NiRuMnGa中铁磁与反铁磁相互作用之间的竞争导致磁受挫并稳定了团簇玻璃态。

papers.title: Specialized machine learning force fields for materials dynamics
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by accessing unprecedented length and time scales. While pretrained equivariant graph neural networks achieve robust zero-shot performance for near-equilibrium properties across broad chemical spaces, their translation to complex materials dynamics remains fundamentally challenged by out-of-distribution reactive states, representation biases, and computational scaling limits. In this Review, we examine how physics-driven specialization extends the applicability of MLIPs to complex dynamical systems. We systematically evaluate the structural trade-offs in MLIP design: the undersampling of highly strained configurations, the prohibitive computational overhead of high-order message-passing architectures, and the necessity of nonlocal interactions for open and field-coupled systems. Through four demanding application contexts - electrified interfaces, compositionally fluctuating open systems, multiphase evolution, and large-scale fracture - we establish a framework for observable-specific validation. Highlighting the complementary roles of universal foundation models and task-specific potentials, we emphasize that targeted adaptations must be rigorously benchmarked against intended observables. We conclude with a roadmap for developing physically consistent, hardware-aware force fields that seamlessly connect electronic-structure accuracy to macroscopic materials phenomena.
papers.title_cn: 面向材料动力学的专用机器学习力场
papers.abs_cn: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）正在通过触及前所未有的长度和时间尺度而变革原子尺度模拟。尽管预训练等变图神经网络在广泛化学空间中对于近平衡性质实现了稳健的零样本性能，但其向复杂材料动力学的迁移仍从根本上受到分布外反应态、表示偏差和计算扩展极限的挑战。在这篇综述中，我们考察了物理驱动的专业化如何将 MLIPs 的适用性扩展到复杂动力系统。我们系统评估了 MLIP 设计中的结构性权衡：高应变构型的欠采样、高阶消息传递架构的过高计算开销，以及开放和场耦合系统对非局域相互作用的必要性。通过四个 demanding 的应用场景——带电界面、组成波动的开放系统、多相演化和大规模断裂——我们建立了一个针对可观测量的验证框架。我们强调了通用基础模型与任务专用势的互补作用，并强调针对性适配必须针对预期可观测量进行严格基准测试。最后，我们提出了一个路线图，用于开发物理一致、硬件感知的力场，将电子结构精度与宏观材料现象无缝连接。

papers.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
papers.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential field-induced phase transition into a collective electronic state driven by enhanced electron-electron interactions. Our findings provide valuable insights into the unconventional chiral transport and emergent correlated quantum states under extreme magnetic fields.
papers.title_cn: Weyl半导体碲中手性反常的演化与破缺
papers.abs_cn: 拓扑材料中的手性反常表现为负纵向磁阻，然而这种效应的可调性和演化仍然难以捉摸。在此，我们表明掺杂碲可作为实现巨大负纵向磁阻的多功能平台，该效应可通过费米能级和磁场高度调控。通过将费米能级移向Weyl点，我们观察到负磁阻的显著增强，这源于手性反常，并且稳健地持续到环境温度。超越量子极限后，系统表现出正线性磁电导，这作为最低Landau能级中手性反常的有力输运特征。值得注意的是，在低温下的极端量子极限中，磁阻经历了从负到正的剧烈反转。这种反转指向一种潜在的场诱导相变，转变为由增强的电子-电子相互作用驱动的集体电子态。我们的发现为极端磁场下的非常规手性输运和涌现关联量子态提供了有价值的见解。

papers.title: Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning
papers.abstract: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. We introduce the Kolmogorov-Arnold flow (KAFlow), which learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, fixes the gauge of these functions so that every term has a unique place, integrates the dynamics with exact exponential integrators, and distills its closed form automatically. On the synthetic benchmarks of the Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator, KAFlow lowers the out-of-distribution loss by 3.4 to 11 times and recovers every coefficient to within 10^-4 without symbolic templates, reaching the precision floor of the data. On long-horizon quantum dynamics, it lowers the state infidelity by up to 6 orders of magnitude, and by 30 times when trained only on position and momentum measurements. KAFlow also learns a variable-order fractional operator 15 times more accurately than existing operator networks and discovers nonlocal, fractional and non-polynomial dispersion relations on which sparse regression fails.
papers.title_cn: 用于可解释算子学习的低秩 Kolmogorov-Arnold 生成流
papers.abs_cn: 从数据中学习物理定律的神经算子应当能够泛化到训练分布之外，并以闭式形式揭示所学到的定律。Kolmogorov-Arnold 神经算子通过在所有位置和频率上学习一个稠密的伪微分符号，对位置相关动力学同时实现了这两点，但其代价随分辨率的平方增长，且闭式形式必须手工读出。这种稠密符号是不必要的：有限阶变系数微分算子的符号，其分离秩由其系数函数的数量所界定，与分辨率无关，而该网络在其自身基准上学习到的符号秩为二。我们引入 Kolmogorov-Arnold 流（KAFlow），它将物理算子的生成元学习为由单变量 Kolmogorov-Arnold 函数构建的低秩符号，固定这些函数的规范使得每一项都有唯一的位置，用精确指数积分器对动力学进行积分，并自动蒸馏出其闭式形式。在 Kolmogorov-Arnold 神经算子的合成基准上，KAFlow 将分布外损失降低了 3.4 到 11 倍，并在没有符号模板的情况下将每个系数恢复到 10^-4 以内，达到了数据的精度下限。在长时程量子动力学上，它将状态不保真度最多降低了 6 个数量级，当仅使用位置和动量测量进行训练时降低了 30 倍。KAFlow 还以比现有算子网络高 15 倍的精度学习了一个变阶分数阶算子，并发现了稀疏回归无法处理的非局域、分数阶和非多项式色散关系。

papers.title: TopoLIA: Topology-Inspired Latent Interaction Attention for Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: The growing sophistication of drug discovery calls for new advances in artificial intelligence (AI). Transformers have underpinned recent breakthroughs in AI, yet their conventional source-target attention mechanism can become a bottleneck for modeling complex interactions. Here, we introduce TopoLIA, a topology-inspired latent interaction attention mechanism that learns not only how much information should be exchanged between interaction partners, but also how that information should be transformed. Source-target-dependent attention is mediated through a compact latent interaction space, providing a structured representation of complex interactions. We further incorporate topological spectral representations to capture multiscale data geometry and extract algebraic relationships. TopoLIA thus incorporates topological principles into both data representation and neural network architecture. We demonstrate TopoLIA on protein-ligand binding, where persistent spectra encode multiscale topological and geometric patterns in 3D protein-ligand complexes, while latent interaction attention (LIA) enables structured, source-target-dependent information exchange. We pretrain TopoLIA by reconstructing masked multiscale spectral tokens from unlabeled molecular structures, yielding transferable structural representations without task-specific annotations. Across multiple scoring and docking benchmarks, TopoLIA achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms its standard-attention counterpart. Rank analyses show that compact latent dimensions yield the best performance, supporting compact interaction spaces as an effective inductive bias for biomolecular learning. More broadly, LIA provides a general framework for structured, source-target-dependent information exchange that is applicable to diverse scientific and AI problems involving complex heterogeneous interactions.
papers.title_cn: TopoLIA：面向药物发现的拓扑启发潜在交互注意力
papers.abs_cn: 药物发现日益增长的复杂性要求人工智能（AI）取得新的进展。Transformer 支撑了近期 AI 的突破，然而其传统的源-目标注意力机制在建模复杂交互时可能成为瓶颈。在此，我们提出 TopoLIA，一种拓扑启发的潜在交互注意力机制，它不仅学习交互伙伴之间应交换多少信息，还学习这些信息应如何被变换。依赖于源-目标的注意力通过一个紧凑的潜在交互空间进行中介，为复杂交互提供结构化表示。我们进一步引入拓扑谱表示，以捕捉多尺度数据几何并提取代数关系。因此，TopoLIA 将拓扑原理融入数据表示和神经网络架构之中。我们在蛋白质-配体结合上展示了 TopoLIA，其中持久谱编码 3D 蛋白质-配体复合物中的多尺度拓扑和几何模式，而潜在交互注意力（LIA）则实现结构化的、依赖于源-目标的信息交换。我们通过从无标注分子结构中重建掩码多尺度谱 token 来预训练 TopoLIA，从而在无需任务特定标注的情况下获得可迁移的结构表示。在多个评分和对接基准上，TopoLIA 达到了最先进的性能，并持续优于其标准注意力对应版本。秩分析表明，紧凑的潜在维度能带来最佳性能，支持紧凑交互空间作为生物分子学习的一种有效归纳偏置。更广泛地说，LIA 为结构化的、依赖于源-目标的信息交换提供了一个通用框架，适用于涉及复杂异质交互的多种科学和 AI 问题。

papers.title: NucleoNet: A Nuclear-Aware Determinant Ansatz for Multi-Geometry Neural Variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Neural-network variational Monte Carlo provides an accurate route to solving the electronic Schrödinger equation, but many neural wavefunctions are optimized for a single nuclear geometry, requiring separate calculations to map out a potential energy surface. We introduce NucleoNet, a nuclear-aware determinant ansatz in which electrons and nuclei form a unified particle set propagated through a shared electron--nucleus backbone that jointly evolves one-particle and two-particle representations. Nuclei carry learned representations that evolve alongside the electronic representations and condition orbital construction, while antisymmetry is imposed only by electronic determinants. On equilibrium small-molecule benchmarks, NucleoNet achieves accuracy comparable to established neural-wavefunction baselines with substantially fewer parameters. For each molecular system, a single model optimized jointly across geometries describes the N$_2$ dissociation curve, Li displacement in LiCN, and the ethane and formamide minimum-energy paths for bond dissociation. Sparse-geometry training generalizes to unseen geometries for N$_2$ and LiCN without further optimization, and N$_2$ ablations show that nuclear streams substantially improve this interpolation. These results show that a compact wavefunction with jointly evolved nuclear representations can describe the geometries of a molecular system with a single set of parameters.
papers.title_cn: NucleoNet：一种面向多几何构型神经变分蒙特卡洛的核感知行列式拟设
papers.abs_cn: 神经网络变分蒙特卡洛为求解电子薛定谔方程提供了一条精确途径，但许多神经波函数针对单一核几何构型进行优化，需要分别计算才能绘制势能面。我们提出 NucleoNet，一种核感知行列式拟设，其中电子和原子核构成统一粒子集，通过共享的电子-原子核主干传播，该主干联合演化单粒子和双粒子表示。原子核携带学习到的表示，与电子表示共同演化并条件化轨道构建，而反对称性仅由电子行列式施加。在平衡态小分子基准上，NucleoNet 以显著更少的参数达到了与已有神经波函数基线相当的精度。对于每个分子体系，一个跨几何构型联合优化的单一模型即可描述 N2 解离曲线、LiCN 中 Li 位移以及乙烷和甲酰胺键解离的最小能量路径。稀疏几何构型训练可泛化到 N2 和 LiCN 的未见几何构型而无需进一步优化，N2 消融实验表明核流显著改善了这种插值。这些结果表明，具有联合演化核表示的紧凑波函数可以用单一参数集描述分子体系的多种几何构型。

papers.title: Ionic liquid/PDMS coated nanostructured ZnO surfaces for superior antibacterial activity
papers.abstract: The development of nanostructured antibacterial surfaces has gained significant attention due to the urgent need to combat bacterial colonization and biofouling across food, healthcare, and marine sectors. Among functional metal oxides, zinc oxide (ZnO) nanostructures are particularly promising owing to their rich morphology, favourable physicochemical attributes, and intrinsic bactericidal properties. Here, we utilize a green, eco-friendly Hot Water Treatment (HWT) method to fabricate dense ZnO nanorod arrays on zinc substrates. To overcome the practical limitations and challenges of conventional antibacterial coatings, such as poor operational stability, cytotoxicity, and the risk of antimicrobial resistance, we developed a durable hybrid coating composed of an imidazolium-based ionic liquid stabilized with polydimethylsiloxane. The resulting hybrid-coated nanostructured surfaces exhibit superior antibacterial efficacy against Escherichia coli through a combination of topography-induced mechanical strain and membrane disruption.
papers.title_cn: 离子液体/PDMS 涂覆的纳米结构 ZnO 表面具有优异的抗菌活性
papers.abs_cn: 由于在食品、医疗和海洋领域迫切需要对抗细菌定植和生物污损，纳米结构抗菌表面的开发受到了广泛关注。在功能性金属氧化物中，氧化锌（ZnO）纳米结构因其丰富的形貌、有利的物理化学特性以及固有的杀菌性能而尤其具有前景。在此，我们利用一种绿色、环保的热水处理（HWT）方法在锌基底上制备了致密的 ZnO 纳米棒阵列。为了克服传统抗菌涂层在实际应用中的局限性和挑战，如操作稳定性差、细胞毒性以及抗菌耐药性风险，我们开发了一种由咪唑基离子液体与聚二甲基硅氧烷稳定化组成的耐用混合涂层。所得混合涂层纳米结构表面通过形貌诱导的机械应变和膜破坏的协同作用，对 Escherichia coli 表现出优异的抗菌功效。

papers.title: High-Throughput Discovery of Chiral Carbon-Boron Semimetals with Weyl Topology and Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity
papers.abstract: Chiral crystals provide a natural platform for unconventional topological fermions, while light-element carbon--boron frameworks are promising for phonon-mediated superconductivity owing to strong covalent bonding and high phonon frequencies. Here, we combine Wyckoff-position-based structure generation with high-throughput first-principles calculations to search for C--B crystals in selected hexagonal chiral space groups. Starting from 972 generated $\mathrm{C}_m\mathrm{B}_n$ structures ($m,n=1\text{--}4$), successive filters based on energetic stability, dynamical stability, electronic metallicity, topological band features, and thermal stability identify six stable candidates: $(\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{B}_2)_8$, $(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_2)_3$, $(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_4)_6$, $(\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{B}_2)_6$, $(\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{B}_3)_6$, and $(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_2)_6$. These materials host diverse topological semimetal states near the Fermi level, including charge-one, charge-two, and charge-three Weyl points, nodal rings, and nodal-surface states. Notably, $(\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{B}_2)_8$ exhibits screw-symmetry-protected charge-three Weyl points and strong electron--phonon coupling, yielding a McMillan transition temperature of $31.1\,\mathrm{K}$ for the Coulomb pseudopotential parameter $μ^* = 0.10$. In addition, $(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_2)_3$ hosts multiple charge-one Weyl points and pronounced anisotropic multiband superconductivity revealed by fully anisotropic Eliashberg calculations. These results extend the materials scope of topological semimetals with phonon-mediated superconductivity to chemically designed chiral light-element structures.
papers.title_cn: 具有Weyl拓扑和声子介导超导性的手性碳硼半金属的高通量发现
papers.abs_cn: 手性晶体为非常规拓扑费米子提供了天然平台，而轻元素碳硼框架由于强共价键和高声子频率，有望实现声子介导的超导性。在此，我们将基于Wyckoff位置的结构生成与高通量第一性原理计算相结合，在选定的六方手性空间群中搜索C-B晶体。从972个生成的$\mathrm{C}_m\mathrm{B}_n$结构（$m,n=1\text{--}4$）出发，基于能量稳定性、动力学稳定性、电子金属性、拓扑能带特征和热稳定性的逐级筛选确定了六个稳定候选物：$(\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{B}_2)_8$、$(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_2)_3$、$(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_4)_6$、$(\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{B}_2)_6$、$(\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{B}_3)_6$和$(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_2)_6$。这些材料在费米能级附近具有多种拓扑半金属态，包括电荷为一、电荷为二和电荷为三的Weyl点、节线环和节面态。值得注意的是，$(\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{B}_2)_8$表现出螺旋对称性保护的电荷为三的Weyl点和强电子-声子耦合，在库仑赝势参数$μ^* = 0.10$时给出McMillan转变温度为$31.1\,\mathrm{K}$。此外，$(\mathrm{C}\mathrm{B}_2)_3$具有多个电荷为一的Weyl点，并通过完全各向异性Eliashberg计算揭示了明显的各向异性多带超导性。这些结果将具有声子介导超导性的拓扑半金属的材料范围扩展到化学设计的手性轻元素结构。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Topology and Van Hove Saddle Points in Hexagonal TiAs
papers.abstract: We report the first successful growth of stoichiometric hexagonal TiAs single crystals (space group $P6_3/mmc$) using chemical vapor transport and investigate their vibrational, electronic, topological, and magnetotransport properties. Polarized Raman spectroscopy identifies all four Raman-active phonon modes ($A_{1g} + E_{1g} + 2E_{2g}$), consistent with the hexagonal crystal symmetry. First-principles calculations reveal nontrivial band topology characterized by a symmetry indicator $\mathbb{Z}_4 = 2$ and a strong topological index $ν_0 = 1$, together with symmetry-protected fourfold band degeneracies at the nonsymmorphic Brillouin-zone boundary. The Fermi surface exhibits an orbital-dependent crossover from quasi-two-dimensional cylindrical sheets to a corrugated three-dimensional structure along $k_z$. A Van Hove saddle point approximately 0.5 eV below the Fermi level along $Γ\text{--}K$ is associated with a neck-disrupting Lifshitz transition and enhanced density of states. Magnetotransport measurements reveal a pronounced twofold angular magnetoresistance, consistent with anisotropic Fermi-surface geometry and open cyclotron orbits. Hall measurements indicate uncompensated, hole-dominated transport, accounting for the absence of extreme magnetoresistance and contributing to the field-orientation-dependent Hall response. These results establish hexagonal TiAs as a platform for exploring the interplay of nonsymmorphic band topology, Van Hove singularities, and anisotropic electronic transport in transition-metal monopnictides.
papers.title_cn: 六方TiAs中的对称性强制拓扑与Van Hove鞍点
papers.abs_cn: 我们报道了利用化学气相输运法首次成功生长化学计量比六方TiAs单晶（空间群 $P6_3/mmc$），并研究了其振动、电子、拓扑和磁输运性质。偏振拉曼光谱识别出全部四个拉曼活性声子模式（$A_{1g} + E_{1g} + 2E_{2g}$），与六方晶体对称性一致。第一性原理计算揭示了非平庸能带拓扑，其特征为对称性指标 $\mathbb{Z}_4 = 2$ 和强拓扑指数 $ν_0 = 1$，并在非对称性布里渊区边界处存在对称性保护的四重能带简并。费米面表现出轨道依赖的从准二维柱状片层到沿 $k_z$ 方向褶皱三维结构的交叉。沿 $Γ\text{--}K$ 方向约低于费米能级0.5 eV处存在一个Van Hove鞍点，与破坏颈部的Lifshitz转变和增强的态密度相关。磁输运测量揭示了显著的二重角度磁阻，与各向异性费米面几何和开放回旋轨道一致。霍尔测量表明非补偿的、以空穴为主的输运，这解释了极端磁阻的缺失，并导致了依赖于场方向的霍尔响应。这些结果确立了六方TiAs作为探索过渡金属单磷族化合物中非对称性能带拓扑、Van Hove奇点和各向异性电子输运相互作用的平台。

papers.title: Alter-excitons in Altermagnets: Symmetry, Splitting and Dispersion
papers.abstract: Magnetism provides a fertile platform for discovering emergent quantum phenomena governed by symmetry. Recent developments of spin-space-group (SSG) theory have revealed altermagnets as a distinct class of nonrelativistic collinear magnets with unconventional spin-dependent electronic structures. Here, we demonstrate that altermagnetic symmetry imposes fundamentally different constraints on electronic and excitonic excitations. Although the quasiparticle and two-body Hamiltonians possess identical SSG symmetries, we find that symmetry-protected degeneracies present in the electronic band structure can be intrinsically lifted in the exciton spectrum at specific momenta. This splitting arises solely from the many-body nature of excitons and does not require spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order. Combining symmetry analysis with many-body perturbation theory, we predict a novel class of spin-split excitonic quasiparticles, termed alter-excitons, and reveal their characteristic dispersions in altermagnetic systems. Our results establish excitons as a sensitive probe of hidden spin-space symmetries and uncover a new route toward symmetry-engineered many-body phenomena in collinear magnets.
papers.title_cn: 交错磁体中的交错激子：对称性、劈裂与色散
papers.abs_cn: 磁性为发现由对称性主导的新兴量子现象提供了丰富的平台。自旋空间群（SSG）理论的最新发展揭示了交错磁体是一类独特的非相对论共线磁体，具有非常规的自旋依赖电子结构。在此，我们证明交错磁对称性对电子激发和激子激发施加了根本不同的约束。尽管准粒子和两体哈密顿量具有相同的SSG对称性，我们发现电子能带结构中受对称性保护的简并在激子谱中特定动量处可以被内在地解除。这种劈裂仅源于激子的多体本质，不需要自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序。结合对称性分析与多体微扰理论，我们预测了一类新型自旋劈裂激子准粒子，称为交错激子，并揭示了它们在交错磁体系中的特征色散。我们的结果确立了激子作为隐藏自旋空间对称性的灵敏探针，并揭示了在共线磁体中对称性工程多体现象的新途径。

papers.title: All-electron RT-TDDFT with Exact Exchange based on Numeric Atom-centered Orbitals for Condensed Matter
papers.abstract: Real-time time-dependent density functional theory (RT-TDDFT) has become a widely used first-principles method for studying excited-state and nonequilibrium electron dynamics. Hybrid exchange-correlation (XC) functionals, which incorporate a fraction of nonlocal exact exchange, are particularly important for accurately describing processes such as charge transfer and hot-carrier dynamics. However, the high computational cost which accompanies exact exchange, as required in hybrid XC functionals, has largely restricted RT-TDDFT simulations of condensed matter systems to using semi-local XC functionals. In this work, we present an all-electron implementation of exact exchange for RT-TDDFT based on numeric atom-centered orbitals, extending an efficient ground-state resolution-of-identity (RI) framework to the complex, time-dependent Hamiltonians required for real-time propagation. We validate the implementation against an established RI approach, for an isolated water molecule, finding exact agreement for both valence and core (K-edge) excitations. We also demonstrate the method on two extended periodic systems, crystalline silicon and silicon carbide. For silicon, the HSE06 spectrum reproduces previously reported real-time TDDFT results and agrees with experiment to within approximately 0.2~eV, consistent with plane-wave pseudopotential implementations. For silicon carbide, we compute valence and X-ray absorption spectra at the silicon $L$-edge and carbon $K$-edge. These results establish an efficient, all-electron route to hybrid-XC functional RT-TDDFT for both molecular and condensed matter systems.
papers.title_cn: 基于数值原子中心轨道的全电子实时含时密度泛函理论精确交换方法用于凝聚态体系
papers.abs_cn: 实时含时密度泛函理论（RT-TDDFT）已成为研究激发态和非平衡电子动力学的广泛使用的第一性原理方法。混合交换关联（XC）泛函包含一部分非局域精确交换，对于准确描述电荷转移和热载流子动力学等过程尤为重要。然而，混合XC泛函所需的精确交换所带来的高计算成本，在很大程度上限制了凝聚态体系的RT-TDDFT模拟只能使用半局域XC泛函。在本工作中，我们提出了基于数值原子中心轨道的RT-TDDFT精确交换的全电子实现，将高效基态恒等式分辨（RI）框架扩展到实时传播所需的复数含时哈密顿量。我们针对孤立水分子，将本实现与已有的RI方法进行验证，发现价态和芯态（K边）激发均完全一致。我们还在两个扩展周期体系——晶体硅和碳化硅上展示了该方法。对于硅，HSE06谱再现了先前报道的实时TDDFT结果，并与实验在约0.2~eV范围内一致，与平面波赝势实现相符。对于碳化硅，我们计算了硅L边和碳K边的价态和X射线吸收谱。这些结果建立了一条高效的全电子途径，用于分子和凝聚态体系的混合XC泛函RT-TDDFT。

papers.title: Room-temperature ferroelectric p-wave magnet
papers.abstract: P -wave magnets exhibit odd-parity spin polarization in momentum space while retaining zero net magnetization, offering a promising route toward nonrelativistic spintronics. Previously reported p-wave magnets based on combined time-reversal and lattice-translation symmetry, Tt, have thus far exhibited ordering temperatures below the liquid-nitrogen range. Here, we demonstrate a distinct route to a pristine p-wave magnetism that does not require T t symmetry, and instead is based on incommensurate spin-spiral order. Specifically, the cycloidal magnetic structure of the multiferroic BiFeO3 (BFO) intrinsically realizes p-wave magnetism coexisting with ferroelectric polarization at room temperature. Combining symmetry analysis, density-functional-theory calculations, and circular photogalvanic-effect (CPGE) measurements, we find a large nonrelativistic spin splitting of approximately 100 meV associated with the cycloidal order. The resulting p-wave spin polarization gives rise to a characteristic CPGE response whose sign can be reversibly switched by electrically controlling the cycloid chirality. Our results establish ferroelectric BiFeO3 as a room-temperature platform for electrically switchable p-wave magnetism and provide a route toward voltage-controlled spintronic devices based on parity-breaking magnetic order.
papers.title_cn: 室温铁电 p 波磁体
papers.abs_cn: p 波磁体在动量空间中表现出奇宇称自旋极化，同时保持零净磁化，为实现非相对论性自旋电子学提供了一条有前景的途径。此前报道的基于时间反演与晶格平移联合对称性 Tt 的 p 波磁体，其有序温度迄今均低于液氮温区。在此，我们展示了一条实现本征 p 波磁性的不同途径，该途径不需要 Tt 对称性，而是基于非公度自旋螺旋序。具体而言，多铁性 BiFeO3（BFO）的摆线磁结构在室温下本征地实现了与铁电极化共存的 p 波磁性。结合对称性分析、密度泛函理论计算和圆光电流效应（CPGE）测量，我们发现与摆线序相关的大约 100 meV 的大非相对论性自旋劈裂。由此产生的 p 波自旋极化给出了特征性的 CPGE 响应，其符号可通过电控摆线手性实现可逆翻转。我们的结果确立了铁电 BiFeO3 作为电可切换 p 波磁性的室温平台，并为基于宇称破缺磁序的电压控制自旋电子器件提供了一条途径。

papers.title: Ground-State Phase Diagram of the Effective Model with Antiferromagnetic Nearest-Neighbor and Ferromagnetic Next-Nearest-Neighbor Interactions in 1/1 Periodic Approximants to Icosahedral Quasicrystals
papers.abstract: By performing complete enumeration of all configurations of magnetic moments, we have determined the ground-state phase diagram of the effective model with antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor interactions $J_1$ and ferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor interactions $J_2$ on the 1/1 periodic approximant to icosahedral quasicrystal. Depending on the ratio of $J_2/J_1$ and the magnetic anisotropy arising from the crystalline electric field, various non-collinear ferrimagnetic orders and antiferromagnetic orders are shown to be stabilized, whose magnetic space groups are identified as $R\bar{3}$, $C2'/m'$, $Pm'm'2$ and $I_{\rm P}m'\bar{3}'$. We have revealed the topological as well as magnetic property of each ground state with degeneracy, which is useful to understand experimental observations of magnetic structures and domains in the rare-earth-based 1/1 approximants.
papers.title_cn: 二十面体准晶的1/1周期近似中具有反铁磁最近邻和铁磁次近邻相互作用的有效模型的基态相图
papers.abs_cn: 通过对磁矩所有构型的完全枚举，我们确定了在二十面体准晶的1/1周期近似上，具有反铁磁最近邻相互作用 J1 和铁磁次近邻相互作用 J2 的有效模型的基态相图。根据 J2/J1 的比值以及由晶体电场引起的磁各向异性，各种非共线亚铁磁序和反铁磁序被证明可以稳定存在，其磁空间群被确定为 R-3、C2'/m'、Pm'm'2 和 I_P m'-3'。我们揭示了每个具有简并度的基态的拓扑和磁性性质，这对于理解稀土基1/1近似中磁结构和磁畴的实验观测是有用的。

papers.title: Riemannian Hessian analysis of Sobolev gradient flows for the Gross--Pitaevskii ground state problem
papers.abstract: Sobolev gradient flows for the Gross--Pitaevskii ground state problem are Riemannian gradient descent methods on the sphere under a metric induced by a discrete elliptic operator. We analyze their convergence through the condition number of the Riemannian Hessian at the ground state. Bounds of the Rayleigh quotient of the Riemannian Hessian give a uniform analysis of these methods for different metrics. The uniform analysis applies to the classical metrics, such as the shifted Laplacian and the energy-adaptive metrics. Inspired by this analysis, we also consider three new metrics. One of them is a Thomas--Fermi metric, whose condition number is bounded uniformly in the interaction strength for the one-dimensional harmonic trap and whose iteration count does not grow in the Thomas--Fermi regime in the numerical tests. The performance suggested by our analysis is consistent with three-dimensional numerical tests with up to one billion unknowns, for both Riemannian gradient descent and Riemannian conjugate gradient methods, whose practical performance is also related to the Hessian condition number. The Thomas--Fermi flow needs the fewest iterations, while the metrics inverted exactly by tensor-product solvers are the fastest in computational time on one GPU card.
papers.title_cn: Gross--Pitaevskii 基态问题的 Sobolev 梯度流的 Riemannian Hessian 分析
papers.abs_cn: Gross--Pitaevskii 基态问题的 Sobolev 梯度流是球面上在离散椭圆算子诱导的度量下的 Riemannian 梯度下降方法。我们通过基态处 Riemannian Hessian 的条件数来分析其收敛性。Riemannian Hessian 的 Rayleigh 商界给出了这些方法在不同度量下的统一分析。该统一分析适用于经典度量，如 shifted Laplacian 和能量自适应度量。受此分析启发，我们还考虑了三种新度量。其中一种是 Thomas--Fermi 度量，对于一维谐振子陷阱，其条件数在相互作用强度上一致有界，并且在数值测试中其迭代次数在 Thomas--Fermi 区域不增长。我们的分析所建议的性能与高达十亿未知量的三维数值测试一致，对于 Riemannian 梯度下降和 Riemannian 共轭梯度方法均是如此，后者的实际性能也与 Hessian 条件数相关。Thomas--Fermi 流需要的迭代次数最少，而由张量积求解器精确求逆的度量在单块 GPU 卡上计算时间最快。

papers.title: Polyconvex neural-network surrogates with learned paired directional features for anisotropic hyperelastic homogenization
papers.abstract: Approximating the effective anisotropic hyperelastic response of a representative volume element (RVE) requires constitutive expressiveness, mechanical consistency, and computational efficiency. This work develops a polyconvex physics-augmented neural network (PANN) construction based on paired directional features whose orientations, stretch powers, and determinant exponents adapt to the RVE response. The features are composed with convex, componentwise nondecreasing cores, realized as an input-convex neural network (ICNN) or an input-convex Kolmogorov-Arnold network (ICKAN). The complete energies satisfy objectivity, an exactly stress-free reference, two-dimensional polyconvexity, and prescribed growth conditions by construction, and nonnegative energy is certified separately for the selected models. On a multicavity and a single-cavity periodic cell, these energies are compared with an Unconstrained energy, trained identically without the curvature and growth constraints, and with three hyperreduced projection-based reduced-order models (HPROMs), which serve as physics-based references. On the first cell, learning the features lowers the stress error sevenfold, and six features suffice on both. The constrained energies remain below one percent in stress error and in the displacement error of a tensile-coupon FE$^2$ application with a full-order reference, whereas the Unconstrained energy and the HPROMs are more accurate inside the data. Beyond the data, however, the Unconstrained energy loses rank-one convexity, and under confined compression it stops below half of the 500 MPa that the constrained energies reach. These results quantify what the guarantees cost in accuracy and what they secure beyond the data.
papers.title_cn: 具有学习配对方向特征的多凸神经网络代理模型用于各向异性超弹性均匀化
papers.abs_cn: 近似代表性体积单元（RVE）的有效各向异性超弹性响应需要本构表达能力、力学一致性和计算效率。本文提出了一种基于配对方向特征的多凸物理增强神经网络（PANN）构造，其特征的方向、拉伸幂和行列式指数可自适应于 RVE 响应。这些特征与凸的、逐分量非递减的核心函数复合，核心函数实现为输入凸神经网络（ICNN）或输入凸 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（ICKAN）。完整的能量函数通过构造满足客观性、精确无应力参考状态、二维多凸性以及规定的增长条件，并且对所选模型单独验证了能量非负性。在多空腔和单空腔周期性单元上，将这些能量与无约束能量（以相同方式训练但不施加曲率和增长约束）以及三种超缩减投影型降阶模型（HPROM）进行比较，后者作为基于物理的参考。在第一个单元上，学习特征将应力误差降低了七倍，并且两个单元上六个特征即已足够。约束能量在应力误差以及拉伸试样 FE$^2$ 应用（以全阶模型为参考）的位移误差方面均保持在百分之一以下，而无约束能量和 HPROM 在数据内部更为精确。然而在数据之外，无约束能量失去秩一凸性，并且在受限压缩下其应力停止在 500 MPa 的一半以下，而约束能量可达到 500 MPa。这些结果量化了这些保证在精度方面的代价以及在数据之外所保障的性能。

papers.title: Drude, Where's My Charge? End-to-End Learning of Polarizable Drude Force Fields for Polymer Electrolytes
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations of solid polymer electrolytes require force fields that are fast enough to converge ion transport over hundreds of nanoseconds, yet accurately describe the ion-polymer interactions that govern it. Fixed-charge force fields meet the first requirement but neglect electronic polarization, an effect often approximated by scaling ionic charges using empirically chosen factors. Here we present AutoDrude, a differentiable framework that parametrizes polarizable Drude force fields directly from DFT energies, forces, and dipoles, with no empirical tuning and at only 1.20 times the cost of a fixed-charge simulation. For PEO-LiTFSI, the dipole-constrained (hard-constraint) AutoDrude model reproduces the experimental ionic conductivity as accurately as the best charge-scaled model (17% versus 16% mean absolute percentage error). We compare the polarizable forcefield to fixed charge ones models by fitting a fixed charge model. Unlike the charge-scaled models tested here, however, AutoDrude also reproduces the dilute-limit cation transference number, its increase with salt concentration, and the absence of Li-TFSI contact ion pairs at low concentration. A penalty-based (soft-constraint) variant yields a closer fit to the DFT reference yet underestimates the conductivity by up to an order of magnitude, demonstrating that closer agreement with DFT training data alone does not guarantee accurate ion transport. These results indicate that although charge scaling can reproduce ionic conductivity the explicit inclusion of polarization is necessary to capture the concentration dependence of cation transport in PEO-LiTFSI.
papers.title_cn: Drude，我的电荷去哪儿了？面向聚合物电解质的可极化 Drude 力场的端到端学习
papers.abs_cn: 固态聚合物电解质的分子动力学模拟需要力场既足够快以在数百纳秒内收敛离子输运，又能准确描述主导离子输运的离子-聚合物相互作用。固定电荷力场满足第一个要求，但忽略了电子极化，而这一效应通常通过经验选择的因子缩放离子电荷来近似。在此，我们提出 AutoDrude，一个可微框架，可直接从 DFT 能量、力和偶极中参数化可极化 Drude 力场，无需经验调参，且成本仅为固定电荷模拟的 1.20 倍。对于 PEO-LiTFSI，偶极约束（硬约束）AutoDrude 模型再现实验离子电导率的准确度与最佳电荷缩放模型相当（平均绝对百分比误差 17% 对 16%）。我们通过拟合一个固定电荷模型，将可极化力场与固定电荷模型进行比较。然而，与此处测试的电荷缩放模型不同，AutoDrude 还能再现稀溶液极限下的阳离子迁移数、其随盐浓度的增加，以及低浓度下不存在 Li-TFSI 接触离子对。基于惩罚项（软约束）的变体对 DFT 参考的拟合更接近，却将电导率低估达一个数量级，表明仅与 DFT 训练数据更接近并不能保证准确的离子输运。这些结果表明，尽管电荷缩放可以再现离子电导率，但显式引入极化对于捕捉 PEO-LiTFSI 中阳离子输运的浓度依赖性仍是必要的。

papers.title: Realizing Two-Dimensional Altermagnets with 100% Spin Polarization along the [110] Direction in Ambidentate-Ligand Based Square Organometallic Lattices
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism, as a novel magnetic paradigm, not only possesses a zero net magnetic moment, but also exhibits a substantial nonrelativistic spin-splitting effect. Currently, developing a simple and experimentally feasible method for designing altermagnets is eagerly pursued. Moreover, achieving 100% spin polarization along certain directions in valence or conduction bands for altermagnets remains challenging. To address these issues, based on a tight-binding model, we propose a viable chemical strategy for constructing organometallic altermagnets by using ambidentate ligands. Furthermore, in these organometallic altermagnets, direction-dependent 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in band edges can be induced via the coexistence of altermagnetically spin-split dispersive and flat bands, where the flat band suppresses electron transport in one spin channel and the dispersive band enables conduction in the other spin channel. Then, via first-principles calculations, a screening of 90 two-dimensional ambidentate-ligand based square organometallic lattices leads to the identification of three altermagnetic materials, namely Fe(taz)2Cl2 (taz = 1,2,4- triazine), Co(app)2Cl2, and Fe(app)2Cl2 (app = 1,4-azaphosphinine), all of which possess 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in valence bands, as well as notable piezomagnetic behavior. This study paves the way for achieving direction-dependent fully spin-polarization in altermagnetic materials.
papers.title_cn: 在基于两可配体的方形有机金属晶格中实现沿[110]方向具有100%自旋极化的二维交错磁体
papers.abs_cn: 交错磁性作为一种新颖的磁性范式，不仅具有零净磁矩，还展现出显著的非相对论性自旋劈裂效应。目前，人们迫切追求开发一种简单且实验可行的交错磁体设计方法。此外，在交错磁体中实现价带或导带沿特定方向的100%自旋极化仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些问题，基于紧束缚模型，我们提出了一种利用两可配体构建有机金属交错磁体的可行化学策略。进一步地，在这些有机金属交错磁体中，通过交错磁自旋劈裂的色散带与平带的共存，可以在带边沿[110]方向诱导出方向依赖的100%自旋极化，其中平带抑制了一个自旋通道中的电子输运，而色散带则允许另一个自旋通道中的导电。随后，通过第一性原理计算，对90种基于两可配体的二维方形有机金属晶格进行筛选，识别出三种交错磁材料，即Fe(taz)2Cl2（taz = 1,2,4-三嗪）、Co(app)2Cl2和Fe(app)2Cl2（app = 1,4-氮杂膦），它们均在价带中沿[110]方向具有100%自旋极化，以及显著的压磁行为。这项研究为实现交错磁材料中方向依赖的完全自旋极化铺平了道路。

papers.title: Dynamic Chemical Changes of Ti3C2Tx MXenes in Halide Perovskite Precursor Environments
papers.abstract: The integration of two-dimensional Ti3C2Tx MXenes into Halide Perovskite (HaP) optoelectronics has shown immense potential for enhancing device performance, yet the fundamental chemical interactions within the precursor ink (a critical stage determining the final material state) remain largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive investigation into the chemical stability and surface evolution of Ti3C2Tx MXenes when exposed to the individual and combined components of a model methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) solution. By combining detailed X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis with Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations, we decouple the complex interactions between MXenes and the ink constituents. We demonstrate that elemental iodine (I2) and polyiodides (In-) act as aggressive oxidizers, triggering rapid degradation and dissolution of the MXene flakes. Conversely, lead iodide (PbI2) induces a slower oxidation process driven by the strong adsorption of Pb2+ ions onto oxygen terminated sites. In stark contrast, methylammonium iodide (MAI) exhibits a stabilizing effect: it adsorbs onto the MXene surface via hydrogen bonding, effectively passivating the flakes and retarding degradation. In addition, our results reveal that the sequence of precursor addition governs the MXene surface state, requiring extra caution, but also enabling further tunability. These findings provide a critical view on how MXene integration with materials, in general, and HaP in particular, should be perceived, providing a fundamental for their rational engineering.
papers.title_cn: Ti3C2Tx MXenes在卤化物钙钛矿前驱体环境中的动态化学变化
papers.abs_cn: 将二维Ti3C2Tx MXenes集成到卤化物钙钛矿（HaP）光电子器件中已展现出提升器件性能的巨大潜力，然而前驱体墨水中（决定最终材料状态的关键阶段）的基本化学相互作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。本研究全面考察了Ti3C2Tx MXenes在暴露于模型甲基铵铅碘（MAPbI3）溶液的单一组分及组合组分时的化学稳定性和表面演化。通过将详细的X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算相结合，我们解耦了MXenes与墨水组分之间复杂的相互作用。我们证明，元素碘（I2）和多碘化物（In-）充当强氧化剂，引发MXene片层的快速降解和溶解。相反，碘化铅（PbI2）诱导一种较慢的氧化过程，其驱动力是Pb2+离子在氧终止位点上的强吸附。与之形成鲜明对比的是，甲基铵碘化物（MAI）表现出稳定效应：它通过氢键吸附到MXene表面，有效钝化片层并延缓降解。此外，我们的结果揭示，前驱体的添加顺序决定了MXene的表面状态，这需要格外谨慎，但也提供了进一步调控的可能性。这些发现为如何看待MXene与材料（一般而言）尤其是与HaP的集成提供了关键视角，为其理性设计奠定了基础。

papers.title: Corrugated Niobene: Stability, Mechanical and Electronic Properties from First-Principles Calculations
papers.abstract: The growing diversity of two-dimensional (2D) materials has expanded opportunities in electronics, energy technologies, catalysis, and optical applications. Within this landscape, understanding how corrugated architectures accommodate metallic bonding and influence the stability and properties of monoelemental niobium sheets remains an open research direction. Here, we propose a corrugated niobene nanosheet, denoted c-Nb, and investigate its structural, energetic, vibrational, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties using density functional theory simulations. The optimized structure adopts a centrosymmetric P-3m1 symmetry, with six atoms per primitive cell and a geometrical thickness of 4.279 Angstrom. Its cohesive energy of -6.03 eV/atom indicates strong binding relative to isolated atoms, although bulk BCC Nb remains energetically favored by 2.49 eV/atom. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies along the investigated high-symmetry path and the positive-definite in-plane stiffness matrix support dynamical and mechanical structural stability. Despite its pronounced corrugation, the nanosheet exhibits isotropic in-plane elasticity, with Young's and shear moduli of 43.66 N/m and 13.66 N/m, respectively, and a Poisson's ratio of 0.598. Electronic states near the Fermi level are dominated by Nb 4d orbitals, establishing multiband metallicity. These findings identify a corrugated structural candidate that combines strong cohesion, elastic compliance, and metallic electronic behavior, extending the structural diversity of monoelemental 2D metals and providing a basis for further exploration of niobium nanosheets in electronic and ultraviolet-responsive systems.
papers.title_cn: 波纹铌烯：基于第一性原理计算的稳定性、力学与电子性质
papers.abs_cn: 二维（2D）材料日益增长的多样性拓展了其在电子学、能源技术、催化和光学应用中的机会。在这一背景下，理解波纹结构如何容纳金属键并影响单元素铌片层的稳定性和性质仍是一个开放的研究方向。在此，我们提出了一种波纹铌烯纳米片，记为 c-Nb，并利用密度泛函理论模拟研究了其结构、能量、振动、力学、电子和光学性质。优化后的结构采用中心对称的 P-3m1 对称性，每个原胞含六个原子，几何厚度为 4.279 Angstrom。其内聚能为 -6.03 eV/atom，表明相对于孤立原子具有强结合，尽管体相 BCC Nb 在能量上仍低 2.49 eV/atom。在所研究的高对称路径上不存在虚声子频率，且面内刚度矩阵为正定，支持了动力学和力学结构稳定性。尽管具有明显的波纹特征，该纳米片仍表现出面内各向同性弹性，杨氏模量和剪切模量分别为 43.66 N/m 和 13.66 N/m，泊松比为 0.598。费米能级附近的电子态主要由 Nb 4d 轨道主导，形成多带金属性。这些发现确定了一种结合强内聚、弹性柔顺和金属电子行为的波纹结构候选材料，扩展了单元素二维金属的结构多样性，并为进一步探索铌纳米片在电子和紫外响应系统中的应用提供了基础。

papers.title: The quantum geometry of the chemical bond
papers.abstract: Electronic properties of materials depend both on band energies and quantum geometry of electronic states. We relate bonding indices to the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), showing how chemical bonding dictates the momentum-space texture of bands, bridging chemical and physical descriptions of solids. We show the QGT decomposed into the three center bond index, weighted by their oriented area. Resolving these contributions by orbital pair reveals the donor--acceptor character that distinguish ionic, covalent, hypervalent, and metavalent bonding. We identify the bonding pattern for topology in materials: noncollinear three center bonds, which are the source of Berry curvature in solids. Bond fluctuation can be directly linked to electromagnetic response by resolving their energy spectrum, opening a quantitative route towards the design of physical properties of materials from bonding motifs.
papers.title_cn: 化学键的量子几何
papers.abs_cn: 材料的电子性质既取决于能带能量，也取决于电子态的量子几何。我们将成键指数与量子几何张量（QGT）联系起来，表明化学键如何决定能带的动量空间织构，从而架起固体的化学描述与物理描述之间的桥梁。我们证明QGT可分解为三中心键指数，并由其有向面积加权。按轨道对分辨这些贡献，揭示了区分离子键、共价键、超价键和金属价键的给体—受体特征。我们识别出材料中拓扑的成键模式：非共线三中心键，它们是固体中Berry曲率的来源。通过分辨键涨落的能谱，可以将其直接与电磁响应联系起来，为从成键基元出发定量设计材料的物理性质开辟了道路。

papers.title: Predicted state-to-state collisional rate coefficients from neural networks
papers.abstract: Molecular spectra observed in the interstellar medium are commonly analyzed using non-local thermodynamic equilibrium models, which requires accurate state-to-state collisional rate coefficients. Close-coupling calculations become prohibitively expensive for transitions from highly excited rotational states, therefore available datasets are often truncated at low initial states and temperatures; and since each new system also requires an accurate ab initio potential energy surface, many detected molecules have no collisional data. We employ two machine learning strategies to predict rotational state-to-state rate coefficients of molecules included in the train set beyond the range of initial states and temperatures computed so far, and predicting those of a molecule absent from training and validation sets. Feed-forward neural networks are trained on state-to-state de-excitation rate coefficients of 24 linear molecules colliding with para-H2. Scheme 1 includes all systems in the train+validation set, with 70%, 80%, and 90% initial-state boundaries and a 90% temperature boundary. Scheme 2 is trained on 22 systems described only by transition and molecular properties, and predicts two excluded systems, CS and CF+, whose astrophysical impact is explored with non-LTE calculations. For the 90% boundary, Scheme 1 predicts 99.4% of the test transitions within a factor of 2, and no prediction deviates from the reference value by more than a factor of 4.7. This model was used to complete 18 datasets. Scheme 2 reproduces the rate coefficients of two excluded systems within a factor of 3 for more than 92% of their transitions. Both schemes provide near-instantaneous complements to close-coupling calculations: Scheme 1 extends the range of a molecule already included in the training set with high accuracy, while Scheme 2 gives a reasonable first estimate for a molecule that has not been studied.
papers.title_cn: 从神经网络预测态-态碰撞速率系数
papers.abs_cn: 在星际介质中观测到的分子光谱通常使用非局部热动平衡模型进行分析，这需要准确的态-态碰撞速率系数。对于来自高激发转动态的跃迁，紧耦合计算变得极其昂贵，因此可用的数据集往往在低初始态和温度处被截断；并且由于每个新系统还需要准确的从头算势能面，许多已探测到的分子没有碰撞数据。我们采用两种机器学习策略来预测训练集中包含的分子的转动态-态速率系数，使其超出迄今为止计算的初始态和温度范围，并预测训练集和验证集中未出现的分子的速率系数。前馈神经网络在24个线性分子与para-H2碰撞的态-态去激发速率系数上进行训练。方案1包含训练+验证集中的所有系统，使用70%、80%和90%的初始态边界以及90%的温度边界。方案2在仅由跃迁和分子性质描述的22个系统上进行训练，并预测两个被排除的系统CS和CF+，其天体物理影响通过非LTE计算进行探索。对于90%边界，方案1预测了99.4%的测试跃迁在2倍因子以内，且没有预测偏离参考值超过4.7倍因子。该模型被用于完成18个数据集。方案2在超过92%的跃迁中，将被排除的两个系统的速率系数重现到3倍因子以内。两种方案都提供了对紧耦合计算的近乎即时补充：方案1以高精度扩展了训练集中已包含的分子的范围，而方案2为尚未研究的分子提供了合理的初步估计。

papers.title: Predictive Synthesis of MOFs and COFs
papers.abstract: Predictive synthesis concerns the prospective modeling of how a targeted structure can be realized. The synthesis of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and covalent organic frameworks (COFs) intrinsically involves a multidimensional space of interdependent variables, posing a challenge for bench chemists to parameterize and predict. In this Perspective, we discuss the evolution from chemical-intuition-driven experimentation toward the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in the laboratory. By virtue of prior knowledge, uncertainty, and experimental failure in determining what should be attempted next, we envision predictive synthesis progressing from static recipe recommendation toward real-time control and transferable principles of framework formation. In this context, the significance lies in transforming trial-and-error practice into a means of measurable chemical reasoning, thereby accelerating crystalline materials discovery and advancing synthetic chemistry.
papers.title_cn: MOFs和COFs的预测性合成
papers.abs_cn: 预测性合成关注的是如何前瞻性地建模以实现目标结构。金属有机框架（MOFs）和共价有机框架（COFs）的合成本质上涉及一个由相互依赖变量构成的多维空间，这给实验化学家带来了参数化和预测的挑战。在本展望中，我们讨论了从化学直觉驱动的实验向实验室中人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）集成的发展演变。鉴于先验知识、不确定性以及实验失败在决定下一步应尝试什么方面的作用，我们设想预测性合成将从静态配方推荐发展到实时控制和可迁移的框架形成原则。在此背景下，其意义在于将试错实践转变为一种可测量的化学推理手段，从而加速晶态材料的发现并推动合成化学的进步。

papers.title: Homogeneous to multi-scale inhomogeneous complex magnetism in Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho), Revealed by muSR and Machine-Learned Muon-Site Calculations
papers.abstract: We report a comprehensive muon spin rotation and relaxation (muSR) study of the hexagonal 6H-perovskites Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho) to investigate the role of rare-earth anisotropy in the magnetic ground state of 4d-4f coupled systems. Ba3HoRu2O9 exhibits two successive magnetic orderings at TN1 = 46 K and TN2 = 10 K, leading to a complex magnetic ground state, whereas Ba3GdRu2O9, with Gd3+ (L = 0) S-state ions, shows primarily single magnetic ordering at TN = 14.5 K. Zero-field (ZF) and longitudinal-field (LF) muSR measurements reveal markedly different magnetic behavior despite their structural similarity. Ba3HoRu2O9 displays a multi-scale inhomogeneous magnetic state characterized by two-component exponential relaxation, broad local-field distributions, incomplete LF decoupling, and persistent spin dynamics. The muSR results identify two characteristic magnetic energy scales near 46 and 10 K, associated with correlated Ru-Ho interactions and quasistatic magnetic ordering, respectively. Redfield analysis further demonstrates strong local magnetic fields and distributed spin fluctuation timescales, confirming magnetic inhomogeneity. Machine-learning-assisted muon-site and dipolar-field calculations show that the broad field distribution naturally arises from muons sensing distinct coexisting magnetic domains at different structural sites. In contrast, Ba3GdRu2O9 exhibits a comparatively homogeneous antiferromagnetic ground state below 14.5 K, with Gaussian relaxation consistent with a narrow static field distribution. These results establish that the rare-earth ion in Ba3LnRu2O9 is a powerful tuning parameter, driving the ground state from homogeneous to complex, multi-scale inhomogeneous behavior through competing 4d-4f magnetic interactions.
papers.title_cn: 通过 muSR 和机器学习辅助的缪子位点计算揭示 Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho) 中从均匀到多尺度非均匀复杂磁性
papers.abs_cn: 我们报道了对六方 6H-钙钛矿 Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho) 的全面缪子自旋旋转与弛豫 (muSR) 研究，以探究稀土各向异性在 4d-4f 耦合体系磁基态中的作用。Ba3HoRu2O9 在 TN1 = 46 K 和 TN2 = 10 K 处表现出两次连续磁有序，导致复杂的磁基态；而具有 Gd3+ (L = 0) S 态离子的 Ba3GdRu2O9 则主要表现出单一磁有序，TN = 14.5 K。零场 (ZF) 和纵向场 (LF) muSR 测量表明，尽管两者结构相似，其磁行为却显著不同。Ba3HoRu2O9 表现出多尺度非均匀磁态，其特征为双组分指数弛豫、宽局域场分布、不完全 LF 解耦以及持续自旋动力学。muSR 结果识别出两个特征磁能标，分别位于 46 和 10 K 附近，分别与关联的 Ru-Ho 相互作用和准静态磁有序相关。Redfield 分析进一步表明存在强局域磁场和分布式自旋涨落时间尺度，证实了磁非均匀性。机器学习辅助的缪子位点和偶极场计算表明，宽场分布自然来源于缪子在不同结构位点探测到共存的不同磁畴。相比之下，Ba3GdRu2O9 在 14.5 K 以下表现出相对均匀的反铁磁基态，其高斯弛豫与窄静态场分布一致。这些结果确立了 Ba3LnRu2O9 中的稀土离子是一个强有力的调控参数，通过竞争的 4d-4f 磁相互作用驱动基态从均匀行为转变为复杂的多尺度非均匀行为。

papers.title: Bayesian Sampling of Structural Ensembles: The Role of Ensemble-Counting Measures
papers.abstract: Structural ensemble refinement is widely used to integrate molecular simulations with experimental measurements. While most applications focus on the maximum-a-posteriori (MAP) ensemble, Bayesian sampling of the posterior distribution can provide uncertainty estimates and posterior averages for arbitrary observables. A notable step in this direction was introduced by the Bayesian Energy Landscape Tilting (BELT) framework, where sampling is performed on a family of maximum-entropy ensembles parametrized by Lagrange multipliers. Here, we show that Bayesian sampling in this setting requires an explicit choice of ensemble-counting measure. In particular, the flat measure in Lagrange-multiplier space used in the original BELT formulation leads to a posterior distribution that is formally non-normalizable for finite reference trajectories. We propose the Jeffreys measure as an invariant ensemble-counting prescription, restoring normalizability in the finite-sample situations considered here, and providing a consistent definition of posterior averages. Using both an analytically tractable Gaussian model and maximum-entropy refinement of RNA oligomer simulations, we compare different ensemble-counting measures and show that they can significantly affect Bayesian estimates. The resulting methodology has been implemented in the \texttt{MDRefine} software package.
papers.title_cn: 结构系综的贝叶斯采样：系综计数测度的作用
papers.abs_cn: 结构系综精修被广泛用于将分子模拟与实验测量相结合。虽然大多数应用关注最大后验（MAP）系综，但对后验分布的贝叶斯采样可以提供不确定性估计以及任意可观测量在后验下的平均值。贝叶斯能量景观倾斜（BELT）框架在这一方向上迈出了显著的一步，其中采样是在由拉格朗日乘子参数化的一族最大熵系综上进行的。在这里，我们表明，在此设定下的贝叶斯采样需要显式选择一种系综计数测度。特别地，原始 BELT 表述中使用的拉格朗日乘子空间中的平坦测度会导致后验分布在有限参考轨迹下形式上不可归一化。我们提出 Jeffreys 测度作为一种不变的系综计数规定，在本文所考虑的有限样本情形下恢复了可归一化性，并为后验平均提供了自洽的定义。我们使用一个可解析处理的高斯模型以及对 RNA 寡聚体模拟的最大熵精修，比较了不同的系综计数测度，并表明它们会显著影响贝叶斯估计。由此得到的方法已在 \texttt{MDRefine} 软件包中实现。

papers.title: Theory of Disorder-Induced Multimode Coupling in a Fabry-Pérot Cavity
papers.abstract: Strong light--matter interactions have attracted significant interest in physical chemistry due to the potential for modifying molecular processes by hybridizing with cavity photons and forming polaritonic states. However, for a disordered molecular ensemble within an optical cavity capable of supporting multiple photon modes, theoretical understanding of multimode polaritons remains incomplete, particularly regarding whether and how distinct photon modes are mutually coupled through molecules. In this work, we generalize the collective mode expansion formalism to incorporate multiple photonic modes and show that spatial and orientational disorder in the light--matter coupling strength (originating from dipole orientation fluctuations and photonic field inhomogeneity) can mediate cross-mode coupling. This disorder-induced coupling allows for energy transfer to otherwise unexcited photon modes through a mechanism termed disorder-induced multimode activation (DIMA). Using an effective one-dimensional Fabry--Pérot cavity as a test system, we demonstrate that the cross-mode energy transfer through DIMA can be controlled by changing the molecular layer thickness and the optical properties of the mirrors. Furthermore, we show that DIMA is robust against weak energetic disorder. This mechanistic understanding lays the foundation for a systematic control of multimode photon coupling using disorder-induced effects.
papers.title_cn: Fabry-Pérot 腔中无序诱导多模耦合的理论
papers.abs_cn: 强光-物质相互作用在物理化学领域引起了广泛关注，因为其有望通过与腔光子杂化并形成极化激元态来调控分子过程。然而，对于能够支持多个光子模式的光学腔内的无序分子集合，多模极化激元的理论理解仍不完整，特别是关于不同光子模式是否以及如何通过分子相互耦合的问题。在本工作中，我们将集体模式展开形式推广至包含多个光子模式的情形，并表明光-物质耦合强度中的空间无序和取向无序（源于偶极取向涨落和光子场不均匀性）可以介导跨模式耦合。这种无序诱导耦合通过一种称为无序诱导多模激活（DIMA）的机制，允许能量转移至原本未被激发的光子模式。我们以有效一维 Fabry-Pérot 腔作为测试体系，证明通过 DIMA 实现的跨模式能量转移可以通过改变分子层厚度和反射镜的光学性质来调控。此外，我们还表明 DIMA 对弱能量无序具有鲁棒性。这一机理理解为利用无序诱导效应系统性地调控多模光子耦合奠定了基础。

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs for Translating Legacy Fortran Atmospheric Physics to GPU-Accelerated JAX
papers.abstract: Legacy Fortran physics packages in atmospheric models such as CESM, WRF, and E3SM pose a barrier to GPU modernization, while manual porting requires accelerator-programming expertise. We present LAFT (LLM-Assisted Fortran Translation), an agentic framework for converting Fortran atmospheric physics parameterizations into GPU-accelerated JAX while preserving numerical agreement with the Fortran reference. LAFT coordinates source-code analysis, translation, repair, runtime validation, and performance profiling. It combines a deterministic front end for metadata extraction and bridge generation, structured translation prompts, numerical validation, and profiling-guided feedback to identify inefficient execution patterns. The bridge handles array-layout conversion separately from scientific computation. We evaluate LAFT using the Kessler warm-rain microphysics scheme and four LLMs: Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen. All four validated translations reproduce the Fortran reference outputs to near floating-point precision for the evaluated case, but their GPU performance differs substantially with execution design. The Gemini-generated implementation achieves up to a 357-fold speedup over serial Fortran in cached execution at 1,000,000 atmospheric columns, excluding compilation and host-device transfers. The results demonstrate that numerical agreement alone does not ensure efficient GPU execution and motivate combining numerical validation with hardware-aware performance analysis. LAFT provides a practical workflow for modernizing legacy atmospheric physics code through LLM-assisted translation, deterministic interface generation, automated validation and repair, and reproducible profiling.
papers.title_cn: 评估LLM将遗留Fortran大气物理代码翻译为GPU加速的JAX
papers.abs_cn: CESM、WRF和E3SM等大气模型中的遗留Fortran物理包构成了GPU现代化的障碍，而手动移植需要加速器编程专业知识。我们提出了LAFT（LLM辅助Fortran翻译），一个将Fortran大气物理参数化转换为GPU加速JAX的智能体框架，同时保持与Fortran参考的数值一致性。LAFT协调源代码分析、翻译、修复、运行时验证和性能分析。它结合了用于元数据提取和桥接生成的确定性前端、结构化翻译提示、数值验证以及分析引导的反馈来识别低效执行模式。桥接将数组布局转换与科学计算分开处理。我们使用Kessler暖雨微物理方案和四个LLM评估LAFT：Claude、GPT、Gemini和Qwen。所有四个经过验证的翻译在评估案例中都能以接近浮点精度的水平复现Fortran参考输出，但它们的GPU性能因执行设计而差异显著。Gemini生成的实现在1,000,000个大气柱的缓存执行中，排除编译和主机-设备传输，相比串行Fortran实现了高达357倍的加速。结果表明，仅数值一致并不能确保高效的GPU执行，并促使将数值验证与硬件感知性能分析相结合。LAFT通过LLM辅助翻译、确定性接口生成、自动验证和修复以及可复现的性能分析，为现代化遗留大气物理代码提供了实用工作流程。

papers.title: Fourier Transform-Based Computation of Two-Electron Four-Center Coulomb Repulsion Integrals
papers.abstract: We present a Fourier-based method for evaluating two-electron four-center Coulomb repulsion integrals over Slater-type orbitals. Spherical Fourier-Bessel coefficients of the convolution factors are precomputed and reused. Since the spherical part of the integral can be evaluated directly, there remains only a one-dimensional quadrature problem in the radial direction. For the ten reference integrals reported here, the largest absolute discrepancy is $1.7\times10^{-9}$. A preliminary resident-cache benchmark computes approximately $4.2\times10^5$ unique integrals per second on an NVIDIA V100 at the contraction stage.
papers.title_cn: 基于傅里叶变换的双电子四中心库仑排斥积分计算
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了一种基于傅里叶的方法，用于计算Slater型轨道上的双电子四中心库仑排斥积分。卷积因子的球面傅里叶-贝塞尔系数被预先计算并重复使用。由于积分的球面部分可以直接计算，因此只剩下径向方向的一维求积问题。对于本文报道的十个参考积分，最大绝对偏差为 1.7×10^-9。一个初步的常驻缓存基准测试在 NVIDIA V100 上于收缩阶段每秒计算约 4.2×10^5 个唯一积分。

papers.title: Parallel Design of a GPU-Resident Semi-Lagrangian Drift-Kinetic Solver on Unstructured Extruded Tokamak Meshes
papers.abstract: Semi-Lagrangian (SL) schemes advect a distribution function along characteristics and remap it to a fixed grid. They are unconditionally stable without a global solve, and with discontinuous Galerkin (DG) integration the transfer along a magnetic field line conserves mass exactly. This paper presents the parallel and GPU design of a 3X+2V SLDG drift-kinetic tokamak solver on unstructured, flux-surface-aligned poloidal planes of shaped cross section, extruded toroidally. Transport follows magnetic field lines across the planes, and each velocity channel advances a fixed distance per step, proportional to its parallel speed, so the halo depth a channel needs grows with its speed. Velocity-dependent ragged halos exploit this, sending each channel only its own upwind depth. The 4D decomposition includes the toroidal angle, the 2D poloidal plane and the magnetic moment, and leaves the parallel velocity whole: no stage transports across the magnetic moment, while a parallel-velocity partition would put a halo inside the acceleration stage. On NVIDIA A100s the design strong-scales over the magnetic-moment axis from one to 12 four-GPU nodes, and a weak series of three points refining all five phase-space dimensions together, 16x in total per series point, holds a weak-scaling efficiency of 75% on 16 GPUs and 57% on 256, from a one-GPU base case. The pointwise interpolations within the poloidal plane do not conserve mass, and the full step's mass drift stays below 2.1x10^-5 at every series point. The design was implemented with an AI code assistant under a machine-checked regression discipline, in which every change is held to one of four exactness classes, from bit-identical to a physics rate within a stated tolerance.
papers.title_cn: 在非结构挤出托卡马克网格上GPU驻留的半拉格朗日漂移动理学求解器的并行设计
papers.abs_cn: 半拉格朗日（SL）格式沿特征线对流分布函数并将其重映射到固定网格。它们无条件稳定且无需全局求解，而采用间断伽辽金（DG）积分时，沿磁力线的传输精确守恒质量。本文介绍了在非结构、通量面 aligned 的极向平面（具有成形截面，沿环向挤出）上的3X+2V SLDG漂移动理学托卡马克求解器的并行与GPU设计。输运沿磁力线跨越平面，每个速度通道每步推进固定距离，与其平行速度成正比，因此通道所需的halo深度随其速度增长。速度相关的锯齿状halo利用这一点，每个通道只发送自己的迎风深度。四维分解包括环向角、二维极向平面和磁矩，并保持平行速度完整：没有阶段跨越磁矩传输，而平行速度划分会在加速阶段内部放置halo。在NVIDIA A100上，该设计在磁矩轴上从1个到12个四GPU节点进行强扩展，而一个弱扩展系列（三个点同时细化所有五个相空间维度，每个系列点总计16倍）在16个GPU上保持75%的弱扩展效率，在256个GPU上保持57%，基准为单GPU情况。极向平面内的逐点插值不守恒质量，整个步长的质量漂移在每个系列点均低于2.1x10^-5。该设计是在AI代码助手的辅助下，在机器检查的回归纪律下实现的，其中每个更改都被限制在四个精确性类别之一，从位完全相同到在指定容差内的物理速率。

papers.title: An all-transistor physical-learning transformer can be trained to perform in-context learning
papers.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. We show that in simulations this circuit can be trained to perform a simple in-context learning task, despite using realistic reverse components which transmit only an approximate gradient. For this training to succeed we need cross-entropy loss (not mean squared error). We generate nudges appropriate for this loss using a novel floating circuit element, based on the same MOSFET sub-circuit used for softmax. We train the resistors in this circuit using the Lion optimiser, which can be implemented using one capacitor per parameter to store local memory of past gradient estimates.
papers.title_cn: 全晶体管物理学习变压器可被训练执行上下文学习
papers.abs_cn: 大多数通过平衡传播或耦合学习训练的系统与多层感知机属于同一类：虽然它们可能是通用函数逼近器，但难以学习变压器易于处理的关联任务。平衡传播依赖于信息在物理系统中通过输入和输出之间的双向流动。更复杂的非线性系统会破坏反向流动，例如执行乘法运算的系统，而乘法是表达点积注意力所必需的。在这里，我们通过将额外的电路元件引入双电路或二元电路，明确地恢复了这种双向流动。然后，我们利用这些思想构建了一种利用亚阈值 MOSFET 器件的指数电流定律的注意力机制。我们表明，在模拟中，该电路可以被训练执行一个简单的上下文学习任务，尽管使用了仅传输近似梯度的现实反向组件。为了使这种训练成功，我们需要交叉熵损失（而不是均方误差）。我们使用一种新颖的浮动电路元件生成适合这种损失的微调信号，该元件基于用于 softmax 的相同 MOSFET 子电路。我们使用 Lion 优化器训练该电路中的电阻器，该优化器可以通过每个参数一个电容器来实现，以存储过去梯度估计的局部记忆。

papers.title: Enhanced Coulomb pseudopotentials in high-pressure hydrides from first principles
papers.abstract: In the Eliashberg theory of superconductivity, Coulomb interactions oppose the phonon-mediated attraction and suppress the superconducting critical temperature $T_{\mathrm{c}}$. However, most first-principles predictions continue to treat this repulsion with an empirical Coulomb pseudopotential $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ in the range 0.1-0.15. Here we present first-principles calculations of the Coulomb parameter $μ$ and pseudopotential $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ in superconducting hydrides across a range of pressures. The screened Coulomb interaction is evaluated at the random phase approximation level with the Mantel code. We demonstrate that several hydride systems, including H$_3$S, YSbH$_6$ and Mg$_2$IrH$_6$, have strong Coulomb repulsions driven by a large density of states at the Fermi energy, $N_{\mathrm{F}}$. For Mg$_2$IrH$_6$ we obtain $μ=0.62$ and $μ^*_{\text{ME}}\approx0.39$, leading to a 40 K suppression in $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ relative to a standard $μ^*_{\text{ME}}=0.16$. Our obtained $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ is far above the conventional range and, accounting for the energy dependence of the density of states, resolves the factor-of-two discrepancy between $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ estimates of previous studies. Across all systems and pressures studied, we find that $μ$ closely tracks $N_{\mathrm{F}}$, suggesting that commonly used $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ values lead to overestimated $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ in materials where the density of states at the Fermi energy is large.
papers.title_cn: 高压氢化物中增强的库仑赝势：第一性原理研究
papers.abs_cn: 在超导的Eliashberg理论中，库仑相互作用与声子介导的吸引作用相对抗，并抑制超导临界温度 $T_{\mathrm{c}}$。然而，大多数第一性原理预测仍然使用经验库仑赝势 $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$（范围在0.1-0.15）来处理这种排斥作用。在此，我们展示了超导氢化物在一系列压力下库仑参数 $μ$ 和赝势 $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ 的第一性原理计算。屏蔽库仑相互作用在随机相位近似水平下使用Mantel代码进行评估。我们证明，包括H$_3$S、YSbH$_6$和Mg$_2$IrH$_6$在内的多个氢化物体系具有由费米能处大态密度 $N_{\mathrm{F}}$ 驱动的强库仑排斥。对于Mg$_2$IrH$_6$，我们得到 $μ=0.62$ 和 $μ^*_{\text{ME}}\approx0.39$，相对于标准 $μ^*_{\text{ME}}=0.16$，导致 $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ 被抑制40 K。我们得到的 $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ 远高于传统范围，并且通过考虑态密度的能量依赖性，解决了先前研究中 $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ 估计值之间两倍的差异。在所有研究的体系和压力下，我们发现 $μ$ 与 $N_{\mathrm{F}}$ 密切关联，这表明在费米能处态密度较大的材料中，常用的 $μ^*_{\text{ME}}$ 值会导致 $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ 被高估。

papers.title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
papers.abstract: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.
papers.title_cn: Bi-FORK：高维分岔系统的生成建模
papers.abs_cn: 分岔在物理系统中无处不在，从结构屈曲到流体和气候动力学，但在深度学习中仍很大程度上未被探索。在对称破缺分岔处，单个输入允许多个同样有效的解，违反了大多数学习型物理代理模型所依赖的一对一假设。我们提出了 Bi-FORK，一个用于学习高维系统中这些一对多解映射的生成框架。Bi-FORK 通过潜在流匹配生成完整轨迹，保持空间和时间连贯性，并使用排斥引导采样在单次摊销过程中恢复不同的解分支。我们在屈曲梁、机械超材料和 Allen-Cahn 相分离上评估了 Bi-FORK，涵盖了连续、离散和场值分岔，离散化点数高达 260,000。Bi-FORK 恢复了多模态解结构，同时将规模扩展到比先前方法高出几个数量级，为高维分岔物理系统打开了生成建模的大门。

papers.title: Broadband and Large-Multimode Quantum Optical Storage with Rare-Earth Ions in Solids
papers.abstract: Broadband quantum memory devices are essential elements for future quantum networks. Here we propose a broadband quantum memory scheme called Hole Anti-hole Grating Echo Memory (HAGEM) for rare-earth ions in solids, which can be implemented with most of the present rare-earth ions hosted in various types of solids. Using HAGEM, a quantum memory device with one billion temporal modes per second can be developed with current available technologies. To validate the memory protocol, we conducted some proof-of-concept experiments. We provide a Eu$^\text{3+}$ molecular complex with special hyperfine level structures of which the hyperfine level separations are in a specific mathematical correlation that can be obtained by harnessing chemical engineering. Using the proposed memory protocol and material, we experimentally demonstrate a single-mode quantum optical storage efficiency of 14.9% and a memory bandwidth of 200MHz, which can easily be extended to a few GHz. In addition, a multi-mode storage of four temporal modes is achieved with a storage efficiency of 1.3%. Broadband & large-multimode quantum memory device with a long storage time enabled by HAGEM integrating with the current available entangled photon pair source and tunable delay lines, a quantum repeater network with an entanglement distribution rate on the order of 1kHz - 10kHz can be created with a communication distance around 100km. This will greatly facilitate the development of quantum networks in near future.
papers.title_cn: 基于固态稀土离子的宽带大模式数量子光存储
papers.abs_cn: 宽带量子存储器是未来量子网络的关键元件。本文提出了一种用于固态稀土离子的宽带量子存储方案，称为空穴反空穴光栅回波存储器（HAGEM），该方案可利用大多数现有稀土离子在各种固态基质中实现。利用HAGEM，基于当前可用技术可开发出每秒十亿个时间模式的量子存储器件。为验证该存储协议，我们进行了一些概念验证实验。我们提供了一种具有特殊超精细能级结构的Eu$^\text{3+}$分子配合物，其超精细能级间距满足特定的数学关联，可通过化学工程手段获得。利用所提出的存储协议和材料，我们实验演示了14.9%的单模量子光存储效率和200MHz的存储带宽，且该带宽可轻松扩展至几GHz。此外，还实现了四个时间模式的多模存储，存储效率为1.3%。通过将HAGEM与当前可用的纠缠光子对源和可调延迟线集成，可构建具有长存储时间的宽带大模式数量子存储器件，从而在约100km通信距离下创建纠缠分发速率在1kHz-10kHz量级的量子中继网络。这将极大促进近期量子网络的发展。

papers.title: A neural characteristic mapping method: Lagrangian PINNs based on flow maps for transport-dominated problems
papers.abstract: We propose a novel numerical method for transport-dominated problems using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). In such problems, the solution can develop large gradients and fine structures over time. This is particularly challenging for classical PINNs, which represent the solution itself. In our approach, rather than the solution, we choose to approximate the flow map of the equation. The solution is then recovered by pulling back the exact initial condition, so that its fine structures are produced by the map rather than represented by the network. Our method is constructed by approximating the flow map of the equation with multiple PINNs, one per time subinterval, and composing them using the semigroup property of the flow, so that each network only has to represent a map close to the identity. To highlight the advantages of our method compared to classical PINNs or classical numerical schemes, we present numerical results on the linear advection equation, the incompressible Euler equation in vorticity formulation, the Vlasov-Poisson equation, and finally a drift-kinetic equation.
papers.title_cn: 一种神经特征映射方法：基于流映射的拉格朗日PINNs用于输运主导问题
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了一种使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解输运主导问题的新数值方法。在这类问题中，解随时间可能发展出大梯度和精细结构。这对经典PINNs尤为困难，因为经典PINNs表示的是解本身。在我们的方法中，我们选择逼近方程的流映射，而不是解本身。然后通过拉回精确的初始条件来恢复解，从而使其精细结构由映射产生，而不是由网络表示。我们的方法通过用多个PINNs逼近方程的流映射来构造，每个时间子区间一个PINN，并利用流的半群性质将它们复合起来，使得每个网络只需表示一个接近恒等的映射。为了突出我们的方法相较于经典PINNs或经典数值格式的优势，我们展示了在线性平流方程、涡量形式不可压缩Euler方程、Vlasov-Poisson方程以及最后的漂移动理学方程上的数值结果。

papers.title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
papers.abstract: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.
papers.title_cn: 先验还是反馈？LLM 在适配神经算子时使用什么
papers.abs_cn: LLM 科学智能体是仅依赖其初始任务上下文，还是根据实验反馈调整其决策？我们在神经算子适配中研究这一问题，其中大语言模型（LLM）在有限的试验预算下选择微调配置。在偏微分方程（PDE）族内部及之间的迁移中，LLM 在几乎所有匹配比较中都取得了比随机搜索和贝叶斯优化更低的留出测试 nRMSE。仅凭最终性能无法区分发生了什么，因此我们通过受控干预来验证每一项归因。在观察到任何验证分数之前，LLM 的首次配置已经在相应随机搜索池中排名接近顶部，表明存在有用的初始偏置。一项互补的冷启动干预表明，所选基础学习率会随 PDE 描述而变化。一旦反馈可用，在已评估配置之间重新分配验证分数，会在所有测试案例中改变下一次提议，而保持数值不变的改写则不会产生可比的总体效应。这些干预确立，LLM 的决策级行动会响应给定任务和观察到的结果，表明它结合了任务依赖的先验与对实验反馈的敏感性。

papers.title: MERCE: Method-Space Correlation Energy Extrapolation toward High-Rank Coupled Cluster Accuracy
papers.abstract: Energy extrapolation is a well-established strategy for approaching quantum-chemical limits without performing prohibitively expensive calculations. Complete basis set extrapolation is widely used, whereas extrapolation across electronic structure methods remains much less developed. Method-Space Effective-Rank Correlation Energy Extrapolation (MERCE) is introduced as an adaptive effective-rank framework for estimating high-rank finite-basis correlation energies from second-order Moller-Plesset perturbation theory (MP2), coupled cluster with single and double excitations (CCSD), and CCSD with perturbative triples [CCSD(T)]. The method assigns adaptive effective ranks to MP2 and CCSD(T) from the local MP2-CCSD-CCSD(T) correlation energy pattern and fits a compact three-point extrapolation form for each system. A hierarchical model-selection protocol balances cross-dataset transferability, maximum dataset-level mean absolute error (MAE) ratios, robustness on developmental sets referenced to full configuration interaction (FCI), size-consistency defects, and performance for A24 noncovalent interaction energies. Across the chemically diverse benchmarks used during model development, the selected MERCE model substantially reduces CCSD(T) errors and frequently improves upon the tested higher-rank coupled cluster baselines. Transferability is further assessed using calculations performed only after the functional form and parameters were frozen. Formal nonadditivity is quantified using artificial noninteracting pairs and the actual A24 and selected S66 component calculations.
papers.title_cn: MERCE：面向高秩耦合簇精度的方法空间相关能外推
papers.abs_cn: 能量外推是一种成熟的策略，用于在不进行过于昂贵的计算的情况下逼近量子化学极限。完全基组外推被广泛使用，而跨电子结构方法的外推则发展得远远不够。方法空间有效秩相关能外推（MERCE）被引入作为一种自适应有效秩框架，用于从二阶Moller-Plesset微扰理论（MP2）、单双激发耦合簇（CCSD）以及带微扰三激发的CCSD [CCSD(T)] 估计高秩有限基组相关能。该方法根据局部MP2-CCSD-CCSD(T)相关能模式为MP2和CCSD(T)分配自适应有效秩，并为每个体系拟合一个紧凑的三点外推形式。分层模型选择协议在跨数据集可迁移性、最大数据集级平均绝对误差（MAE）比率、以完全组态相互作用（FCI）为参考的开发集上的稳健性、尺寸一致性缺陷以及A24非共价相互作用能表现之间进行平衡。在模型开发过程中使用的化学多样性基准上，所选MERCE模型显著降低了CCSD(T)误差，并经常优于所测试的更高秩耦合簇基线。可迁移性进一步通过仅在函数形式和参数冻结之后才执行的计算进行评估。形式非可加性通过人工非相互作用对以及实际A24和选定S66组分计算进行量化。

papers.title: The Stability of Rutile Oxides for Oxygen Evolution Catalysis: From Mechanistic Understanding to New Descriptors
papers.abstract: Polymer electrolyte water electrolysis is considered as a pivotal technology for green hydrogen production. Iridium dioxide (IrO2) serves as the benchmark electrocatalyst for the anodic oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in these cells. However, the scarcity and cost of iridium drives efforts to find durable and cost-effective replacements or drastically reduce the iridium loading. While ruthenium dioxide (RuO2) offers comparable activity, its practical utility is impacted by its stability being inferior to IrO2. The presented computational study analyzes the metal-oxygen bond strengths in bulk IrO2 and RuO2 to provide insights into the electronic origins of their differing stabilities.
