Through a comparative analysis of the electronic structure of bulk rutile IrO2, RuO2, and selected MO2 systems, it is able to discriminate the covalent and ionic contributions to the metal-oxygen bond using crystal-orbital-derived electronic descriptors.
papers.title_cn: 金红石型氧化物在析氧催化中的稳定性：从机理理解到新描述符
papers.abs_cn: 聚合物电解质水电解被认为是绿色制氢的关键技术。二氧化铱（IrO2）是这些电解池中阳极析氧反应（OER）的基准电催化剂。然而，铱的稀缺性和成本推动了寻找耐用且具有成本效益的替代品或大幅降低铱载量的努力。虽然二氧化钌（RuO2）具有相当的活性，但其稳定性不如IrO2，影响了其实际应用。本计算研究分析了块体IrO2和RuO2中的金属-氧键强度，以深入了解它们稳定性差异的电子起源。通过对块体金红石型IrO2、RuO2以及选定的MO2体系的电子结构进行比较分析，能够利用源自晶体轨道的电子描述符区分金属-氧键的共价和离子贡献。

papers.title: Transducing quantum-spin-ice correlations into Weyl Fermi-arc transport at a synthetic Kondo lattice interface
papers.abstract: Quantum spin ice hosts collective excitations and quantum fluctuations that are largely electrically silent because the materials supporting them are insulating. Coupling this magnetic environment to surface-localized Weyl states offers a route to encode its correlations directly into Fermi-arc transport. Experimental access to this regime, however, has remained largely unexplored. Here, we realize a synthetic Kondo lattice interface between the Weyl semimetal $\mathrm{Eu_2Ir_2O_7}$ and the quantum-spin-ice candidate $\mathrm{Tb_2Ti_2O_7}$, and demonstrate that quantum-spin-ice correlations are imprinted on Weyl Fermi-arc transport. At ultra-low temperature, electronic transport evolves from a sixfold anisotropic response at low field into a twelvefold response over an intermediate field window, before entering a reentrant sixfold anisotropy at high field. No analogous twelvefold response occurs at the classical-spin-ice interface. The quantum--classical contrast shows that the same itinerant electronic channel acquires qualitatively different symmetry information when interacting with the quantum-fluctuating Tb moments, consistent with an interfacial coupling between the Weyl surface states and the transverse, multipolar degrees of freedom, in addition to the longitudinal, dipolar contribution. Our work establishes synthetic Kondo lattice interfaces as a route for transducing frustrated quantum magnetism with multipole correlations into distinct Weyl Fermi-arc transport responses.
papers.title_cn: 在合成近藤晶格界面处将量子自旋冰关联转换为Weyl费米弧输运
papers.abs_cn: 量子自旋冰承载着集体激发和量子涨落，但由于支撑它们的材料是绝缘的，这些激发和涨落在电学上基本是沉默的。将这种磁性环境与表面局域化的Weyl态耦合，为将其关联直接编码到费米弧输运中提供了一条途径。然而，对这一区域的实验探索在很大程度上仍未被开展。在此，我们实现了Weyl半金属 $\mathrm{Eu_2Ir_2O_7}$ 与量子自旋冰候选材料 $\mathrm{Tb_2Ti_2O_7}$ 之间的合成近藤晶格界面，并证明量子自旋冰关联被印刻到了Weyl费米弧输运上。在超低温下，电子输运从低场下的六重各向异性响应演变为中间场窗口内的十二重响应，随后在高场下进入回归的六重各向异性。在经典自旋冰界面处没有出现类似的十二重响应。量子与经典的对比表明，同一个巡游电子通道在与量子涨落的Tb矩相互作用时获得了定性不同的对称性信息，这与Weyl表面态和横向多极自由度之间的界面耦合一致，此外还有纵向偶极贡献。我们的工作确立了合成近藤晶格界面作为一条途径，可将具有多极关联的阻挫量子磁性转换为独特的Weyl费米弧输运响应。

papers.title: Theory of the CH$_\text{S}^-$ Defect in MoS$_2$ Confirming the Origin of the Quantum Emission
papers.abstract: Establishing the microscopic origin of localized emission in two-dimensional materials through consistent agreement between experiment and theory remains challenging. Recent STM/STS-STML measurements assigned an emission near 1.8 eV in monolayer MoS$_2$/hBN(2L)/graphene to the negatively charged CH$_\mathrm{S}^{-}$ defect. However, a comprehensive theoretical description of this emitter is still lacking. Here, we develop such a description and systematically investigate the photophysical properties of CH$_\mathrm{S}^{-}$ in monolayer MoS$_2$, two bilayer configurations, and a MoS$_2$/hBN heterostructure. The defect retains a similar local geometry and favors a singlet ground state in all four environments, whereas its electronic transition, zero-phonon line, electron-phonon coupling, radiative lifetime, and transition-dipole orientation depend strongly on the surrounding layers. The isolated-monolayer model exhibits substantial structural reorganization and produces a broad, dominant phonon sideband that is inconsistent with experiment. Adding an adjacent layer, either MoS$_2$ or hBN, substantially suppresses the phonon sideband, with only a minor dependence on the defect position in bilayer MoS$_2$. In particular, the MoS$_2$/hBN model yields a weak phonon sideband and closely reproduces the experimental photoluminescence lineshape. Our results thus provide the first theoretical agreement of CH$_\mathrm{S}^{-}$ emission and further reveal the role of adjacent layers in determining the electronic, vibronic, and optical properties of the quantum emitters in two-dimensional materials.
papers.title_cn: MoS$_2$ 中 CH$_{\text{S}}^-$ 缺陷的理论确认量子发射的起源
papers.abs_cn: 通过实验与理论的一致吻合来确定二维材料中局域发射的微观起源仍然具有挑战性。最近的 STM/STS-STML 测量将单层 MoS$_2$/hBN(2L)/石墨烯中约 1.8 eV 的发射归因于带负电的 CH$_\mathrm{S}^{-}$ 缺陷。然而，对该发射体的全面理论描述仍然缺乏。在此，我们建立了这样的描述，并系统研究了 CH$_\mathrm{S}^{-}$ 在单层 MoS$_2$、两种双层构型以及 MoS$_2$/hBN 异质结构中的光物理性质。该缺陷在所有四种环境中保持相似的局域几何结构，并倾向于单重态基态，而其电子跃迁、零声子线、电子-声子耦合、辐射寿命和跃迁偶极取向强烈依赖于周围层。孤立单层模型表现出显著的结构重组，并产生与实验不一致的宽大主导声子边带。加入相邻层（无论是 MoS$_2$ 还是 hBN）会显著抑制声子边带，且对双层 MoS$_2$ 中缺陷位置的依赖性较小。特别是，MoS$_2$/hBN 模型产生弱的声子边带，并紧密再现了实验光致发光线型。因此，我们的结果首次在理论上与 CH$_\mathrm{S}^{-}$ 发射达成一致，并进一步揭示了相邻层在决定二维材料中量子发射体的电子、振动和光学性质中的作用。

papers.title: A Universal Polybromide Melt Strategy for the Direct Conversion of Metals into Optoelectronic-Grade Bromide Perovskites
papers.abstract: Halide perovskite systems require specific metal oxidation states (M2+ or M+/M3+ pairs), limiting processing flexibility during traditional synthesis and posing stability challenges for multivalent metals like Sn, Cu, and Au. This work anchors a profound paradigm shift: a universal, single-step, organic-solvent free synthetic platform that directly converts stable elemental metal films into bromide perovskite and perovskite-related systems for a wide variety of (opto)electronic applications. The synthetic platform uses methylammonium polybromide melt (PBM) that reacts at room temperature with different elemental metals, including Pb, Sn, Au, and Cu, successfully transforming them into their respective Br-perovskite phases: MAPbBr3, MASnBr3, MA2Au2Br6, and MA2CuBr4. It is shown that the PBMs chemical activity can be tuned, and in situ X-ray diffraction captures in two cases transient intermediate phases during phase evolution. For Sn, which tends towards overoxidation to Sn4+ phase, changes in the PBMs composition coupled with a metallic Sn mediated comproportionation reaction allowed suppressing overoxidation, and formation of high quality MASnBr3 films under ambient conditions. Overall, oxidation and disproportionation potentials are found to be useful metrics for predicting M:PBM reaction outcomes. Industrially, this approach should be fully compatible with roll-to-roll infrastructure, providing a low-barrier pathway to scale next-generation optoelectronic technologies.
papers.title_cn: 一种通用多溴化物熔融策略：将金属直接转化为光电级溴化物钙钛矿
papers.abs_cn: 卤化物钙钛矿体系需要特定的金属氧化态（M2+ 或 M+/M3+ 对），这限制了传统合成过程中的加工灵活性，并对 Sn、Cu 和 Au 等多价金属构成了稳定性挑战。这项工作实现了一个深刻的范式转变：一种通用、单步、无有机溶剂的合成平台，可将稳定的元素金属薄膜直接转化为溴化物钙钛矿及钙钛矿相关体系，用于多种（光）电子应用。该合成平台使用甲基铵多溴化物熔融物（PBM），在室温下与不同的元素金属（包括 Pb、Sn、Au 和 Cu）反应，成功将其转化为各自的 Br-钙钛矿相：MAPbBr3、MASnBr3、MA2Au2Br6 和 MA2CuBr4。研究表明，PBM 的化学活性可以被调控，原位 X 射线衍射在两种情况下捕获了相演化过程中的瞬态中间相。对于易于过度氧化为 Sn4+ 相的 Sn，改变 PBM 组成并结合金属 Sn 介导的归中反应，可以抑制过度氧化，并在环境条件下形成高质量的 MASnBr3 薄膜。总体而言，氧化电位和歧化电位被发现是预测 M:PBM 反应结果的有用指标。在工业上，该方法应与卷对卷基础设施完全兼容，为规模化下一代光电技术提供了一条低门槛途径。

papers.title: Pressure-induced double-dome superconductivity in doped kagome metal Cs(V0.86Ta0.14)3Sb5 without charge density wave
papers.abstract: The vanadium-based kagome superconductor CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ exhibits an intricate interplay between charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC). Substituting Ta for V will suppress the CDW order and enhance superconductivity. Here, we report a high-pressure study up to 48 GPa on Ta-doped Cs(V$_{0.86}$Ta$_{0.14}$)$_3$Sb$_5$ with enhanced $T_\mathrm{c}$ around 5.29 K and without CDW order. At low pressures, unlike the characteristic $``$M-shaped" temperature-pressure phase diagram of the pristine CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, the Ta-doped compound exhibits a distinct non-monotonic evolution. Initially, $T_\mathrm{c}$ drops slightly from 5.29 K at ambient pressure to 4.90 K at 0.33 GPa, before increasing to a maximum of 5.70 K at 0.61 GPa. Upon further compression, $T_\mathrm{c}$ decreases continuously to 0.98 K at 12.3 GPa. At higher pressures, $T_\mathrm{c}$ rises again, reaching 4.46 K at 47.7 GPa. This evolution of $T_\mathrm{c}$ establishes two superconducting domes under pressure, which are similar to those in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$. Our results demonstrate that pressure-induced double-dome superconductivity is intrinsic to these V-based kagome superconductors, even in the absence of long-range CDW order.
papers.title_cn: 无电荷密度波的掺杂kagome金属Cs(V0.86Ta0.14)3Sb5中的压力诱导双穹顶超导电性
papers.abs_cn: 钒基kagome超导体CsV3Sb5展现出电荷密度波（CDW）与超导电性（SC）之间复杂的相互作用。用Ta替代V会抑制CDW序并增强超导电性。在此，我们报道了对Ta掺杂的Cs(V0.86Ta0.14)3Sb5（其Tc增强至约5.29 K且无CDW序）进行的最高至48 GPa的高压研究。在低压下，与原始CsV3Sb5典型的“M形”温度-压力相图不同，Ta掺杂化合物表现出明显的非单调演化。起初，Tc从常压下的5.29 K略微下降至0.33 GPa时的4.90 K，随后升高至0.61 GPa时的最大值5.70 K。进一步加压后，Tc持续下降至12.3 GPa时的0.98 K。在更高压力下，Tc再次上升，在47.7 GPa时达到4.46 K。Tc的这种演化在压力下形成了两个超导穹顶，与CsV3Sb5中的类似。我们的结果表明，压力诱导的双穹顶超导电性是这些V基kagome超导体的内禀性质，即使在没有长程CDW序的情况下也是如此。

papers.title: Density functional perturbation theory of meta-generalized gradient approximations using algorithmic differentiation
papers.abstract: Density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) is an established framework for the computation of derivatives in plane-wave density functional theory (DFT). We present an implementation of DFPT for exchange-correlation (XC) functionals $E_\mathrm{xc}(ρ,τ)$ that incorporate an explicit dependence on both the density $ρ$ and the kinetic energy density $τ$. This covers the popular class of semilocal meta-generalized gradient approximations (meta-GGAs) as well as broader nonlocal parametrizations. We sidestep the derivation of cumbersome XC second energy derivative expressions by recasting these derivatives as a Jacobian-vector product of the XC potentials, which we evaluate with algorithmic differentiation (AD) techniques. Integration with our previously developed AD-DFPT framework [N. F. Schmitz et al., npj Comput. Mater. 12, 6 (2026)] provides access to derivatives of arbitrary ground state quantities with respect to arbitrary perturbations. We employ AD-DFPT to compute a range of response properties for ZnO and BaTiO3, and find that the recent r2SCAN01 meta-GGA functional generally outperforms LDA and PBE. Finally, we showcase the optimization of a neural-network meta-GGA to self-consistently reproduce hybrid-DFT reference densities of bulk silicon, using AD-DFPT gradients. Overall, these results establish AD-DFPT as a versatile route for computing DFT derivatives at the meta-GGA level, be they common response properties or the unusual derivatives required for the gradient-based training of novel XC functionals.
papers.title_cn: 使用算法微分的 meta-GGA 密度泛函微扰理论
papers.abs_cn: 密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）是平面波密度泛函理论（DFT）中计算导数的一个成熟框架。我们提出了针对交换关联（XC）泛函 $E_\mathrm{xc}(ρ,τ)$ 的 DFPT 实现，该泛函同时显式依赖于密度 $ρ$ 和动能密度 $τ$。这涵盖了流行的半局域 meta-GGA 类泛函以及更广泛的非局域参数化。我们通过将这些导数重新表述为 XC 势的 Jacobian-向量积，并利用算法微分（AD）技术进行计算，从而绕过了繁琐的 XC 二阶能量导数表达式的推导。与我们之前开发的 AD-DFPT 框架 [N. F. Schmitz et al., npj Comput. Mater. 12, 6 (2026)] 相结合，可以计算任意基态量对任意微扰的导数。我们使用 AD-DFPT 计算了 ZnO 和 BaTiO3 的一系列响应性质，发现最近的 r2SCAN01 meta-GGA 泛函通常优于 LDA 和 PBE。最后，我们展示了利用 AD-DFPT 梯度优化神经网络 meta-GGA，以自洽地重现体硅的杂化 DFT 参考密度。总体而言，这些结果确立了 AD-DFPT 作为在 meta-GGA 水平上计算 DFT 导数的通用途径，无论是常见的响应性质还是新型 XC 泛函基于梯度训练所需的特殊导数。

papers.title: La-Ribo: RNA Co-Design via Geometry-Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract: RNA function arises from the coupling of nucleotide sequence and three-dimensional structure, motivating their joint design. Coordinating global folding with nucleotide-level detail remains challenging under limited structural supervision. We introduce La-Ribo, a generative framework for RNA sequence-structure co-design via geometry-latent flow matching. La-Ribo retains a sparse phosphate-sugar--base scaffold and encodes nucleotide identity and local conformation in residue-wise latents. A shared flow network generates both jointly, and an RNA-specific decoder then reconstructs all heavy atoms. To expand supervision, we construct a quality-controlled corpus of 168,561 RNA structures, integrating experimental data with predictions from three folding models, including 10,631 MSA-supported structures generated in this work. La-Ribo improves designability and codesignability over the evaluated baselines across sampling budgets and two refolding models, and the same prior supports scaffold-conditioned inverse folding without additional training.
papers.title_cn: La-Ribo：通过几何-隐空间流匹配的RNA共设计
papers.abs_cn: RNA功能源于核苷酸序列与三维结构的耦合，这促使了对其的联合设计。在有限的结构监督下，协调全局折叠与核苷酸级别的细节仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了La-Ribo，一个通过几何-隐空间流匹配进行RNA序列-结构共设计的生成框架。La-Ribo保留了一个稀疏的磷酸-糖-碱基骨架，并在残基级别的隐空间中编码核苷酸身份和局部构象。一个共享的流网络联合生成两者，然后一个RNA特异性解码器重建所有重原子。为了扩展监督，我们构建了一个经过质量控制的包含168,561个RNA结构的语料库，将实验数据与来自三个折叠模型的预测相结合，其中包括本工作中生成的10,631个MSA支持的结构。在采样预算和两个重折叠模型下，La-Ribo在可设计性和共设计性方面优于所评估的基线，并且相同的先验支持无需额外训练的骨架条件反向折叠。

papers.title: Direct Quantification of Molecular Helicity-Dependent Effective Magnetic Fields in Chiral Polypeptide/Ferromagnet Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS) refers to structural chirality governing spin transport in chiral systems, with experimental signatures reported in both transport experiments and photoemission. Beyond influencing transport, recent experiments indicate that adsorbed chiral molecules can influence the magnetic state of adjacent ferromagnetic layers, suggesting the existence of chirality-induced effects whose origin and quantitative characterization remain lacking. Here, we investigate chirality-induced long-range magnetic interactions in a hybrid molecular/ferromagnetic multilayer beyond the conventional direct transport coupling. We demonstrate the long-range nature by decoupling the adsorbed chiral molecules from the magnet using an insulating spacer. We show that self-assembled monolayers of chiral polypeptides with a helical structure can act on a ferromagnetic multilayer via an enantiomer-dependent effective magnetic field that may be mediated by chiral phonons through the insulating layer. Using Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect (MOKE) microscopy with on-chip reference regions free of molecules, we directly quantify this field by measuring precisely the reproducible shifts of the local hysteresis loops. The extracted effective field reverses sign for opposite enantiomers and correlates with the enantiomeric excess. These results provide a direct and quantitative link between molecular chirality and magnetic response in hybrid heterostructures, establishing an experimentally accessible benchmark for a CISS-related effect.
papers.title_cn: 手性多肽/铁磁异质结构中分子螺旋度相关有效磁场的直接定量
papers.abs_cn: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）是指结构手性调控手性系统中的自旋输运，在输运实验和光电子发射中均有实验报道。除了影响输运之外，近期实验表明吸附的手性分子可以影响相邻铁磁层的磁态，暗示存在手性诱导效应，但其起源和定量表征仍然缺乏。在此，我们研究了混合分子/铁磁多层体系中超越传统直接输运耦合的手性诱导长程磁相互作用。我们通过使用绝缘间隔层将吸附的手性分子与磁体解耦，证明了其长程性质。我们表明，具有螺旋结构的自组装手性多肽单分子层可以通过对映体依赖的有效磁场作用于铁磁多层，该磁场可能由手性声子通过绝缘层介导。利用磁光克尔效应（MOKE）显微镜以及无分子的片上参考区域，我们通过精确测量局部磁滞回线的可重复位移，直接定量了这一磁场。提取的有效磁场对于相反对映体发生符号反转，并与对映体过量相关。这些结果为混合异质结构中分子手性与磁响应之间提供了直接且定量的联系，为CISS相关效应建立了一个实验上可及的基准。

papers.title: A structure-preserving neural density functional for the ions of a polymer electrolyte
papers.abstract: Predicting the structure and response of inhomogeneous polymer electrolytes requires a description of ion correlations that retains molecular-scale accuracy while remaining transferable across spatial scales and geometries. We develop a neural density functional for electrolytes that preserves spatial symmetries, thermodynamic integrability and the Noether identities, with perfect screening recovered in stable, noncritical bulk states. Its nonlinear density dependence captures the concentration-dependent correlations missed by a pair closure, including a crossover from enhanced to suppressed long-wavelength number fluctuations at strong coupling. The functional describes density profiles at an untrained salt concentration and predicts bulk structure factors and the long-wavelength number response. Trained solely on planar density and internal-force profiles from molecular dynamics, the functional predicts ionic structure in larger domains and in two-dimensional external fields. On the same ion data, it is more accurate than three other neural density-functional architectures and keeps its accuracy with a quarter of the training runs, where the errors of the best alternative grow by about two thirds. The spatial transferability provides a necessary foundation for connecting molecular correlations to continuum predictions at larger scales.
papers.title_cn: 用于聚合物电解质离子的保结构神经密度泛函
papers.abs_cn: 预测非均匀聚合物电解质的结构和响应，需要对离子关联进行描述，这种描述既要保持分子尺度的精度，又要在不同空间尺度和几何构型之间具有可迁移性。我们为电解质开发了一种神经密度泛函，它保持空间对称性、热力学可积性和Noether恒等式，并在稳定的非临界体相态中恢复完美屏蔽。其非线性密度依赖性捕捉了配对闭合所遗漏的浓度依赖关联，包括在强耦合下从增强到抑制长波长数密度涨落的交叉行为。该泛函描述了未训练盐浓度下的密度分布，并预测了体相结构因子和长波长数密度响应。仅使用来自分子动力学的平面密度和内力分布进行训练，该泛函就能预测更大域内和二维外场中的离子结构。在相同的离子数据上，它比另外三种神经密度泛函架构更准确，并且在仅使用四分之一训练轮次时仍保持其准确性，而最佳替代方案的误差则增大约三分之二。这种空间可迁移性为在更大尺度上将分子关联与连续介质预测联系起来提供了必要基础。

papers.title: Origins of Universal Machine Learning Force-Field Errors in Multicomponent Materials
papers.abstract: Universal machine learning force-field generalization to multicomponent environments generated by compositional design remains insufficiently assessed. We construct a benchmark of 7,599 multicomponent configurations inspired by high-entropy design, elemental substitution and anion mixing. Eleven pretrained models are evaluated against density functional theory for energies, forces and stresses, with assessment extended to elastic, vibrational and adsorption-related properties. Force errors are analysed through training-reference coverage, local geometric heterogeneity, distance directionality and elemental response. Distances to training-reference environments reveal a qualitative association between coverage differences and increasing errors, while substantial variation remains at similar distances. Higher-error groups show greater local geometric heterogeneity, although OMat24 provides broad coverage of these environments. Relative to training-reference pair medians, errors remain low near the median, rise steeply on the compression side and increase more weakly on the extension side. After matching element pairs and absolute distance deviations, compression-side force errors are 1.81-1.95 times extension-side errors. Model-predicted pairwise interaction curves show greater curvature under compression. Fitting difficulty in independent elemental systems correlates with electronic band-energy responses to atomic displacements and Fermi-level shifts, and a similar pattern is observed in multicomponent systems. In parameter-matched comparisons, spherical-harmonic representations with maximum degrees of 2 and 4 lower test force errors for 38 and 40 of 43 elements, respectively, while differences in elemental difficulty remain. These findings inform force-field selection for experimental compositional design and identify targets for training-data sampling and model representations.
papers.title_cn: 多组分材料中通用机器学习力场误差的来源
papers.abs_cn: 通用机器学习力场向由成分设计生成的多组分环境的泛化能力仍缺乏充分评估。我们构建了一个包含 7,599 个多组分构型的基准，其灵感来自高熵设计、元素替代和阴离子混合。我们针对能量、力和应力，将十一个预训练模型与密度泛函理论进行评估比较，并将评估扩展到弹性、振动和吸附相关性质。力误差通过训练参考覆盖度、局部几何异质性、距离方向性和元素响应进行分析。到训练参考环境的距离揭示了覆盖度差异与误差增大之间的定性关联，而在相似距离处仍存在显著差异。较高误差组表现出更大的局部几何异质性，尽管 OMat24 对这些环境提供了广泛覆盖。相对于训练参考对的中位数，误差在中位数附近仍然较低，在压缩侧急剧上升，而在拉伸侧上升较弱。在匹配元素对和绝对距离偏差后，压缩侧的力误差是拉伸侧力误差的 1.81-1.95 倍。模型预测的成对相互作用曲线在压缩下表现出更大的曲率。独立元素系统中的拟合难度与电子能带能量对原子位移和费米能级移动的响应相关，并且在多组分系统中也观察到类似模式。在参数匹配的比较中，最大阶数为 2 和 4 的球谐表示分别降低了 43 个元素中 38 个和 40 个元素的测试力误差，而元素难度的差异仍然存在。这些发现为实验成分设计中的力场选择提供了信息，并确定了训练数据采样和模型表示的目标。

papers.title: Multiple photoelectron inelastic scattering in large He nanodroplets
papers.abstract: Helium nanodroplets are ideal testbeds for elucidating secondary processes induced by ionizing radiation in condensed matter. Here we study photoionization electron spectra of large He nanodroplets in the extreme ultraviolet region, where photoelectrons undergo multiple inelastic collisions with He atoms in the nanodroplets. The resulting characteristic electron energy-loss features are identified by their dependence on photon energy and nanodroplet size and by comparison with a simple numerical simulation. Conditions for minimizing electron scattering with the He nanodroplets are discussed.
papers.title_cn: 大尺寸氦纳米液滴中的多次光电子非弹性散射
papers.abs_cn: 氦纳米液滴是阐明凝聚态中电离辐射诱导的次级过程的理想测试平台。本文研究了在极紫外区域大尺寸氦纳米液滴的光电离电子谱，其中光电子与纳米液滴中的 He 原子发生多次非弹性碰撞。通过分析这些特征对光子能量和纳米液滴尺寸的依赖关系，并与简单的数值模拟进行比较，我们识别了由此产生的特征性电子能量损失特征。本文还讨论了最小化电子与 He 纳米液滴散射的条件。

papers.title: MAST: Motif-Augmented Diffusion with Search Tree for Spectroscopic Molecular Structure Elucidation
papers.abstract: Elucidating molecular structures from spectra is a foundational problem in chemical and materials characterization, yet remains challenging due to spectral ambiguity and the vast molecular space. Although recent diffusion-based generators show strong promise for spectra-conditioned elucidation, existing methods struggle to learn robust spectra-structure relationships from limited paired data when relying solely on global spectral representation. Moreover, the repeated full sampling inference strategy incurs substantial computation overhead. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MAST}, a \textbf{M}otif-\textbf{A}ugmented diffusion framework with \textbf{S}earch \textbf{T}ree, for joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation. MAST introduces explicit, interpretable \emph{motif priors} as intermediate evidences throughout denoising, reducing conditional ambiguity and facilitating spectra-conditioned optimization. We further cast diffusion sampling as \emph{reward-guided tree search} to prioritize high-reward denoising trajectories, yielding a compact set of spectra-consistent candidates under limited budgets. On the QM9S multi-spectra benchmark, MAST achieves \textbf{94.89\%} exact recovery and improves 3D fidelity, while preserving high chemical validity and stability. Code is available at https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST.
papers.title_cn: MAST：基于搜索树的基元增强扩散用于光谱分子结构解析
papers.abs_cn: 从光谱中解析分子结构是化学与材料表征中的基础问题，但由于光谱模糊性和巨大的分子空间，这一问题仍然具有挑战性。尽管近期基于扩散的生成器在光谱条件解析方面展现出强大潜力，但现有方法在仅依赖全局光谱表示时，难以从有限的配对数据中学习鲁棒的光谱-结构关系。此外，重复的全采样推理策略会带来大量计算开销。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 MAST，一种带有搜索树的基元增强扩散框架，用于联合 2D-3D 光谱分子结构解析。MAST 在去噪过程中引入显式、可解释的基元先验作为中间证据，从而减少条件模糊性并促进光谱条件优化。我们进一步将扩散采样转化为奖励引导的树搜索，以优先选择高奖励的去噪轨迹，在有限预算下生成一小组与光谱一致的候选结构。在 QM9S 多光谱基准上，MAST 实现了 94.89% 的精确恢复率，并提升了 3D 保真度，同时保持了较高的化学有效性和稳定性。代码见 https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST。

papers.title: Emergent gold-induced interfacial magnetism in monolayer FePS$_3$
papers.abstract: Owing to their atomically clean interfaces and extreme thinness, two-dimensional (2D) materials are ideal hosts for strong proximity effects, whereby contact with an adjacent material reshapes their ground state. Here, we demonstrate such an effect within a hybrid heterostructure, between the 2D antiferromagnet FePS$_3$ and an ultrathin gold film. Rather than a passive support, the latter profoundly changes the nature of the magnetism in the 2D magnet, inducing a sizeable interfacial moment. Large-area flakes from Au-assisted exfoliation, combined with element-selective X-ray absorption mapping, enable a layer-by-layer study from monolayer to bulk, benchmarked against an inert SiO$_2$ substrate reference. At 9 T and 5 K, the monolayer on gold shows a three-fold enhanced X-ray magnetic circular dichroism relative to SiO$_2$, with a $\sim$40% reduction of the orbital-to-spin moment ratio. Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering reveals a collapse of the crystal-field (d-d) excitations and a massive spectral-weight transfer to the charge-transfer region, unveiling the microscopic mechanism behind this change. Supported by atomic multiplet calculations, we identify interfacial charge transfer and Fe 3d-Au hybridization as the origin of these effects, which decay over the first three layers and vanish at the pentalayer, establishing layer number combined with substrate engineering as an atomically precise handle.
papers.title_cn: 单层 FePS3 中金诱导的界面磁性涌现
papers.abs_cn: 由于其原子级洁净的界面和极致的薄度，二维（2D）材料是强邻近效应的理想载体，通过与相邻材料的接触可重塑其基态。在此，我们展示了在二维反铁磁体 FePS3 与超薄金膜之间的混合异质结构中存在这样的效应。金膜并非被动支撑，而是深刻改变了二维磁体的磁性本质，诱导出可观的界面磁矩。通过 Au 辅助剥离获得的大面积薄片，结合元素选择性 X 射线吸收成像，我们实现了从单层到块体的逐层研究，并以惰性 SiO2 衬底作为参照基准。在 9 T 和 5 K 下，金上的单层相对于 SiO2 表现出三倍增强的 X 射线磁圆二色性，同时轨道与自旋磁矩比降低约 40%。共振非弹性 X 射线散射揭示了晶体场（d-d）激发的塌缩以及向电荷转移区的大量谱权重转移，从而揭示了这一变化背后的微观机制。在原子多重态计算的支持下，我们确定界面电荷转移和 Fe 3d-Au 杂化为这些效应的起源，这些效应在前三层中衰减并在五层时消失，从而确立了层数与衬底工程相结合作为一种原子级精确的调控手段。

papers.title: Symmetry-Dependent Polarity Reversal of Bulk Spin-Orbit Torque in Single-Layer MnCoGa
papers.abstract: Controlling the magnitude and polarity of spin-orbit torque (SOT) is essential for manipulating magnetization in spintronic devices. Here, we realize bulk spin-orbit torque (SOT) in a single-layer Mn1.6Co1.4Ga (MCG) Heusler alloy and achieve lattice strain-controlled reversal of SOT polarity. SOT-driven magnetization switching is achieved over a thickness range of 3-20 nm, with the switching polarity reversed between the strongly strained ultrathin regime and thicker films. First-principles calculations reveal a sizable intrinsic spin Hall conductivity (SHC) in MCG originating from its topological band structure, which is enhanced by the tetragonal distortion without changing sign. Together with the thickness-dependent structural evolution, we demonstrate that the reversal of SOT polarity does not originate from a sign change of the SHC, but rather from lattice distortion induced symmetry breaking that modifies the conversion of spin current into a net bulk SOT, thereby controlling its polarity. These results establish strain-controlled structural symmetry as an additional degree of freedom for tuning bulk SOT in magnetic single layers.
papers.title_cn: 单层 MnCoGa 中体自旋轨道矩的对称性依赖极性反转
papers.abs_cn: 控制自旋轨道矩（SOT）的大小和极性对于操控自旋电子器件中的磁化至关重要。在此，我们在单层 Mn1.6Co1.4Ga（MCG）Heusler 合金中实现了体自旋轨道矩（SOT），并实现了晶格应变控制的 SOT 极性反转。SOT 驱动的磁化翻转在 3-20 nm 的厚度范围内实现，且翻转极性在强应变超薄区域与较厚薄膜之间发生反转。第一性原理计算揭示了 MCG 中存在可观的由拓扑能带结构产生的本征自旋霍尔电导（SHC），该电导在四方畸变下增强而不改变符号。结合厚度依赖的结构演化，我们证明 SOT 极性的反转并非源于 SHC 的符号变化，而是源于晶格畸变诱导的对称性破缺，该对称性破缺改变了自旋流转换为净体 SOT 的过程，从而控制其极性。这些结果确立了应变控制的结构对称性作为调控磁性单层中体 SOT 的额外自由度。

papers.title: Ghost tasking for parametrized Gaussian Processes solving linear differential equations
papers.abstract: Physics-informed machine learning has gained significant attention in recent years. In regimes of limited data, parametrized Gaussian processes have become popular. Existing approaches, however, often face limitations, such as requiring parametrizable (also called controllable) systems or a large number of output tasks. In this work, we introduce a systematic procedure we call "ghost tasking", using auxiliary tasks to circumvent these limitations. We prove that such ghost tasks can render any non-parametrizable system effectively parametrizable, enabling algorithmic construction of parametrized Gaussian Processes while keeping the number of required tasks (i.e. output dimensions) and latent functions low. We find that ghost tasking performs especially well in an inverse problem setting, even with very few available data. We show the usage and power of ghost tasking in three experiments, providing systematic comparisons to the only other currently available method applicable to all experiments. We provide necessary syntax and explications for two computer algebra programs that compute parametrizations for systems with polynomial or rational coefficients. Our theoretical results extend to systems with meromorphic functions.
papers.title_cn: 用于求解线性微分方程的参数化高斯过程的幽灵任务
papers.abs_cn: 近年来，物理信息机器学习受到了广泛关注。在数据有限的场景下，参数化高斯过程变得流行。然而，现有方法常常面临局限，例如要求系统可参数化（也称为可控）或需要大量输出任务。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种系统化的程序，称为“幽灵任务”，利用辅助任务来规避这些局限。我们证明，此类幽灵任务可以使任何不可参数化的系统有效地变为可参数化，从而能够以较少的所需任务数（即输出维度）和潜在函数来算法化地构建参数化高斯过程。我们发现，幽灵任务在逆问题设定中表现尤为出色，即使在可用数据非常少的情况下也是如此。我们通过三个实验展示了幽灵任务的用法和效力，并与目前唯一适用于所有实验的其他方法进行了系统比较。我们为两个计算机代数程序提供了必要的语法和说明，用于计算具有多项式或有理系数的系统的参数化。我们的理论结果可推广到具有亚纯函数的系统。

papers.title: Multifunctional synaptic learning and neuromorphic computing using crystalline TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$ heterojunction-based memory devices
papers.abstract: An attempt is made here to mimic different properties of biological synapses using Ag/TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$/p$^{++}$-Si memristor structure by studying its different transport properties under dc and pulsed bias. The presence of crystalline NiO$_x$ with smaller gains is found to be helpful to get TiO$_x$ deposited on its top with crystalline properties and larger grains. The heterostructure offers stable bipolar forming free non-volatile resistive switching characteristics under reverse biased condition with gradual set and reset features. These devices are also able to successfully implement the classical Pavlov's learning, study artificial nociceptor and Morse code detection. While incorporating synaptic weights derived from the measured conductance programming pulse relationship, an artificial neural network achieves nearly 95\% accuracy in MNIST digit recognition. In brief, NiO$_x$/TiO$_x$ heterojunction plays the pivotal role in getting such reproducible $I-V$ characteristics for mimicking different properties of biological synapses.
papers.title_cn: 利用晶态 TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$ 异质结基存储器件实现多功能突触学习与神经形态计算
papers.abs_cn: 本文尝试利用 Ag/TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$/p$^{++}$-Si 忆阻器结构，通过研究其在直流和脉冲偏压下的不同输运特性，来模拟生物突触的多种功能。研究发现，具有较小增益的晶态 NiO$_x$ 有助于在其顶部沉积出具有晶态特性和较大晶粒的 TiO$_x$。该异质结构在反向偏置条件下呈现出稳定的双极无形成电压的非易失阻变特性，并具有渐变 set 和 reset 特征。这些器件还能够成功实现经典的巴甫洛夫学习、人工伤害感受器研究以及摩尔斯电码检测。在将测量得到的电导编程脉冲关系所衍生的突触权重纳入人工神经网络后，该网络在 MNIST 数字识别中达到了接近 95% 的准确率。简言之，NiO$_x$/TiO$_x$ 异质结在获得这种可重复的 $I-V$ 特性以模拟生物突触的不同功能方面发挥了关键作用。

papers.title: Gas-phase chemistry of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$: a key building block for carbon mass growth in space
papers.abstract: The gas-phase chemistry of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$ plays a central role in the growth of carbonaceous species across a wide range of environments, from combustion systems to interstellar media. However, the presence of multiple isomers, primarily the linear propargyl cation and the cyclic cyclopropenyl cation, has so far prevented the determination of reliable isomer-specific reaction kinetics. In this work, we combine tunable vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) photoionization with controlled ion--molecule reaction measurements to selectively produce and probe the reactivity of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$ isomers. By employing a titration approach, we extract isomer-specific reaction rate coefficients and branching ratios for reactions of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$ with $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_4$, $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_4$, and $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6$. Our results demonstrate a strong contrast in reactivity: the most stable cyclic isomer is found to be essentially unreactive under the investigated conditions, whereas the linear isomer exhibits efficient and diverse chemistry leading to the formation of larger hydrocarbon ions. In particular, the formation of $\mathrm{C}_6\mathrm{H}_5^+$ is observed, providing an important intermediate in pathways toward aromatic species. These findings help resolve long-standing ambiguities in previously reported rate coefficients and provide new quantitative constraints for kinetic and astrochemical models. More broadly, this work highlights the importance of isomer-specific chemistry in carbon growth processes and demonstrates the effectiveness of VUV-based photoionization methods for disentangling complex reaction networks in the gas phase.
papers.title_cn: C3H3+ 的气相化学：空间中碳质量增长的关键构建单元
papers.abs_cn: C3H3+ 的气相化学在从燃烧系统到星际介质等广泛环境中的含碳物种生长过程中起着核心作用。然而，多种异构体的存在，主要是线性炔丙基阳离子和环状环丙烯基阳离子，迄今为止阻碍了可靠的同分异构体特异性反应动力学的确定。在本工作中，我们将可调谐真空紫外（VUV）光电离与受控离子-分子反应测量相结合，以选择性产生并探测 C3H3+ 异构体的反应性。通过采用滴定方法，我们提取了 C3H3+ 与 C2H4、C3H4 和 C3H6 反应的同分异构体特异性反应速率系数和分支比。我们的结果表明反应性存在强烈对比：最稳定的环状异构体在所研究的条件下基本不反应，而线性异构体则表现出高效且多样的化学性质，导致形成更大的烃离子。特别是，观察到 C6H5+ 的形成，这为通向芳香物种的路径提供了重要的中间体。这些发现有助于解决先前报道的速率系数中长期存在的模糊性，并为动力学和天体化学模型提供了新的定量约束。更广泛地说，这项工作突出了同分异构体特异性化学在碳增长过程中的重要性，并展示了基于 VUV 的光电离方法在解析气相中复杂反应网络方面的有效性。

papers.title: Homogeneous Charge Relaxation in Organic Mixed Ionic-Electronic Conductors
papers.abstract: Organic mixed ionic-electronic conductors (OMIECs) couple ionic and electronic signals, enabling energy storage, neuromorphic computing, and bioelectronics. However, how charge relaxes in water once the bias is removed, which determines how long stored states persist, remains unclear. Using operando charge photometry, we tracked charge in OMIEC films during biasing and open-circuit relaxation. Under bias, charges moved as redox fronts. After bias removal, charge instead relaxed uniformly across the channel. Modeling and cryo-electron microscopy indicate that swelling creates connected water-rich pathways through the bulk. These pathways speed ion motion but also let stored charge leak away. Tuning the terminal side chain of a polythiophene controls water uptake and ion trapping. Bulky hydrophobic side chains enable stable programmable states, whereas hydrophilic side chains support fast electrophysiology sensing.
papers.title_cn: 有机混合离子-电子导体中的均匀电荷弛豫
papers.abs_cn: 有机混合离子-电子导体（OMIECs）耦合离子和电子信号，可实现能量存储、神经形态计算和生物电子学。然而，一旦去除偏压，电荷在水中如何弛豫——这决定了存储状态能持续多久——仍不清楚。利用操作电荷光度法，我们追踪了OMIEC薄膜在偏压和开路弛豫过程中的电荷。在偏压下，电荷以氧化还原前沿的形式移动。去除偏压后，电荷反而在整个通道中均匀弛豫。建模和冷冻电子显微镜表明，溶胀在体相中形成了连通的富水通路。这些通路加速了离子运动，但也让存储的电荷泄漏流失。调节聚噻吩的末端侧链可控制吸水性和离子捕获。庞大的疏水侧链可实现稳定的可编程状态，而亲水侧链则支持快速电生理传感。

papers.title: Mutual Linearity of Complexes in Chemical Reaction Networks
papers.abstract: Exact statements about how a system far from equilibrium responds to changes in its rate constants are scarce beyond linear response, yet they are central to the control of biochemical networks. A notable exception is mutual linearity: in a jump process, controlling the rates of a single transition makes any two stationary probabilities obey an exact affine relation, arbitrarily far from equilibrium. With nonlinear mass-action kinetics, and conservation laws in place of a normalization, chemical reaction networks seem to defy mutual linearity since species concentrations obey no such relation. We show that it was there all along, in the complexes' activities (mass-action monomials) rather than in the concentrations of species. For zero-deficiency networks with a single linkage class, controlling one reaction makes any three stationary activities obey a linear relation whose coefficients are independent of the controlled rate constants, the conserved quantities (hence the initial state), and even of the stoichiometry of complexes. This predicts hidden activities and bounds the activity ratios the control can reach, while a violation signals nonzero deficiency or multiple linkage classes.
papers.title_cn: 化学反应网络中复合物的相互线性
papers.abs_cn: 关于远离平衡态的系统如何响应速率常数变化的精确陈述，在线性响应之外极为稀少，但它们对生化网络的控制至关重要。一个显著的例外是相互线性：在跳跃过程中，控制单个跃迁的速率会使任意两个稳态概率服从精确的仿射关系，且任意远离平衡态。对于非线性质量作用动力学，以及用守恒律代替归一化，化学反应网络似乎违背了相互线性，因为物种浓度不服从这样的关系。我们表明，它一直存在，存在于复合物的活性（质量作用单项式）中，而非物种的浓度中。对于具有单个连接类的零亏格网络，控制一个反应会使任意三个稳态活性服从线性关系，其系数独立于被控制的速率常数、守恒量（因此也独立于初始状态），甚至独立于复合物的化学计量。这预测了隐藏活性，并界定了控制所能达到的活性比，而违反则表明非零亏格或多个连接类。

papers.title: Comprehensive study of massively overlapping cascades in common elemental metals
papers.abstract: Massively overlapping cascades simulations were carried out in 21 elemental metals: Be, Al, Ti, V, Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zr, Nb, Mo, Rh, Pd, Ag, Hf, Ta, W, Pt, Au and Pb. These elements have simple FCC, BCC and HCP lattice structures. For each element, 2000 cumulative 5 keV cascades were simulated using molecular dynamics. The overlapping cascades were simulated using various classical analytical interatomic potentials as well as with machine-learning interatomic potentials for many of the elements. The general conclusion is that results from massively overlapping cascades simulations are very sensitive to the choice of interatomic potential across the periodic table. Furthermore, we see that FCC metals all form stacking fault tetrahedra due to irradiation, and also typically include interstitial type Shockley partial and Frank type dislocations. In BCC materials typically form interstitial 1/2$\langle$1 1 1$\rangle$ dislocations, but vacancy type 1/2$\langle$1 1 1$\rangle$ dislocations were also observed in V and Nb. HCP materials tend to form complex dislocation structures mainly consisting of a-type dislocations that can be of both vacancy or interstitial type. Correlations between saturated defect concentrations and fundamental underlying material properties are explored.
papers.title_cn: 常见元素金属中大规模重叠级联的综合研究
papers.abs_cn: 在21种元素金属中进行了大规模重叠级联模拟：Be、Al、Ti、V、Cr、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zr、Nb、Mo、Rh、Pd、Ag、Hf、Ta、W、Pt、Au和Pb。这些元素具有简单的FCC、BCC和HCP晶格结构。对于每种元素，使用分子动力学模拟了2000个累积5 keV级联。对于许多元素，使用各种经典分析型原子间势以及机器学习原子间势来模拟重叠级联。总体结论是，在元素周期表中，大规模重叠级联模拟的结果对原子间势的选择非常敏感。此外，我们看到FCC金属由于辐照都形成堆垛层错四面体，并且通常还包括间隙型Shockley分位错和Frank型位错。在BCC材料中通常形成间隙型1/2<1 1 1>位错，但在V和Nb中也观察到空位型1/2<1 1 1>位错。HCP材料倾向于形成复杂的位错结构，主要由a型位错组成，这些位错可以是空位型或间隙型。探讨了饱和缺陷浓度与基本材料性能之间的相关性。

papers.title: Fluid deformable surfaces with variable thickness - a Surface Shallow-Water-Helfrich model
papers.abstract: Epithelial tissues play a fundamental role in morphogenesis. Mechanically they can be viewed as thin soft materials exhibiting a solid-fluid duality. The Surface Navier-Stokes-Helfrich model accounts for these properties by combining bending and surface hydrodynamics. In order to account for varying cell thickness we incorporate a thickness field in the spirit of a shallow-water equation, but defined on the (self-)evolving surface. This replaces the inextensibility constraint of the two-dimensional fluid and with it the conservation of surface area by an incompressibility constraint of the thin film fluid allowing for changes in surface area. We develop a numerical scheme based on surface finite elements, perform convergence tests, demonstrate the impact on shape evolution of closed surfaces with a constant enclosed volume and discuss implications on modeling morphogenesis.
papers.title_cn: 变厚度的流体可变形曲面——一种曲面浅水-Helfrich模型
papers.abs_cn: 上皮组织在形态发生中起着基础性作用。从力学角度看，它们可以被视为表现出固-液二象性的薄软材料。曲面Navier-Stokes-Helfrich模型通过结合弯曲和表面流体动力学来描述这些性质。为了考虑细胞厚度的变化，我们引入了一个厚度场，其思想类似于浅水方程，但定义在（自）演化曲面上。这取代了二维流体的不可伸展约束，从而将表面积守恒替换为薄膜流体的不可压缩约束，允许表面积发生变化。我们基于曲面有限元开发了一个数值格式，进行了收敛性测试，展示了其对具有恒定封闭体积的闭合曲面形状演化的影响，并讨论了对形态发生建模的意义。

papers.title: Femtosecond Three-Dimensional Imaging of Single-Protein with Hard X-ray Laser
papers.abstract: The extremely intense pulses of X-ray free-electron lasers (XFELs) have enabled imaging of radiation-sensitive samples, such as macromolecular microcrystals, beyond radiation damage limits. These sources have the potential to deliver biomolecular single-particle imaging, similar to cryo-electron microscopy but without the need for cryo-fixation and with temporal resolution from femtoseconds to milliseconds. While this possibility was recognized before XFELs were built, the biological single-particle imaging work-flow has previously only been demonstrated on large virus particles. Based on decades of improvements in X-ray beam focusing, particle delivery, diffraction detection, and advanced analysis, here we demonstrate imaging of a single molecular complex, the giant-hemoglobin erythrocruorin (Ery) with X-ray laser pulses. Two-dimensional classes of diffraction patterns could be reconstructed to 15 Angstrom resolution, and 3D images to approximately 20 Angstrom, while the 3D merged intensity in reciprocal space extended beyond 20 Angstrom. The resolution discrepancy is likely due to heterogeneity caused by gas-phase compaction of the complexes. With increased throughput, this approach could be used to reveal in-situ structural details during mass spectrometry studies of biomolecules, while improvements in sample delivery may provide ultrafast snapshot imaging of biological single-particles in their native-state beyond the limitations of radiation damage.
papers.title_cn: 硬X射线激光对单蛋白的飞秒三维成像
papers.abs_cn: X射线自由电子激光（XFEL）的极强脉冲使得对辐射敏感样品（如大分子微晶）的成像超越了辐射损伤极限。这些光源有潜力实现生物分子单颗粒成像，类似于冷冻电镜，但无需冷冻固定，且具有从飞秒到毫秒的时间分辨率。尽管在XFEL建成之前这一可能性已被认识到，但生物单颗粒成像工作流程此前仅在大病毒颗粒上得到验证。基于数十年来在X射线束聚焦、颗粒输送、衍射探测和先进分析方面的改进，我们在此展示了用X射线激光脉冲对单一分子复合物——巨型血红蛋白erythrocruorin（Ery）的成像。二维衍射图分类可重建至15埃分辨率，三维图像可重建至约20埃，而倒易空间中的三维合并强度延伸超过20埃。分辨率差异可能是由气相压缩复合物导致的异质性所致。随着通量提高，该方法可用于在生物分子质谱研究中揭示原位结构细节，而样品输送的改进可能提供超越辐射损伤极限的天然态生物单颗粒超快快照成像。

papers.title: Beyond special quasirandom structures: free energies from energy cumulants
papers.abstract: Predicting the finite-temperature stability of a disordered phase requires its free energy. It is traditionally approximated by combining the energy of a special quasirandom structure (a small cell mimicking a random alloy) with the ideal configurational entropy. This approximation neglects the short-range order that develops on cooling. In this study, we show that the conventional approximation is the first term of an infinite expansion of the free energy in energy cumulants. Higher-order cumulants are estimated from energies of random arrangements, without Monte Carlo or molecular dynamics. In a nine-element refractory system, adding the second cumulant reduced free energy errors by about an order of magnitude. The expansion gives phase diagrams with order--disorder transitions, defect concentrations, and short-range order. To demonstrate its utility, we used a foundation interatomic potential to screen lithium-excess rocksalt oxides across 26 elements for synthesizable disordered phases rich in the Li$_4$ clusters needed for lithium percolation. The approach applies to any lattice and chemistry, and brings disordered phases within reach of routine screening.
papers.title_cn: 超越特殊准随机结构：来自能量累积量的自由能
papers.abs_cn: 预测无序相的有限温度稳定性需要其自由能。传统上，它通过将特殊准随机结构（一种模拟随机合金的小晶胞）的能量与理想构型熵相结合来近似。这种近似忽略了冷却时形成的短程有序。在本研究中，我们表明传统近似是自由能在能量累积量中无限展开的第一项。高阶累积量从随机排列的能量估计，无需 Monte Carlo 或分子动力学。在一个九元素难熔系统中，加入第二累积量使自由能误差降低了约一个数量级。该展开给出了具有有序--无序转变、缺陷浓度和短程有序的相图。为了展示其效用，我们使用基础原子间势在 26 种元素中筛选锂过量岩盐氧化物，以寻找可合成的无序相，这些相富含锂渗流所需的 Li$_4$ 团簇。该方法适用于任何晶格和化学体系，并使无序相进入常规筛选的范围。

papers.title: Benchmarking Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials for Temperature-Dependent Elasticity of Binary and High-Entropy Refractory Carbides
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of temperature-dependent elasticity is important for assessing refractory carbides under high-temperature conditions, but the computational cost of ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) limits systematic investigations across compositions and temperatures. Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) offer an efficient alternative, yet their accuracy for this task remains insufficiently established. Here, we benchmark nine uMLIPs against consistent AIMD reference data for five binary and two high-entropy (HE) carbides between 300 and 1200 K. Elastic constants and the corresponding bulk, shear, and Young's moduli are obtained using stress-strain molecular dynamics, explicitly sampling thermal atomic motion and anharmonic effects beyond thermal expansion alone. We assess absolute elastic properties and normalized thermal softening separately. MACE-MH-1 achieves the lowest overall mean absolute percentage error (5.7%). MACE-MH-1 and DPA4-Mini reproduce thermal softening most accurately, with mean deviations of 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points, respectively. All models generally underestimate stiffness, with larger equilibrium volumes relative to the AIMD reference likely contributing to this trend for most models. C12 exhibits the largest model-dependent errors. The HE carbides are described with accuracy comparable to that of the binary carbides, indicating no apparent accuracy penalty from chemical complexity. Accuracy instead varies with transition-metal composition, with group-V carbides, particularly TaC, presenting the greatest challenge. These results identify promising pretrained models for finite-temperature elasticity in carbides and show why accurate absolute stiffness and thermal softening must be assessed independently.
papers.title_cn: 基准测试通用机器学习原子间势对二元及高熵难熔碳化物温度相关弹性的预测
papers.abs_cn: 准确预测温度相关弹性对于评估高温条件下的难熔碳化物很重要，但从头算分子动力学（AIMD）的计算成本限制了跨成分和温度的系统研究。通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）提供了一种高效替代方案，但其在此任务中的准确性仍未得到充分确立。在此，我们针对五种二元和两种高熵（HE）碳化物在300至1200 K之间的一致AIMD参考数据，对九种uMLIPs进行了基准测试。弹性常数及相应的体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量通过应力-应变分子动力学获得，明确采样了热原子运动以及热膨胀之外的anharmonic效应。我们分别评估绝对弹性性质和归一化热软化。MACE-MH-1实现了最低的总体平均绝对百分比误差（5.7%）。MACE-MH-1和DPA4-Mini最准确地再现了热软化，平均偏差分别为2.5和2.3个百分点。所有模型通常低估刚度，相对于AIMD参考更大的平衡体积可能对大多数模型的这一趋势有贡献。C12表现出最大的模型依赖性误差。HE碳化物的描述精度与二元碳化物相当，表明化学复杂性没有明显的精度损失。准确性反而随过渡金属成分变化，第V族碳化物，特别是TaC，构成最大挑战。这些结果确定了用于碳化物有限温度弹性的有前景的预训练模型，并说明了为什么必须独立评估绝对刚度和热软化。

papers.title: Tunable Ultrastrong Magnon-Magnon Coupling and Squeezed States in a Triaxial Van der Waals Antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Achieving and quantifying ultrastrong magnon-magnon coupling (USC) remains a key challenge for quantum magnonics. Here, we demonstrate widely tunable USC between chiral (right- and left-handed) and acoustic or optical magnon modes in the van der Waals antiferromagnet $CrPS_4$. Using a full quantum model, we decompose the interaction into three microscopic interaction channels: the co-rotating term $g_1$ (mode hybridization), the counter-rotating term $g_2$ (two-mode squeezing), and, uniquely in the chiral regime, the self-squared term $g_3$ that mediates single-mode squeezing. The normalized coupling ratio reaches $g/f_g$ $\sim$ 0.41, entering the USC regime. Most significantly, we establish a complete protocol linking these USC parameters to a measurable quantum phenomenon: a squeezed magnon vacuum state. Our simulations not only visualize the chirality and polarization evolution of the hybrid modes but also demonstrate how to directly extract quadrature fluctuations and a substantial squeezing factor (up to $\sim$ 9.7 dB) from thermal noise-driven magnetization dynamics. This work provides a material-specific quantum framework for USC and a practical pathway to detect and exploit non-classical magnon states in low-damping two-dimensional magnets, opening a route toward quantum-enhanced spintronics and hybrid quantum information platforms.
papers.title_cn: 三轴范德华反铁磁体中的可调超强磁振子-磁振子耦合与压缩态
papers.abs_cn: 实现并量化超强磁振子-磁振子耦合（USC）仍然是量子磁子学的关键挑战。在此，我们展示了范德华反铁磁体 CrPS4 中手性（右旋和左旋）磁振子模式与声学或光学磁振子模式之间广泛可调的 USC。使用全量子模型，我们将相互作用分解为三个微观相互作用通道：共旋转项 g1（模式杂化）、反旋转项 g2（双模压缩），以及手性区域中独有的自平方项 g3，后者介导单模压缩。归一化耦合比达到 g/f_g ~ 0.41，进入 USC 区域。最重要的是，我们建立了一套完整的方案，将这些 USC 参数与一个可测量的量子现象联系起来：压缩磁振子真空态。我们的模拟不仅可视化了杂化模式的手性和偏振演化，还展示了如何从热噪声驱动的磁化动力学中直接提取正交涨落和显著的压缩因子（高达 ~ 9.7 dB）。这项工作为 USC 提供了一个材料特定的量子框架，并为在低阻尼二维磁体中探测和利用非经典磁振子态提供了一条实用途径，为量子增强自旋电子学和混合量子信息平台开辟了道路。

papers.title: Magnon band splitting without altermagnetism in CuF2
papers.abstract: Conclusive identification of an altermagnetic state requires going beyond mere symmetry arguments. We illustrate this in a combined computational and experimental study of the rutile-like material CuF$_2$, which is on the list of predicted altermagnets. Using ab initio and linear spin-wave calculations supplied by magnetization measurements, we show that CuF$_2$ in its experimental monoclinic structure can be described by a spin-$\frac12$ model of weakly coupled square-lattice layers with the in-plane coupling $J_1\simeq 115$ K and two synergistic antiferromagnetic interplane couplings amounting to 4% and 8% of $J_1$, respectively. Driven by long-range superexchange, these interlayer couplings are oblique to the square planes, resulting in the unit-cell doubling in the magnetically ordered state, thus effectively suppressing any altermagnetic band splitting. Concurrently, we identify unusually strong Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, $|\mathbf D|/J_1\simeq 0.3$, that produce spin canting and, together with order-by-disorder effect, pin the Néel vector to the crystallographic $b$-axis. Additionally, DM anisotropy promotes magnon band splitting, but these bands remain non-chiral. Our results highlight the importance of relativistic effects even in $3d$ magnets with altermagnetic symmetries.
papers.title_cn: CuF2 中无交变磁性的磁振子能带劈裂
papers.abs_cn: 要确凿地识别交变磁态，需要超越单纯的对称性论证。我们通过对类金红石材料 CuF2 的计算与实验联合研究来说明这一点，该材料位于预测的交变磁体列表中。利用从头算和线性自旋波计算，并结合磁化测量，我们表明实验单斜结构中的 CuF2 可以用一个自旋-1/2 模型来描述，该模型包含弱耦合的方格子层，面内耦合 J1 约为 115 K，以及两个协同的反铁磁层间耦合，分别相当于 J1 的 4% 和 8%。由长程超交换驱动，这些层间耦合相对于方格平面是倾斜的，导致磁有序态中晶胞加倍，从而有效抑制了任何交变磁能带劈裂。同时，我们识别出异常强的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用，|D|/J1 约为 0.3，它产生自旋倾斜，并与无序定序效应一起将 Néel 矢量钉扎在晶体学 b 轴上。此外，DM 各向异性促进磁振子能带劈裂，但这些能带保持非手性。我们的结果凸显了即使在具有交变磁对称性的 3d 磁体中，相对论效应的重要性。

papers.title: Elastic polymer networks of exceptional strength by deconcentrating tension
papers.abstract: The strength of a polymer network is orders of magnitude below that of a polymer chain, because the network concentrates high tension in a small fraction of polymer strands. Here we show that the strength of a network can be greatly amplified by recruiting a larger fraction of strands to bear high tension. We develop approaches to fabricate hydrogels of exceptional strength while maintaining low hysteresis. The strength of the hydrogel increases from ~0.05 MPa for a regular network, to ~1 MPa for a highly entangled network, and further to ~10 MPa for a prestretched interpenetrating network. Similar amplifications of strength are achieved for elastomers. Furthermore, experimental data suggest a scaling relation between strength and strand length. This work provides design principles for creating elastic and strong polymer networks.
papers.title_cn: 通过分散张力实现具有卓越强度的弹性聚合物网络
papers.abs_cn: 聚合物网络的强度比聚合物链低几个数量级，因为网络将高张力集中在少部分聚合物链上。在这里，我们表明通过调动更大比例的链来承受高张力，可以极大地增强网络的强度。我们开发了制备具有卓越强度同时保持低滞后的水凝胶的方法。水凝胶的强度从常规网络的约0.05 MPa，增加到高度缠结网络的约1 MPa，进一步增加到预拉伸互穿网络的约10 MPa。类似的强度增强也在弹性体中实现。此外，实验数据表明强度与链长之间存在标度关系。这项工作为创建弹性且强韧的聚合物网络提供了设计原则。

papers.title: Controlling transitions between nonequilibrium states through active bath engineering
papers.abstract: We develop a family of control protocols for finite-time transitions between active nonequilibrium steady states using the noise-color (correlation rate) as the sole control parameter. By reverse-engineering the second moment dynamics of an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, we determine the time-dependent correlation rate required to realize a prescribed evolution of the system's state. We experimentally implement these protocols with a micrometer-sized optically trapped particle coupled to an engineered active bath, demonstrating transitions substantially faster than the natural relaxation while keeping the confining potential, noise amplitude, and temperature fixed. Our approach extends engineered swift-equilibration methods to far-from-equilibrium steady states by directly controlling the temporal correlations of an active environment. We show how physical constraints impose a speed limit on finite-time transitions, while the freedom in choosing the prescribed system evolution can be exploited to eliminate control discontinuities, minimize the admissible transition time, or optimize a thermodynamic cost.
papers.title_cn: 通过主动浴工程控制非平衡态之间的转变
papers.abs_cn: 我们开发了一族控制协议，用于在主动非平衡稳态之间实现有限时间转变，其中以噪声色（关联速率）作为唯一的控制参数。通过逆向工程主动 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程的二阶矩动力学，我们确定了实现系统状态预定演化所需的时间依赖关联速率。我们利用一个微米级的光镊捕获粒子与工程化主动浴耦合，实验实现了这些协议，展示了在保持约束势、噪声幅度和温度固定的情况下，转变速度显著快于自然弛豫。我们的方法通过直接控制主动环境的时间关联，将工程化快速平衡方法扩展到远离平衡的稳态。我们展示了物理约束如何对有限时间转变施加速度极限，同时选择预定系统演化的自由度可用于消除控制不连续性、最小化允许的转变时间或优化热力学成本。

papers.title: Solution-Based Synthesis of Fe-Co-Ni Prussian Blue Analogue Powders: A Comparative Structural, Spectroscopic and Thermal Study
papers.abstract: Prussian Blue (Fe-PBA) and its Co and Ni analogues (Co-PBA and Ni-PBA) were synthesized by an additive-free aqueous co-precipitation route using K$_4$[Fe(CN)$_6$] and FeCl$_3$, CoCl$_2$, or NiCl$_2$, respectively. The three powders were systematically compared by X-ray diffraction, ATR-FTIR and Raman spectroscopy, FEG-SEM/EDS, and TG/SDTA. All compositions exhibit the characteristic cubic cyanide-bridged PBA framework, with apparent lattice parameters of 10.10 +/- 0.02, 10.01 +/- 0.02, and 10.10 +/- 0.03 Angstrom for Fe-PBA, Co-PBA, and Ni-PBA, respectively. The dominant C$\equiv$N stretching band in ATR-FTIR shifts from 2062 to 2071 and 2087 cm$^{-1}$ across the Fe-Co-Ni series, indicating composition-dependent changes in the local cyanide environment. Fe-PBA contains less potassium than the Co- and Ni-containing powders and exhibits a substantially larger low-temperature mass loss. Sharp reflections assigned to crystalline KCl are observed in all three diffraction patterns, while additional unassigned reflections in Ni-PBA indicate the presence of at least one further crystalline phase. These results show that differences among Fe-, Co-, and Ni-based PBAs cannot be attributed solely to transition-metal identity, as precursor oxidation state and washing efficiency also influence the composition and thermal response of the resulting powders.
papers.title_cn: 基于溶液法的 Fe-Co-Ni 普鲁士蓝类似物粉末合成：结构、光谱与热学性质的对比研究
papers.abs_cn: 采用无添加剂的水相共沉淀法，分别以 K4[Fe(CN)6] 与 FeCl3、CoCl2 或 NiCl2 为原料，合成了普鲁士蓝（Fe-PBA）及其 Co 和 Ni 类似物（Co-PBA 和 Ni-PBA）。通过 X 射线衍射、ATR-FTIR 和拉曼光谱、FEG-SEM/EDS 以及 TG/SDTA 对三种粉末进行了系统对比。所有组成均呈现典型的立方氰基桥连 PBA 骨架，Fe-PBA、Co-PBA 和 Ni-PBA 的表观晶格参数分别为 10.10 +/- 0.02、10.01 +/- 0.02 和 10.10 +/- 0.03 Angstrom。ATR-FTIR 中占主导的 C≡N 伸缩振动带在 Fe-Co-Ni 系列中从 2062 位移至 2071 和 2087 cm-1，表明局部氰基环境随组成变化。Fe-PBA 的钾含量低于含 Co 和 Ni 的粉末，并表现出显著更大的低温质量损失。三种衍射图谱中均观察到归属于结晶 KCl 的尖锐反射，而 Ni-PBA 中额外的未归属反射表明至少还存在另一种结晶相。这些结果表明，Fe、Co 和 Ni 基 PBA 之间的差异不能仅归因于过渡金属种类，前驱体氧化态和洗涤效率也会影响所得粉末的组成和热响应。

papers.title: Photoinduced Odd- and Mixed-Parity Magnetism in Collinear Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism, characterized by compensated collinear magnetic moments in real space and momentum-dependent spin splitting with even-parity symmetry, has recently emerged as a distinct form of magnetic order beyond the conventional ferro- and antiferromagnetic paradigms. However, realizing odd- and mixed-parity magnetism in fully compensated collinear magnets remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that light irradiation can induce odd- and mixed-parity magnetism in conventional collinear antiferromagnets. Taking monolayer CoS and CoSe as representative systems, and combining Floquet theory with first-principles calculations, we show that circularly polarized light (CPL) induces odd-parity $f$-wave spin splitting, whereas elliptically polarized light (EPL) induces odd-parity $p$-wave spin splitting. Uniaxial strain combined with CPL provides an alternative route to realizing the $p$-wave state. More remarkably, applying an electric field together with CPL or EPL transforms the spin splitting into mixed-parity forms. The light-induced breaking of $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry, together with spin-orbit coupling, further gives rise to a finite anomalous Hall response. Our work establishes a versatile strategy for engineering odd- and mixed-parity spin splitting in compensated antiferromagnets, offering a route toward light-controlled electronic and magnetic phenomena.
papers.title_cn: 共线反铁磁体中的光诱导奇宇称与混合宇称磁性
papers.abs_cn: 交替磁性（altermagnetism）以实空间中补偿的共线磁矩和具有偶宇称对称性的动量依赖自旋劈裂为特征，近年来作为超越传统铁磁和反铁磁范式的另一种磁有序形式而兴起。然而，在完全补偿的共线磁体中实现奇宇称和混合宇称磁性仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们证明光照射可以在常规共线反铁磁体中诱导奇宇称和混合宇称磁性。以单层 CoS 和 CoSe 作为代表性体系，结合 Floquet 理论与第一性原理计算，我们表明圆偏振光（CPL）诱导奇宇称 f 波自旋劈裂，而椭圆偏振光（EPL）诱导奇宇称 p 波自旋劈裂。单轴应变与 CPL 结合提供了实现 p 波态的替代途径。更引人注目的是，施加电场与 CPL 或 EPL 相结合可将自旋劈裂转变为混合宇称形式。光诱导的 PT 对称性破缺与自旋轨道耦合一起进一步产生了有限的异常霍尔响应。我们的工作建立了一种在补偿反铁磁体中工程化奇宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂的通用策略，为光控电子和磁现象提供了一条途径。

papers.title: Unitary Coupled Cluster Nuclear Shielding Constants in a Quantum Linear Response Framework
papers.abstract: We present calculations of nuclear shielding constants, a key ingredient in nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, within a quantum-computing-suitable framework. We employ quantum linear response (qLR) theory in combination with the unitary coupled cluster (UCC) ansatz and its orbital-optimized (oo-UCC), factorized (fUCC), and orbital-optimized factorized (oo-fUCC) variants. The methods are assessed for seven small molecules against CASCI, CASSCF, CCSD, and CCSD(T) reference calculations. The different UCC-based qLR approaches yield shielding constants in good agreement with comparable classical methods. Factorization, which is necessary for quantum-computing implementations, has only a negligible effect on the calculated shielding constants. Orbital optimization, in contrast, leads to substantial improvements, with oo-UCC and oo-fUCC showing markedly better agreement with CCSD and CCSD(T). Our results establish oo-fUCC combined with qLR as a promising approach for computing nuclear shielding constants on quantum computers.
papers.title_cn: 量子线性响应框架中的酉耦合簇核屏蔽常数
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了在适合量子计算的框架内计算核屏蔽常数的方法，核屏蔽常数是核磁共振波谱学中的关键要素。我们将量子线性响应（qLR）理论与酉耦合簇（UCC）拟设及其轨道优化（oo-UCC）、因子化（fUCC）和轨道优化因子化（oo-fUCC）变体相结合。针对七个小分子，我们将这些方法与CASCI、CASSCF、CCSD和CCSD(T)参考计算进行了评估。不同的基于UCC的qLR方法给出的屏蔽常数与可比的经典方法吻合良好。因子化是量子计算实现所必需的，但对计算的屏蔽常数仅有可忽略的影响。相比之下，轨道优化带来了显著改进，oo-UCC和oo-fUCC与CCSD和CCSD(T)的一致性明显更好。我们的结果确立了oo-fUCC结合qLR作为一种在量子计算机上计算核屏蔽常数的有前景的方法。

papers.title: Optical absorption spectra from the $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter framework for thousands of atoms
papers.abstract: The frequency-dependent absorption and emission of light determine the colors of matter and underpin today's technologies, from solar cells to light-emitting diodes. Predicting optical properties from first principles remains a computational challenge, especially for large and disordered systems. The $GW$ plus Bethe-Salpeter equation ($GW$-BSE) approach provides predictive accuracy for optical properties, but conventional implementations become costly as system size grows. Here, we present a $GW$-BSE framework combining real-time propagation, atom-centered basis sets, and a locally optimized real-space resolution of the identity. The cost of each propagation step scales quadratically with system size and roughly equals the cost of one self-consistent-field iteration in a density-functional calculation with a semilocal functional. This computational efficiency allows us to calculate the absorption spectrum of a nanographene containing 4616 atoms and opens a path toward routine calculations of optical properties for large disordered systems.
papers.title_cn: 面向数千原子的 $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter 框架下的光学吸收谱
papers.abs_cn: 光的频率相关吸收和发射决定了物质的颜色，并支撑着当今从太阳能电池到发光二极管的各种技术。从第一性原理预测光学性质仍然是一个计算挑战，尤其是对于大型和无序体系。$GW$ 加 Bethe-Salpeter 方程（$GW$-BSE）方法为光学性质提供了可预测的精度，但传统实现随着体系尺寸增大而变得昂贵。在这里，我们提出了一个 $GW$-BSE 框架，结合了实时传播、原子中心基组以及局部优化的实空间单位分解。每个传播步骤的成本随体系尺寸二次增长，并且大致等于使用半局域泛函的密度泛函计算中一次自洽场迭代的成本。这种计算效率使我们能够计算包含 4616 个原子的纳米石墨烯的吸收谱，并为大型无序体系光学性质的常规计算开辟了道路。

papers.title: Can end-to-end learning from raw electronic structure explain magnetic anisotropy?
papers.abstract: Machine-learning models trained directly on electronic spectra can predict spin--orbit-driven properties, yet models with comparable predictive accuracy may learn different electronic dependencies. We examine this problem using magnetic anisotropy in atomic-scale magnets and a validation strategy designed to assess the physical relevance of learned spectral relationships. We compare a bidirectional gated recurrent unit and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, both trained to predict magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) from spin- and orbital-resolved scalar-relativistic densities of states (SR-DOS). Despite comparable in-domain (ID) accuracy, the architectures learn only partly overlapping spectral dependencies. Shapley additive explanations identify spectral features shared between the two architectures that can be associated with plausible spin--orbit-coupling pathways consistent with second-order perturbation theory (PT2). Adding PT2-derived MAE contributions to the model inputs has little effect on ID performance but can improve transfer beyond the training domain, with gains differing between architectures. Controlled spectral perturbations further demonstrate that similar attribution patterns do not imply the same functional dependence of the predicted MAE on spectral weight. The contrasting responses provide a functional context for architecture-dependent out-of-domain transfer. End-to-end learning can identify candidate electronic signatures of magnetic anisotropy. Their credible microscopic interpretation, however, rests on convergent evidence from predictive performance, model comparison, physical theory, controlled spectral interventions, and evaluation under distribution shift.
papers.title_cn: 从原始电子结构进行端到端学习能否解释磁各向异性？
papers.abs_cn: 直接在电子谱上训练的机器学习模型可以预测自旋-轨道驱动的性质，但预测精度相当的模型可能学到不同的电子依赖关系。我们利用原子尺度磁体中的磁各向异性以及一种旨在评估所学谱关系物理相关性的验证策略来研究这一问题。我们比较了双向门控循环单元和一维卷积神经网络，两者均被训练用于从自旋和轨道分辨的标量相对论态密度（SR-DOS）预测磁各向异性能（MAE）。尽管域内（ID）精度相当，这两种架构学到的谱依赖关系仅部分重叠。Shapley 加性解释识别出两种架构共享的谱特征，这些特征可与符合二阶微扰理论（PT2）的合理自旋-轨道耦合路径相关联。将 PT2 导出的 MAE 贡献添加到模型输入中对 ID 性能影响甚微，但可以改善向训练域之外的迁移，且增益因架构而异。受控谱扰动进一步表明，相似的归因模式并不意味着预测的 MAE 对谱权重具有相同的函数依赖关系。这些对比性响应为架构依赖的域外迁移提供了功能背景。端到端学习可以识别磁各向异性的候选电子特征。然而，其可信的微观解释依赖于来自预测性能、模型比较、物理理论、受控谱干预以及分布偏移下评估的收敛证据。

papers.title: A General Algorithm for Minimal Uncoupled Stress--Strain Calculations of Elastic Constant
papers.abstract: We have developed a general algorithm for constructing the minimum number of strain configurations required to extract second-order elastic constants from first-principles stress-strain calculations without algebraic coupling between the constants targeted for extraction. The method operates on the sparsity structure of the symmetry-reduced elastic stiffness matrix, represented by an auxiliary binary matrix, and generates admissible strain patterns algorithmically rather than prescribing separate strain sets for individual crystal symmetries. Each independent elastic constant is obtained from a single stress component, while additional stress relations generated by the same deformation provide internal consistency checks. Because the six-dimensional strain space contains only 2^6-1=63 non-empty strain patterns, the minimality of the resulting sets can be verified exactly for every elastic-symmetry type considered. The construction reproduces established high-efficiency strain sets in cases where they are minimal and yields improved sets for symmetry classes in which previously tabulated schemes require additional configurations. Because the formulation is based on stress-strain derivatives, it can also be readily extended to finite temperatures using consistently sampled ensemble-averaged thermodynamic stresses. Explicit strain sets are derived for all elastic-symmetry types spanning the 230 crystallographic space groups, and their accuracy and computational efficiency are benchmarked against established approaches.
papers.title_cn: 弹性常数最小非耦合应力-应变计算的通用算法
papers.abs_cn: 我们开发了一种通用算法，用于构建从第一性原理应力-应变计算中提取二阶弹性常数所需的最少数量的应变构型，且目标提取常数之间不存在代数耦合。该方法基于对称约化弹性刚度矩阵的稀疏结构，用辅助二值矩阵表示，并通过算法生成允许的应变模式，而非为各个晶体对称性分别指定应变集。每个独立弹性常数由单个应力分量获得，而同一变形产生的额外应力关系提供内部一致性检验。由于六维应变空间仅包含 2^6-1=63 个非空应变模式，所得集合的最小性可对所考虑的每种弹性对称类型进行精确验证。该构造在已有高效应变集为最小的情况下复现了这些集合，并在先前表格方案需要额外构型的对称类中给出了改进的集合。由于该表述基于应力-应变导数，它也可以利用一致采样的系综平均热力学应力轻松扩展到有限温度。我们为涵盖 230 个晶体学空间群的所有弹性对称类型导出了显式应变集，并将其精度和计算效率与已有方法进行了基准比较。

papers.title: Interlayer ferromagnetic order revealed through pressure-enhanced interlayer exchange coupling in Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Van der Waals ferromagnets possess finite interlayer magnetic coupling despite their layered crystal structures, and this coupling plays an important role in determining their magnetic properties. In this study, we performed magnetization measurements on high-quality Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ single crystals while selectively tuning the interlayer coupling using hydrostatic pressure. We identified two characteristic temperatures, $T_{\rm inf1}$ and $T_{\rm inf2}$, below the Curie temperature with opposite pressure dependences: $T_{\rm inf1}$ is associated with thermally activated domain-wall depinning, whereas $T_{\rm inf2}$ reflects the formation of interlayer ferromagnetic order. Both temperatures exhibit pronounced pressure dependences, in sharp contrast to the nearly pressure-independent Curie temperature associated with intralayer ferromagnetic order. First-principles calculations revealed a substantial pressure-induced enhancement of the interlayer exchange interaction and reasonably reproduced $T_{\rm inf2}$ and its pressure dependence. These results demonstrate that the emergence of interlayer magnetic ordering can be predicted from the microscopic interlayer exchange coupling, establishing a predictive framework for understanding and designing interlayer coupling phenomena in layered magnetic materials.
papers.title_cn: 通过压力增强的层间交换耦合揭示 Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ 中的层间铁磁序
papers.abs_cn: 范德华铁磁体尽管具有层状晶体结构，却仍存在有限的层间磁耦合，这种耦合在决定其磁性质方面起着重要作用。在本研究中，我们对高质量 Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ 单晶进行了磁化测量，同时利用静水压选择性地调控层间耦合。我们在居里温度以下识别出两个特征温度 $T_{\rm inf1}$ 和 $T_{\rm inf2}$，它们具有相反的压力依赖性：$T_{\rm inf1}$ 与热激活的畴壁脱钉相关，而 $T_{\rm inf2}$ 则反映了层间铁磁序的形成。这两个温度都表现出显著的压力依赖性，与几乎不依赖于压力的、由层内铁磁序决定的居里温度形成鲜明对比。第一性原理计算揭示了压力诱导的层间交换相互作用显著增强，并合理地再现了 $T_{\rm inf2}$ 及其压力依赖性。这些结果表明，层间磁有序的出现可以从微观层间交换耦合中预测，从而为理解和设计层状磁性材料中的层间耦合现象建立了一个预测框架。

papers.title: Three-dimensional imaging of isolated membrane-protein complexes in vacuo with an X-ray laser
papers.abstract: The prospect of imaging single biomolecules, viruses and cells with intense, ultrashort X-ray pulses has driven the development of X-ray free-electron lasers (XFELs). However, the weak scattering from small particles is easily swamped by background from residual gas, which has so far limited applications to strongly scattering targets such as viruses, cell organelles and cells. Here we report a three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of an isolated 1-MDa membrane-protein complex, photosystem I (PS I), from single-particle diffraction data. PS I trimers were aerosolised by charge-reduction electrospray ionisation and injected into the European XFEL beam, with partial helium gas exchange reducing background scattering by 80%. From 32 788 diffraction patterns of single trimers in random orientations, we reconstructed the 3D electron density to a resolution of 3.8 nm, limited by the detector geometry. The disc-shaped density, about 22 nm across and 10 nm thick, matches the size of a PS I trimer in a detergent micelle and is consistent with the compaction predicted by molecular dynamics simulations of the complex in vacuo and observed in native mass spectrometry. These results show that membrane-protein complexes can be imaged in vacuo with X-ray lasers, an important step towards ultrafast diffractive imaging of single macromolecules.
papers.title_cn: 利用X射线激光对真空中分离的膜蛋白复合物进行三维成像
papers.abs_cn: 利用强超短X射线脉冲对单个生物分子、病毒和细胞进行成像的前景推动了X射线自由电子激光器（XFELs）的发展。然而，小颗粒的弱散射容易被残余气体的背景所淹没，迄今为止这限制了其应用于强散射目标，如病毒、细胞器和细胞。在此，我们报道了从单颗粒衍射数据中对一个分离的1-MDa膜蛋白复合物——光系统I（PS I）——进行三维（3D）重建。PS I三聚体通过电荷还原电喷雾电离被气溶胶化并注入欧洲XFEL光束中，部分氦气交换将背景散射降低了80%。从随机取向的单个三聚体的32 788个衍射图案中，我们重建了三维电子密度，分辨率达到3.8 nm，受限于探测器几何构型。该圆盘状密度约22 nm宽、10 nm厚，与去垢剂胶束中PS I三聚体的大小相符，并与该复合物在真空中的分子动力学模拟所预测的以及天然质谱中观察到的紧缩构象一致。这些结果表明，膜蛋白复合物可以在真空中用X射线激光进行成像，这是迈向单个大分子超快衍射成像的重要一步。

papers.title: Predictable Accuracy of Martini 3 Absolute Protein-Ligand Binding Free Energies across 15 Targets
papers.abstract: Alchemical free-energy calculations predict protein-ligand binding affinities with close-to-experimental accuracy, but their cost restricts them to small sets of ligands. Coarse-grained (CG) models such as Martini 3 retain a rigorous statistical-mechanical treatment at a fraction of this cost, yet their accuracy for protein-ligand binding has not been assessed systematically. Here, we compute absolute binding free energies for 172 ligands across 15 protein targets with a Martini 3 double-decoupling protocol and compare them against atomistic FEP+ and OpenFE references. Martini underbinds for every target, by 2.7 to 8.7 kcal/mol. This offset is systematic: it comprises a uniform contribution that grows with the number of charged pocket residues. A linear model in this number, which requires only the protein structure, reduces the mean absolute error from 5.7 to 1.2 kcal/mol in leave-one-out cross-validation, close to the 1.0 kcal/mol obtained with exact per-target offsets. The ranking of ligands within a target varies more widely (median Spearman $ρ$ of 0.32, from $-$0.41 to 0.89) and is rationalized by the structure-activity relationship of each series: Martini ranks ligands well when their affinity is driven by hydrophobicity, $π$-stacking, or size, and poorly when it is driven by hydrogen bonding or charge. Both trends follow from Martini's calibration against bulk partitioning, which captures neither the dielectric environment of a binding pocket nor the directionality of hydrogen bonds. While MMGBSA retains the atomistic detail needed to rank congeneric ligands, Martini yields physically meaningful free energies, and its coarse-graining maps many atomistically distinct molecules onto one representation, making it a complementary tool for rapidly spanning chemical space.
papers.title_cn: Martini 3 绝对蛋白质-配体结合自由能在 15 个靶点上的可预测准确性
papers.abs_cn: 炼金术自由能计算能够以接近实验的精度预测蛋白质-配体结合亲和力，但其成本限制了其只能应用于小规模配体集合。诸如 Martini 3 的粗粒化（CG）模型以远低于此的成本保留了严格的统计力学处理，但其对蛋白质-配体结合的准确性尚未被系统评估。在此，我们使用 Martini 3 双解耦方案计算了 15 个蛋白质靶点上 172 个配体的绝对结合自由能，并将其与全原子 FEP+ 和 OpenFE 参考值进行比较。Martini 对每个靶点均表现为结合过弱，偏差为 2.7 至 8.7 kcal/mol。该偏移是系统性的：它包含一个随带电口袋残基数量增长的均匀贡献。仅需蛋白质结构的、关于该数量的线性模型，在留一交叉验证中将平均绝对误差从 5.7 kcal/mol 降至 1.2 kcal/mol，接近使用精确逐靶点偏移所获得的 1.0 kcal/mol。同一靶点内配体的排序变化更大（Spearman $ρ$ 中位数为 0.32，范围从 $-$0.41 到 0.89），并可通过每个系列的结构-活性关系加以解释：当配体亲和力由疏水性、$π$-堆积或尺寸驱动时，Martini 排序良好；而当其由氢键或电荷驱动时，排序较差。这两种趋势均源于 Martini 基于体相分配性质的校准，这既不能捕捉结合口袋的介电环境，也不能捕捉氢键的方向性。虽然 MMGBSA 保留了排序同源配体所需的全原子细节，但 Martini 能给出物理上有意义的自由能，且其粗粒化将许多原子层面上不同的分子映射到同一表示，使其成为快速跨越化学空间的互补工具。

papers.title: Predicting plasmonic pole representations of complex dielectric spectra using convolutional neural networks
papers.abstract: Extracting spectral properties such as energy position, broadening, and spectral weight from dielectric spectra is critical for interpreting collective electronic excitations in many-body physics. Conventional approaches typically rely on nonlinear fitting procedures that can be computationally demanding and highly sensitive to initialization and fitting choices. In this work, we develop a convolutional neural-network framework for the direct inversion of dielectric spectra into their underlying plasmonic pole structures using a multipole-Padé representation. Rather than training on a constrained database of spectra associated with a specific set of materials, the network is trained entirely on synthetic spectra generated from the analytical multipole-Padé expression with randomized parameters. This enables the network to learn the general mapping between the spectra and their features in an unbiased way, without requiring large, material-specific datasets derived from real materials. We demonstrate that the synthetically trained network generalizes to complex first-principles and experimental dielectric spectra, extracting the underlying pole parameters with high accuracy in a single forward pass. This approach provides an efficient and robust alternative to conventional nonlinear fitting, enabling high-throughput, automated analysis of dielectric spectra across diverse materials and applications.
papers.title_cn: 使用卷积神经网络预测复杂介电谱的等离激元极点表示
papers.abs_cn: 从介电谱中提取能量位置、展宽和谱权重等谱特性对于解释多体物理中的集体电子激发至关重要。传统方法通常依赖于非线性拟合过程，这类方法计算量大，且对初始化和拟合选择高度敏感。在本工作中，我们开发了一个卷积神经网络框架，利用多极点-Padé表示将介电谱直接反演为其潜在的等离激元极点结构。该网络并非在特定材料集相关的受限谱数据库上训练，而是完全在由随机参数化的解析多极点-Padé表达式生成的合成谱上进行训练。这使得网络能够以无偏的方式学习谱与其特征之间的一般映射，而无需来自真实材料的大型材料特定数据集。我们证明，经过合成训练的网络能够泛化到复杂的第一性原理和实验介电谱，在单次前向传播中以高精度提取潜在的极点参数。该方法为传统非线性拟合提供了一种高效且稳健的替代方案，能够实现跨多种材料和应用的介电谱高通量自动化分析。

papers.title: Mode-selective electron-phonon coupling drives charge density waves in the kagome metals YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$
papers.abstract: YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ host the highest charge density wave (CDW) transition temperatures ever reported in kagome metals, $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx 800$ and 400~K, with propagation vectors $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx(1/2,0,0)$ and $(1/4,0,0)$, respectively. The microscopic mechanism behind these record values has remained unresolved. Here, we combine anharmonic phonon renormalization extracted from molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned force field with mode-resolved electron-phonon coupling (EPC) analysis to identify this mechanism. The CDW is driven by mode-selective EPC: the Ru out-of-plane phonon modes couple the Ru-$d_{xz}/d_{yz}$ and Si-$p_x/p_y$ orbitals, and the phonon linewidth peaks sharply at $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$, while the featureless electronic susceptibility rules out Fermi-surface nesting. Phonon anharmonicity melts the CDW, and the anharmonic phonon spectra reproduce both $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ and $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ in good agreement with experiments. Molecular dynamics simulations also visualize the CDW melting in real space. Chemical bonding analysis further shows that the smaller Y$^{3+}$ radius strengthens the Ru-Ru bonds, enhancing lattice rigidity and accounting for the factor-of-two higher $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ of YRu$_3$Si$_2$. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of CDW formation and melting in kagome metals YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$.
papers.title_cn: 模式选择性电子-声子耦合驱动笼目金属 YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 和 LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ 中的电荷密度波
papers.abs_cn: YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 和 LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ 具有笼目金属中迄今报道的最高电荷密度波（CDW）转变温度，$T_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx 800$ 和 400~K，其传播矢量分别为 $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx(1/2,0,0)$ 和 $(1/4,0,0)$。这些创纪录数值背后的微观机制一直未得到解决。在此，我们将由机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学所提取的非谐声子重整化与模式分辨的电子-声子耦合（EPC）分析相结合，以确定这一机制。CDW 由模式选择性 EPC 驱动：Ru 面外声子模式耦合 Ru-$d_{xz}/d_{yz}$ 和 Si-$p_x/p_y$ 轨道，声子线宽在 $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 处急剧达到峰值，而无特征的电子磁化率排除了费米面嵌套。声子非谐性熔化 CDW，非谐声子谱再现的 $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 和 $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 与实验吻合良好。分子动力学模拟还在实空间中可视化了 CDW 的熔化。化学键分析进一步表明，较小的 Y$^{3+}$ 半径增强了 Ru-Ru 键，提高了晶格刚性，并解释了 YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 的 $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 高出两倍的原因。我们的结果建立了笼目金属 YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 和 LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ 中 CDW 形成与熔化的统一微观图像。

papers.title: Non-Perturbative Vibrational Excitation by Arbitrary Electric Fields from Classical Phase-Space Dynamics
papers.abstract: We present a non-perturbative framework for the quantum treatment of vibrational excitation in molecular systems driven by electric fields with arbitrary time dependence. For harmonic potentials with linear dipole coupling, the field-induced dynamics is exactly described by a displaced coherent state, whose evolution is completely determined by a complex phase-space coordinate. Closed-form expressions for this coordinate reveal a clear distinction between resonant and non-resonant regimes. The resulting vibrational populations follow a Poisson distribution determined by a dimensionless time-dependent phase-space displacement, for both resonant and non-resonant driving. Resonant driving results in an enhanced phase-space displacement, whereas finite detuning between the driving and vibrational frequencies leads to an exponential suppression of the phase-space displacement and vibrational excitation. While the approach reduces to the standard time-dependent perturbation theory in the weak-field limit, it remains valid in the strong-field regime, where perturbative treatments fail. Our results provide a transparent phase-space picture of vibrational control and enable non-perturbative state preparation in ultrafast spectroscopy.
papers.title_cn: 基于经典相空间动力学的任意电场非微扰振动激发
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了一个非微扰框架，用于量子处理由任意时间依赖电场驱动的分子系统中的振动激发。对于具有线性偶极耦合的谐振子势，场诱导动力学可以由一个位移相干态精确描述，其演化完全由一个复相空间坐标决定。该坐标的闭式表达式揭示了共振区与非共振区之间的清晰区别。对于共振和非共振驱动，所得的振动布居数均遵循由无量纲时间依赖相空间位移决定的泊松分布。共振驱动导致增强的相空间位移，而驱动频率与振动频率之间的有限失谐则导致相空间位移和振动激发的指数抑制。虽然该方法在弱场极限下退化为标准的时间依赖微扰理论，但它在微扰处理失效的强场区域仍然有效。我们的结果为振动控制提供了一个透明的相空间图像，并使得超快光谱中的非微扰态制备成为可能。

papers.title: Robust skyrmion nucleation and transport via composition gradient in rare earth-transition metal ferrimagnets
papers.abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are typically nucleated via localized excitation methods, such as laser heating, spin-orbit torques, or engineered defects, and their controlled transport is often limited by the skyrmion Hall effect. Here, we demonstrate that spatial gradients in rare-earth--transition-metal alloys, achievable through patterned laser writing, enable both deterministic nucleation and controlled transport. The strategy leverages engineered compositional gradient to cross the magnetization compensation point, defining regions with opposite magnetization. An out-of-plane magnetic field selectively reverses the magnetization, generating a skyrmion. Crucially, the same compositional design enables a channel tuned to the spin angular momentum compensation point, where skyrmions are driven by spin-orbit torques at high velocity with vanishing skyrmion Hall effect. Local composition variations act as pinning sites, enabling threshold-controlled trapping and release.
papers.title_cn: 稀土-过渡金属亚铁磁体中通过成分梯度实现稳健的斯格明子成核与输运
papers.abs_cn: 磁性斯格明子通常通过局域激发方法成核，例如激光加热、自旋轨道矩或人工缺陷，而其受控输运往往受到斯格明子霍尔效应的限制。在此，我们证明稀土-过渡金属合金中的空间梯度——可通过图案化激光写入实现——能够同时实现确定性成核和受控输运。该策略利用工程化成分梯度穿越磁化补偿点，定义出具有相反磁化的区域。面外磁场选择性地反转磁化，从而产生斯格明子。关键在于，相同的成分设计能够实现一个调谐至自旋角动量补偿点的通道，在该通道中斯格明子由自旋轨道矩以高速度驱动，且斯格明子霍尔效应消失。局部成分变化充当钉扎位点，从而实现阈值控制的捕获与释放。

papers.title: Autonomous thermodynamic cycles via robotic mobility and sensing
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic cycles are the foundation of energy conversion across natural and engineered systems, transforming heat into useful work. However, these cycles traditionally operate between fixed thermal reservoirs, restricting them to specific locations and temperature differences. Here, we introduce autonomous thermodynamic cycles enabled by robotic mobility and sensing, allowing robots to perform thermodynamic cycles by accessing spatially varying temperature fields. We experimentally realize this concept using multistable gas-filled capsules that circulate within the system across a thermal gradient. Our model reveals that rapid transitions in the capsules' energy states allow the system to operate as a mobile heat engine that harvests and stores energy. By linking the capsule-scale internal energy dynamics to the robot's large-scale navigation strategy, we optimize locomotion paths that balance motion cost and energy harvesting. These findings demonstrate that thermodynamic cycles can emerge when autonomous systems navigate their environments, offering an artificial analog of organisms that forage for energy across spatial resources.
papers.title_cn: 通过机器人移动与感知实现自主热力学循环
papers.abs_cn: 热力学循环是自然和工程系统中能量转换的基础，将热量转化为有用功。然而，这些循环传统上在固定热库之间运行，限制了其只能在特定位置和温差下工作。在此，我们引入了由机器人移动与感知实现的自主热力学循环，使机器人能够通过访问空间变化的温度场来执行热力学循环。我们使用在系统内跨越温度梯度循环运动的多稳态充气胶囊实验性地实现了这一概念。我们的模型揭示，胶囊能量状态的快速转变使系统能够作为一个移动热机运行，收集并储存能量。通过将胶囊尺度的内能动力学与机器人的大规模导航策略相联系，我们优化了平衡运动成本与能量收集的运动路径。这些发现表明，当自主系统在其环境中导航时，热力学循环可以涌现，为在空间资源中觅食能量的生物体提供了一种人工类比。

papers.title: Convergence of Roberts flow dynamos in Eulerian and Lagrangian codes
papers.abstract: Standard benchmark tests for numerical magnetohydrodynamics codes focus on one- and two-dimensional problems that ignore the possibility of dynamos, i.e., an exponential instability converting kinetic energy into magnetic energy. They also tend to ignore magnetic helicity conservation that can have dramatic effects in periodic domains. The existence of magnetic diffusion is crucial for dynamos, as was exemplified by the impossibility of finding dynamo solutions when using Euler potentials, which is a perfectly valid approach in the absence of magnetic diffusion. The Roberts flows~I, II, III, and IV are two-dimensional flows that support three-dimensional dynamos, all of which are also large-scale dynamos in the sense that their planar averages are of significant strengths, even though flow~II is pointwise non-helical. Here we demonstrate the numerical convergence properties of solutions obtained using discretisation schemes of second, sixth, and tenth order in the mesh width in the Pencil Code, compare the results with the SPH-based SWIFT code, and present a list of averaged quantities that facilitate their use in characterising the solutions as benchmarks.
